Nadhir Benbouali.note: Benbouali is on the scoresheet for Algeria, with his goal coming against Jordan. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Nadhir Benbouali.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Nathan Saliba.name: Nathan Saliba
Nathan Saliba.summary: Nathan-Dylan Saliba (born February 7, 2004) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays for Belgian Pro League club Anderlecht and the Canada national team.
Nathan Saliba.note: Saliba has already given Canada a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Nathan Saliba.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Canada贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Nathaniel Brown.name: Nathaniel Brown
Nathaniel Brown.summary: Nathaniel Christopher Brown (born 16 June 2003) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Germany national team.
Nathaniel Brown.note: Brown has shown both sides of the attacking job for Germany. One action can pull the defender, and the next one can decide the chance.
Nathaniel Brown.noteZh: 他给Germany展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Nestory Irankunda.name: Nestory Irankunda
Nestory Irankunda.summary: Nestory Irankunda (/nɛstəriː ɪrəŋkʊndɑ/ NEST-ər-EE ir-əng-KUN-da; Kirundi: [iɾaŋkunda]; born 9 February 2006) is a professional soccer player who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in Tanzania, he plays for the Australia national team.
Nestory Irankunda.note: Irankunda has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Türkiye. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Nestory Irankunda.noteZh: 他已经为Australia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Neymar.name: Neymar
Neymar.summary: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [nejˈmaʁ dɐ ˈsiwvɐ ˈsɐ̃tuz ˈʒuni.oʁ] ; born 5 February 1992), simply known as Neymar Júnior (shortened to Neymar Jr) or mononymously as Neymar, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays...
Neymar.note: Neymar is midfield insurance for Brazil. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Neymar.noteZh: 他给Brazil一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Nico Schlotterbeck.name: Nico Schlotterbeck
Nico Schlotterbeck.summary: Nico Cédric Schlotterbeck (German pronunciation: [ˈniːko ˈʃlɔtɐˌbɛk]; born 1 December 1999) is a German professional footballer who plays primarily as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Germany national team.
Nico Schlotterbeck.note: Schlotterbeck already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Curaçao. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Nico Schlotterbeck.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Nico Williams.name: Nico Williams
Nico Williams.summary: Nicholas Williams Arthuer (born 12 July 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team. He is recognised for his speed and dribbling skills.
Nico Williams.note: Nico gives Spain the threat that keeps the far side honest. Even when he is not scoring, his speed stops teams from squeezing everything toward Yamal.
Nico Williams.noteZh: 尼科给西班牙带来让远端防线不敢收得太狠的威胁。即使他没有进球，他的速度也会阻止对手把一切都压向亚马尔。

Nicolas Jackson.name: Nicolas Jackson
Nicolas Jackson.summary: Nicolas Jackson (born 20 June 2001) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a striker and winger for Premier League club Chelsea, and the Senegal national team.
Nicolas Jackson.note: Jackson has already made a goal happen for Senegal. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Nicolas Jackson.noteZh: 他已经为Senegal送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Noah Sadiki.name: Noah Sadiki
Noah Sadiki.summary: Noah Junior Sadiki (born 17 December 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Noah Sadiki.note: Sadiki is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For DR Congo, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Noah Sadiki.noteZh: 他给DR Congo提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Noor Al-Rawabdeh.name: Noor Al-Rawabdeh
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.summary: Noor Al-Deen Mahmoud Ali Al-Rawabdeh (Arabic: نُور الدِّيْن مَحمُود عَلِيّ الرَّوَّابدَة; born 24 February 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Malaysia Super League club Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.note: Al-Rawabdeh is a tempo player for Jordan. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.noteZh: 他让Jordan在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Nuno Mendes.name: Nuno Mendes
Nuno Mendes.summary: Nuno Alexandre Tavares Mendes (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈnunu ˈmẽdɨʃ]; born 19 June 2002) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.
Nuno Mendes.note: Mendes's World Cup has already included a goal against Uzbekistan. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Nuno Mendes.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Omar Marmoush.name: Omar Marmoush
Omar Marmoush.summary: Omar Khaled Mohamed Abdelsalam Marmoush (Egyptian Arabic: عمر خالد محمد عبد السلام مرموش; born 7 February 1999) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Manchester City and the Egypt national team.
Omar Marmoush.note: Marmoush is one of Egypt's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Omar Marmoush.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Egypt来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Omar Rekik.name: Omar Rekik
Omar Rekik.summary: Omar Rekik (Arabic: عمر رقيق; born 20 December 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Slovenian PrvaLiga club Maribor. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Tunisia national team.
Omar Rekik.note: Rekik has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Sweden. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Omar Rekik.noteZh: 他已经为Tunisia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Ousmane Dembele.name: Ousmane Dembele
Ousmane Dembele.summary: Masour Ousmane Dembélé (French pronunciation: [us.man dɛm.be.le]; born 15 May 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward or right winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.
Ousmane Dembele.note: Dembele has been France's chaos button on the right. He can shoot with either foot, and Norway found out how quickly one good spell can become a hat trick.
Ousmane Dembele.noteZh: 登贝莱是法国右侧的混乱按钮。他左右脚都能射门，挪威已经见识到一段好状态能多快变成帽子戏法。

Patrik Schick.name: Patrik Schick
Patrik Schick.summary: Patrik Schick (born 24 January 1996) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Czech Republic national team.
Patrik Schick.note: Schick is one of Czechia's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Patrik Schick.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Czechia来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Pedri.name: Pedri
Pedri.summary: Pedro González López (born 25 November 2002), more commonly known as Pedri, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. Pedri is considered one of the best midfielders in the world.
Pedri.note: Pedri is the player who makes Spain's possession feel less sterile. He receives under pressure, turns the ball into a better angle, and lets the wide players attack later.
Pedri.noteZh: 佩德里让西班牙的控球不只是空转。他能在压力下接球，把球转到更好的角度，再让边路球员发动。

Petar Musa.name: Petar Musa
Petar Musa.summary: Petar Musa (Croatian pronunciation: [pětar mûsa]; born 4 March 1998) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas and the Croatia national team.
Petar Musa.note: Musa already has a World Cup goal in this run, against England. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Petar Musa.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Piero Hincapie.name: Piero Hincapie
Piero Hincapie.summary: Piero Martín Hincapié Reyna (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpjeɾo iŋkaˈpje]; born 9 January 2002) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Arsenal, on loan from Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen, and the...
Piero Hincapie.note: Hincapié has been part of Ecuador's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Piero Hincapie.noteZh: 他给Ecuador后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Rafael Leao.name: Rafael Leao
Rafael Leao.summary: Rafael "Rafa" Alexandre da Conceição Leão (Portuguese pronunciation: [ʁɐfɐˈɛl ˈljɐ̃w]; born 10 June 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left winger and forward for Serie A club AC Milan and the Portugal national team.
Rafael Leao.note: Leão has already given Portugal a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Rafael Leao.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Portugal贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Ramin Rezaeian.name: Ramin Rezaeian
Ramin Rezaeian.summary: Ramin Rezaeian Semeskandi (born 21 March 1990) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Persian Gulf Pro League club Esteghlal and the Iran national team. He started his career as a right-back, but he often plays as a winger.
Ramin Rezaeian.note: Rezaeian has given IR Iran both the finish and the pass, including goals against New Zealand and Egypt. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Ramin Rezaeian.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了IR Iran的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Raul Jimenez.name: Raul Jimenez
Raul Jimenez.summary: Raúl Alonso Jiménez Rodríguez (Latin American Spanish: [raˈul xiˈmenes]; born 5 May 1991) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Mexico national team.
Raul Jimenez.note: Jiménez has been one of Mexico's real scoring stories, with goals against South Africa, Ecuador, and England. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Raul Jimenez.noteZh: 他已经是Mexico这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Ritsu Doan.name: Ritsu Doan
Ritsu Doan.summary: Ritsu Dōan (堂安 律, Dōan Ritsu; born 16 June 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Japan national team.
Ritsu Doan.note: Dōan has supplied one of Japan's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ritsu Doan.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Riyad Mahrez.name: Riyad Mahrez
Riyad Mahrez.summary: Riyad Karim Mahrez (born 21 February 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Al-Ahli. Born in France, he captains the Algeria national team.
Riyad Mahrez.note: Mahrez has given Algeria both the finish and the pass, including goals against Austria. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Riyad Mahrez.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了Algeria的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Roberto Lopes.name: Roberto Lopes
Roberto Lopes.summary: Roberto Carlos Lopes (Portuguese: [ʀu.ˈbɛ.tu ˈkaɾ.luʒ ˈlɔpɨʃ]; born 17 June 1992), also known as Pico (Kabuverdianu: [ˈpi.ku]), is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Shamrock Rovers.
Roberto Lopes.note: Lopes has been part of Cabo Verde's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Roberto Lopes.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Romano Schmid.name: Romano Schmid
Romano Schmid.summary: Romano Christian Schmid (born 27 January 2000) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen and the Austria national team.
Romano Schmid.note: Schmid already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Jordan. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Romano Schmid.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Romelu Lukaku.name: Romelu Lukaku
Romelu Lukaku.summary: Romelu Lukaku Bolingoli (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈroːmeːlu luˈkaːku]; born 13 May 1993) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Napoli and the Belgium national team.
Romelu Lukaku.note: Lukaku has kept Belgium alive late, scoring against New Zealand, Senegal, and the United States. His card is simple: service into the box still changes the match.
Romelu Lukaku.noteZh: 卢卡库在比赛后段不断让比利时活下来，对新西兰、塞内加尔和美国都有进球。他的卡片很简单：传进禁区的球依然会改变比赛。

Ronald Araujo.name: Ronald Araujo
Ronald Araujo.summary: Ronald Federico Araújo da Silva (Spanish pronunciation: [roˈnald aɾaˈuxo]; born 7 March 1999) is an Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona, whom he captains, and the Uruguay national team.
Ronald Araujo.note: Araújo is back-line insurance for Uruguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Ronald Araujo.noteZh: 他给Uruguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Ronwen Williams.name: Ronwen Williams
Ronwen Williams.summary: Ronwen Hayden Williams (born 21 January 1992) is a South African soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier Soccer League club Mamelodi Sundowns and captains the South Africa national team.
Ronwen Williams.note: Williams has carried the keeper minutes for South Africa. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Ronwen Williams.noteZh: 他是South Africa防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Ruben Dias.name: Ruben Dias
Ruben Dias.summary: Rúben dos Santos Gato Alves Dias (born 14 May 1997) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Portugal national team. He is regarded as one of the best centre-backs in the world.
Ruben Dias.note: Dias gives Portugal one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Ruben Dias.noteZh: 他是Portugal无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Ruben Vargas.name: Ruben Vargas
Ruben Vargas.summary: Rubén Estephan Vargas Martínez (born 5 August 1998) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Spanish La Liga club Sevilla and the Switzerland national team.
Ruben Vargas.note: Vargas has scored and assisted in Switzerland's run while moving across the front line. He is the runner who appears after Embolo has occupied the first defender.
Ruben Vargas.noteZh: 巴尔加斯在瑞士这段征程中既进球又助攻，并在锋线多个位置移动。他会在恩博洛牵制第一名防守者后出现。

Rustamjon Ashurmatov.name: Rustamjon Ashurmatov
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.summary: Rustam Ashurmatov (Uzbek: Рустам Ашурматов; born 7 July 1996), sometimes spelt as Rustamjon Ashurmatov, is an Uzbek footballer who plays as a defender for Iranian club Esteghlal and the Uzbekistan national team.
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.note: Ashurmatov has been part of Uzbekistan's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.noteZh: 他在Uzbekistan体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Ryan Mendes.name: Ryan Mendes
Ryan Mendes.summary: Ryan Isaac Mendes da Graça (Portuguese: [ʀi.ˈɐ̃ i.ˈzak ˈmẽ.dɨʒ dɐ ˈɡɾa.sɐ]; born 8 January 1990) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a winger for TFF 1. Lig club Iğdır and the Cape Verde national team.
Ryan Mendes.note: Mendes has supplied one of Cabo Verde's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ryan Mendes.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Cabo Verde创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Sadio Mane.name: Sadio Mane
Sadio Mane.summary: Sadio Mané (born 10 April 1992) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Senegal national team.
Sadio Mane.note: Mané has one tournament assist in the bank for Senegal. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Sadio Mane.noteZh: 他已经帮Senegal制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Salem Al-Dawsari.name: Salem Al-Dawsari
Salem Al-Dawsari.summary: Salem Mohammed Shafi Al-Dawsari (Arabic: سَالِم مُحَمَّد شَافِي الدَّوْسَرِيّ; born 19 August 1991) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a left winger and captains both Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Salem Al-Dawsari.note: Al-Dawsari is one of Saudi Arabia's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Salem Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Saudi Arabia来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Saman Ghoddos.name: Saman Ghoddos
Saman Ghoddos.summary: Saman Ghoddos (Persian: سامان قدّوس; born 6 September 1993), known as Seyed Saman Ghoddoos in Iran, is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or striker for the Iran national team and Kalba in UAE Pro League.
Saman Ghoddos.note: Ghoddos is in the quiet-work part of IR Iran's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Saman Ghoddos.noteZh: 他是IR Iran主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Santiago Gimenez.name: Santiago Gimenez
Santiago Gimenez.summary: Santiago Tomás “Santi” Giménez Zolotarchuk (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo toˈmas xiˈmenes]; born 18 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club AC Milan. Born in Argentina, he represents the Mexico national team.
Santiago Gimenez.note: Giménez is one of Mexico's named attacking routes in this tournament. His job is to make the first defender move so the finish or final pass can appear.
Santiago Gimenez.noteZh: 他给Mexico一种把控球变成压力的路线。他要让防守者必须做选择。

Sarpreet Singh.name: Sarpreet Singh
Sarpreet Singh.summary: Sarpreet Singh (born 20 February 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for A-League Men club Wellington Phoenix, on loan from Serbian SuperLiga club TSC and the New Zealand national team.
Sarpreet Singh.note: Singh is a tempo player for New Zealand. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Sarpreet Singh.noteZh: 他让New Zealand在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Scott McTominay.name: Scott McTominay
Scott McTominay.summary: Scott Francis McTominay (born 8 December 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Napoli. Born in England, he plays for the Scotland national team.
Scott McTominay.note: McTominay is a tempo player for Scotland. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Scott McTominay.noteZh: 他让Scotland在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Sead Kolasinac.name: Sead Kolasinac
Sead Kolasinac.summary: Sead Kolašinac (pronounced [sěad kolaʃîːnats]; born 20 June 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Atalanta. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Sead Kolasinac.note: Kolašinac has supplied one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Sead Kolasinac.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Bosnia and Herzegovina创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Simon Adingra.name: Simon Adingra
Simon Adingra.summary: Simon Adingra (born 1 January 2002) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Monaco, on loan from Premier League club Sunderland, and the Ivory Coast national team.
Simon Adingra.note: Adingra gives Côte d'Ivoire a route when possession needs to become pressure. He is there to make a defender choose.
Simon Adingra.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire这届赛事中被重点使用的进攻路线之一。他先让第一名防守者移动，再让终结或最后一传出现。

Son Heung-min.name: Son Heung-min
Son Heung-min.summary: Son Heung-min is South Korea's captain and Los Angeles FC forward, giving the national team elite movement, two-footed finishing, and transition threat.
Son Heung-min.note: Heung-min is one of South Korea's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Son Heung-min.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对South Korea来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Stephen Eustaquio.name: Stephen Eustaquio
Stephen Eustaquio.summary: Stephen Antunes Eustáquio ( STEF-ən; born 21 December 1996) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Los Angeles FC, on loan from Primeira Liga club Porto, and vice-captains the Canada national team.
Stephen Eustaquio.club: Los Angeles FC (on loan from Porto)
Stephen Eustaquio.note: Eustáquio's World Cup has already included a goal against South Africa. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Stephen Eustaquio.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Tahith Chong.name: Tahith Chong
Tahith Chong.summary: Tahith Jose Girigorio Djorkaef Chong (born 4 December 1999) is a Curaçaoan professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Sheffield United and the Curaçao national team.
Tahith Chong.note: Chong has been one of Curaçao's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Tahith Chong.noteZh: 他是Curaçao这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Takefusa Kubo.name: Takefusa Kubo
Takefusa Kubo.summary: Takefusa Kubo (born 4 June 2001), commonly known as Take Kubo, is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for La Liga club Real Sociedad and the Japan national team.
Takefusa Kubo.note: Kubo has one tournament assist in the bank for Japan. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Takefusa Kubo.noteZh: 他已经帮Japan制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Teboho Mokoena.name: Teboho Mokoena
Teboho Mokoena.summary: Teboho Mokoena (born 24 January 1997) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Premiership side Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Teboho Mokoena.note: Mokoena's World Cup has already included a goal against Czechia. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Teboho Mokoena.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Thomas Partey.name: Thomas Partey
Thomas Partey.summary: Thomas Teye Partey (born 13 June 1993) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Villarreal and the Ghana national team.
Thomas Partey.note: Partey is a tempo player for Ghana. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Thomas Partey.noteZh: 他让Ghana在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Tomas Soucek.name: Tomas Soucek
Tomas Soucek.summary: Tomáš Souček (Czech pronunciation: [ˈtomaːʃ ˈsoutʃɛk]; born 27 February 1995) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Czech Republic national team.
Tomas Soucek.note: Souček gives Czechia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Tomas Soucek.noteZh: 他是Czechia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Trezeguet.name: Trezeguet
Trezeguet.summary: Mahmoud Ahmed Ibrahim Hassan (Arabic: محمود أحمد إبراهيم حسن; born 1 October 1994), commonly known as Trézéguet (Arabic: تريزيجيه), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt...
Trezeguet.note: Trézéguet has already given Egypt a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Trezeguet.noteZh: 他给Egypt展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Tyler Adams.name: Tyler Adams
Tyler Adams.summary: Tyler Shaan Adams (born February 14, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Premier League club Bournemouth and the United States national team.
Tyler Adams.note: Adams is a tempo player for United States. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Tyler Adams.noteZh: 他让United States在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Viktor Gyokeres.name: Viktor Gyokeres
Viktor Gyokeres.summary: Viktor Einar Gyökeres (Swedish: [ˈvɪ̌kːtɔr ˈjø̂ːkɛrɛs]; born 4 June 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Arsenal and the Sweden national team.
Viktor Gyokeres.note: Gyökeres has already given Sweden a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Viktor Gyokeres.noteZh: 他给Sweden展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Vinicius Junior.name: Vinicius Junior
Vinicius Junior.summary: Vinícius José Paixão de Oliveira Júnior (Brazilian Portuguese: [viˈni.sjuz ʒoˈzɛ pajˈʃɐ̃w̃ dʒi oliˈvej.ɾɐ ˈʒu.njoʁ]; born 12 July 2000), commonly known as Vinícius Júnior or Vini Jr., is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga...
Vinicius Junior.note: Júnior has given Brazil both the finish and the pass, including goals against Morocco, Haiti, and Scotland. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Vinicius Junior.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Brazil带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Virgil van Dijk.name: Virgil van Dijk
Virgil van Dijk.summary: Virgil van Dijk (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈvɪrdʑɪl vɑn ˈdɛik]; born 8 July 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for and captains both Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.
Virgil van Dijk.note: Dijk has already given Netherlands a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Virgil van Dijk.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Vitinha.name: Vitinha
Vitinha.summary: Vítor Machado Ferreira (born 13 February 2000), known as Vitinha (Portuguese pronunciation: [viˈtiɲɐ]), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.
Vitinha.note: Vitinha gives Portugal structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Vitinha.noteZh: 他给Portugal控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Vozinha.name: Vozinha
Vozinha.summary: Vozinha is a Cabo Verde goalkeeper from Chaves who gives the national team veteran command, shot stopping, and tournament experience.
Vozinha.note: Vozinha is the last voice in Cabo Verde's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Vozinha.noteZh: 他承担了Cabo Verde的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Weston McKennie.name: Weston McKennie
Weston McKennie.summary: Weston James Earl McKennie (born August 28, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays primarily as a midfielder for Serie A club Juventus and the United States national team.
Weston McKennie.note: McKennie has been one of United States's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
Weston McKennie.noteZh: 他是United States让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。

William Saliba.name: William Saliba
William Saliba.summary: William Alain André Gabriel Saliba (French: [wiljam saliba]; born 24 March 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Arsenal and the France national team.
William Saliba.note: Saliba is the calm that lets France play with so much attacking talent ahead of him. He wins duels without making the whole defense look hurried.
William Saliba.noteZh: 萨利巴的冷静让法国敢在身前摆出那么多进攻天才。他能赢下对抗，而不让整条防线显得慌张。

Yasin Ayari.name: Yasin Ayari
Yasin Ayari.summary: Yasin Ayari (Arabic: ياسين عباس عياري; born 6 October 2003) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Sweden national team.
Yasin Ayari.note: Ayari has been one of Sweden's real scoring stories, with goals against Tunisia. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Yasin Ayari.noteZh: 他已经是Sweden这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Yoane Wissa.name: Yoane Wissa
Yoane Wissa.summary: Yoane Wissa (born 3 September 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or left winger for Premier League club Newcastle United. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Yoane Wissa.note: Wissa gives DR Congo a scorer opponents now have to carry in their heads. His goals against Portugal and Uzbekistan make every loose ball feel heavier.
Yoane Wissa.noteZh: 他已经是DR Congo这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Zidane Iqbal.name: Zidane Iqbal
Zidane Iqbal.summary: Zidane Aamar Iqbal (Arabic: زيدان عمار إقبال; Urdu: زیدان عمار اقبال; born 27 April 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Utrecht. Born in England, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Zidane Iqbal.note: Iqbal matters for Iraq when possession reaches crowded areas. He is there to turn a small opening into a real choice.
Zidane Iqbal.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Iraq来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Ante Budimir.name: Ante Budimir
Ante Budimir.summary: Ante Budimir (Croatian pronunciation: [ǎːnte bûdimiːr]; born 22 July 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Osasuna. Born in Bosnia and Herzegovina, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Ante Budimir.note: Budimir has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Panama. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Ante Budimir.noteZh: 他已经为Croatia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Ardon Jashari.name: Ardon Jashari
Ardon Jashari.summary: Ardon Jashari (born 30 July 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club AC Milan and the Switzerland national team.
Ardon Jashari.note: Jashari stepped into the Colombia match to give Switzerland another calm midfielder. He keeps the ball moving when opponents squeeze Xhaka.
Ardon Jashari.noteZh: 贾沙里在对哥伦比亚时进入阵容，给瑞士增加一名冷静中场。当对手压缩扎卡时，他能让球继续流动。

Aurele Amenda.name: Aurele Amenda
Aurele Amenda.summary: Aurèle Florian Amenda (born 31 July 2003) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Switzerland national team.
Aurele Amenda.note: Amenda is centre-back depth for Switzerland's long tournament. He is there if fresh legs are needed without changing the team's passing habits.
Aurele Amenda.noteZh: 阿门达是瑞士漫长赛事中的中卫深度。如果球队需要新鲜体能但不想改变传球习惯，他就有价值。

Cedric Itten.name: Cedric Itten
Cedric Itten.summary: Cedric Jan Itten (born 27 December 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for German 3. Liga club Fortuna Düsseldorf and the Switzerland national team. He will join Bundesliga club Werder Bremen on 1 July 2026.
Cedric Itten.note: Itten is the alternate penalty-area target. Switzerland can use him when the final minutes need crosses, contact, and a forward who stays between centre-backs.
Cedric Itten.noteZh: 伊滕是瑞士的备用禁区目标。当最后阶段需要传中、对抗，以及站在中卫之间的前锋时，他有价值。

Christian Fassnacht.name: Christian Fassnacht
Christian Fassnacht.summary: Christian Andreas Fassnacht (born 11 November 1993) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Swiss Super League club Young Boys and the Switzerland national team.
Christian Fassnacht.note: Fassnacht is the disciplined runner Switzerland can add from midfield zones. He is not the headline, but he arrives where tired defenders stop tracking.
Christian Fassnacht.noteZh: 法斯纳赫特是瑞士可以从中场区域增加的纪律型跑动者。他不是头条人物，但会出现在疲劳防守者停止跟防的位置。

Dan Ndoye.name: Dan Ndoye
Dan Ndoye.summary: Dan Assane Ndoye (born 25 October 2000) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as winger for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the Switzerland national team.
Dan Ndoye.note: Ndoye has given Switzerland a direct outlet and scored right after halftime against Algeria. He stretches the field so Xhaka does not have to pass through traffic every time.
Dan Ndoye.noteZh: 恩多耶给瑞士提供直接出路，并在对阿尔及利亚时下半场刚开始进球。他拉开球场，让扎卡不必每次都从人群中传球。

Denis Zakaria.name: Denis Zakaria
Denis Zakaria.summary: Denis Lemi Zakaria Lako Lado (born 20 November 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Monaco, whom he captains, and the Switzerland national team.
Denis Zakaria.note: Zakaria has been used as both cover and stopper in Switzerland's shape. His range matters when the midfield gets pulled away from Xhaka.
Denis Zakaria.noteZh: 扎卡里亚在瑞士阵型中既当保护也当拦截者。当中场被拉离扎卡身边时，他的覆盖范围很重要。

Djibril Sow.name: Djibril Sow
Djibril Sow.summary: Mohameth Djibril Ibrahima Sow (born 6 February 1997) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Sevilla and the Switzerland national team.
Djibril Sow.note: Sow gives Switzerland a tidy bridge from recovery to attack. If the match becomes about second balls, he helps make the next pass cleaner.
Djibril Sow.noteZh: 索乌给瑞士提供从夺回球权到进攻的整洁桥梁。如果比赛变成第二落点争夺，他能让下一脚传球更干净。

Eray Coemert.name: Eray Coemert
Eray Coemert.summary: Eray Ervin Cömert (born 4 February 1998) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Spanish club Valencia and the Switzerland national team.
Eray Coemert.note: Cömert is sturdy centre-back cover. Switzerland would use him when the priority is clearing the box and restarting with simple passes.
Eray Coemert.noteZh: 居梅尔特是稳健的中卫深度。当首要任务是清理禁区并用简单传球重新开始时，瑞士会用到他。

Fabian Rieder.name: Fabian Rieder
Fabian Rieder.summary: Fabian Rieder (born 16 February 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for German Bundesliga club FC Augsburg and the Switzerland national team.
Fabian Rieder.note: Rieder started the Colombia stalemate as Switzerland looked for one clean action near the box. His set pieces and left foot can decide a tight match.
Fabian Rieder.noteZh: 里德在对哥伦比亚的僵局中首发，瑞士需要禁区附近一次干净处理。他的定位球和左脚能决定胶着比赛。

Gregor Kobel.name: Gregor Kobel
Gregor Kobel.summary: Gregor Kobel (born 6 December 1997) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Switzerland national team.
Gregor Kobel.note: Kobel has been Switzerland's goalkeeper through the knockout grind. His value is staying calm through long pressure spells, then giving Xhaka a playable restart.
Gregor Kobel.noteZh: 科贝尔是瑞士淘汰赛苦战中的门将。他的价值是在长时间压力中保持冷静，然后给扎卡一个可处理的重新开球。

Hassan Alhaydos.name: Hassan Alhaydos
Hassan Alhaydos.summary: Hassan Khalid Hassan Al-Haydos (Arabic: حَسَن خَالِد حَسَن الْهَيْدُوس; born 11 December 1990) is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a forward for and captains Qatar Stars League club Al Sadd and the Qatar national team.
Hassan Alhaydos.note: Al-Haydos is on the scoresheet for Qatar, with his goal coming against Bosnia and Herzegovina. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Hassan Alhaydos.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Kerim Alajbegovic.name: Kerim Alajbegovic
Kerim Alajbegovic.summary: Kerim Alajbegović (pronounced [kěrim alajbêːgoʋitɕ]; born 21 September 2007) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Austrian Bundesliga club Red Bull Salzburg.
Kerim Alajbegovic.note: Alajbegović already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Qatar. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Kerim Alajbegovic.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Lenny Joseph.name: Lenny Joseph
Lenny Joseph.summary: Lenny Joseph (born 12 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Hungarian club Ferencváros. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Lenny Joseph.note: Joseph gives Haiti a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Lenny Joseph.noteZh: 他是Haiti在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Luca Jaquez.name: Luca Jaquez
Luca Jaquez.summary: Luca Antony Jaquez (born 2 June 2003) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for German Bundesliga club VfB Stuttgart and the Switzerland national team.
Luca Jaquez.note: Jaquez has started in Switzerland's rotation and gives them simple defensive cover. His job is to hold the line, not to become the story.
Luca Jaquez.noteZh: 雅克斯已经在瑞士轮换中首发，提供简单可靠的防守深度。他的任务是守住防线，而不是成为故事本身。

Mahmoud Abunada.name: Mahmoud Abunada
Mahmoud Abunada.summary: Mahmud Ibrahim Abunada (Arabic: محمود إبراهيم أبو ندى; born 5 February 2000) is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Qatari Stars League club Al-Rayyan and the Qatar national team.
Mahmoud Abunada.note: Abunada has carried the keeper minutes for Qatar. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Mahmoud Abunada.noteZh: 他是Qatar防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Marvin Keller.name: Marvin Keller
Marvin Keller.summary: Marvin Keller (born 3 July 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Swiss club Young Boys and the Switzerland national team.
Marvin Keller.note: Keller is young goalkeeper cover behind Kobel and Mvogo. His tournament role is development depth, not the quarter-final spotlight.
Marvin Keller.noteZh: 凯勒是科贝尔和姆沃戈身后的年轻门将保障。他在这届赛事中的角色是培养型深度，而不是八强战焦点。

Michel Aebischer.name: Michel Aebischer
Michel Aebischer.summary: Michel Aebischer (born 6 January 1997) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie B club Pisa, on loan from Serie A club Bologna, and the Switzerland national team.
Michel Aebischer.note: Aebischer has been part of Switzerland's midfield control and late box threat. He keeps the shape connected while others make the more obvious runs.
Michel Aebischer.noteZh: 埃比舍是瑞士中场控制和后插上威胁的一部分。他让阵型保持连接，同时让其他人完成更明显的跑动。

Nico Elvedi.name: Nico Elvedi
Nico Elvedi.summary: Nico Elvedi (born 30 September 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the Switzerland national team.
Nico Elvedi.note: Elvedi is the reliable centre-back beside Akanji. He keeps Switzerland from overreacting when opponents try to turn pressure into chaos.
Nico Elvedi.noteZh: 埃尔韦迪是阿坎吉身边可靠的中卫。当对手试图把压力变成混乱时，他避免瑞士过度反应。

Noah Okafor.name: Noah Okafor
Noah Okafor.summary: Noah Arinzechukwu Okafor (born 24 May 2000) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Leeds United and the Switzerland national team.
Noah Okafor.note: Okafor is Switzerland's attacking burst from the bench. If Argentina push high, he is the player who can turn one clearance into a chase.
Noah Okafor.noteZh: 奥卡福是瑞士替补席上的进攻爆发力。如果阿根廷压得很高，他能把一次解围变成追逐。

Promise David.name: Promise David
Promise David.summary: Promise Oluwatobi Emmanuel David Akinpelu (born July 3, 2001) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a striker for Belgian Pro League club Union SG and the Canada national team.
Promise David.note: David has already given Canada a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Promise David.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Canada贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Remo Freuler.name: Remo Freuler
Remo Freuler.summary: Remo Marco Freuler (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈreː.mo ˈfrɔɪ.lər]; born 15 April 1992) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Bologna and the Switzerland national team.
Remo Freuler.note: Freuler is Switzerland's midfield order around Xhaka. He reads the loose ball, covers the next lane, and lets the team avoid panic passes.
Remo Freuler.noteZh: 弗罗伊勒是扎卡身边的瑞士中场秩序。他判断松散球，保护下一条线路，让球队避免慌乱传球。

Ricardo Rodriguez.name: Ricardo Rodriguez
Ricardo Rodriguez.summary: Ricardo Iván Rodríguez Araya (born 25 August 1992) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Real Betis and the Switzerland national team.
Ricardo Rodriguez.note: Rodriguez is Switzerland's experienced left-back base. In a quarter-final against Argentina, his calm around the box may matter more than any overlap.
Ricardo Rodriguez.noteZh: 罗德里格斯是瑞士经验丰富的左后卫底座。对阿根廷的八强战中，他在禁区周围的冷静可能比任何套边都重要。

Silvan Widmer.name: Silvan Widmer
Silvan Widmer.summary: Silvan Dominic Widmer (born 5 March 1993) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Bundesliga club Mainz 05, whom he captains, and the Switzerland national team.
Silvan Widmer.note: Widmer is seasoned right-back cover for Switzerland. He balances the overlap with the recovery run, which matters when opponents counter through stars.
Silvan Widmer.noteZh: 维德默是瑞士经验丰富的右后卫深度。他能平衡套边和回追，这在对手通过球星反击时很重要。

Yvon Mvogo.name: Yvon Mvogo
Yvon Mvogo.summary: Yvon Landry Mvogo Nganoma (born 6 June 1994) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in Cameroon, he plays for the Switzerland national team.
Yvon Mvogo.note: Mvogo is experienced goalkeeper cover. If Kobel is unavailable, Switzerland still have a keeper who can steady the box through pressure.
Yvon Mvogo.noteZh: 姆沃戈是经验门将保障。如果科贝尔无法出场，瑞士仍有一名能在压力下稳住禁区的门将。

Zeki Amdouni.name: Zeki Amdouni
Zeki Amdouni.summary: Mohamed Zeki Amdouni (born 4 December 2000) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for EFL Championship club Burnley and the Switzerland national team.
Zeki Amdouni.note: Amdouni is the clever forward link Switzerland can add if Embolo needs support. He drifts into pockets, combines once, then still threatens the finish.
Zeki Amdouni.noteZh: 阿姆杜尼是瑞士在恩博洛需要支援时可以加入的聪明锋线连接点。他会游到空当，配合一次，然后仍保持终结威胁。

Ali Ahmed.name: Ali Ahmed
Ali Ahmed.summary: Ali Ahmed (born October 10, 2000) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a wide midfielder or winger for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Canada national team.
Ali Ahmed.note: Ahmed is a tempo player for Canada. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Ali Ahmed.noteZh: 他让Canada在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Alistair Johnston.name: Alistair Johnston
Alistair Johnston.summary: Alistair William Johnston (born October 8, 1998) is a Canadian professional football player who plays as a right-back for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the Canada national team. Johnston began his senior career with Vaughan Azzurri.
Alistair Johnston.note: Johnston gives Canada one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Alistair Johnston.noteZh: 他是Canada无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Derek Cornelius.name: Derek Cornelius
Derek Cornelius.summary: Derek Austin Cornelius (born 25 November 1997) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Marseille and the Canada national team.
Derek Cornelius.note: Cornelius is in the quiet-work part of Canada's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Derek Cornelius.noteZh: 他是Canada主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Ismael Kone.name: Ismael Kone
Ismael Kone.summary: Ismaël Kenneth Jordan Koné (born June 16, 2002) is a professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo. Born in the Ivory Coast, he plays for the Canada national team.
Ismael Kone.note: Koné gives Canada a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Ismael Kone.noteZh: 他是Canada的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Jacob Shaffelburg.name: Jacob Shaffelburg
Jacob Shaffelburg.summary: Jacob Everett Shaffelburg (born November 26, 1999) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Los Angeles FC and the Canada national team.
Jacob Shaffelburg.note: Shaffelburg is the forward Canada can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Jacob Shaffelburg.noteZh: 他给Canada替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Joel Waterman.name: Joel Waterman
Joel Waterman.summary: Joel Robert Waterman (born January 24, 1996) is a Canadian soccer player who plays as a centre-back, right-back or defensive midfielder for Chicago Fire of Major League Soccer and the Canada national team.
Joel Waterman.note: Waterman gives Canada cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Joel Waterman.noteZh: 他是Canada后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jonathan Osorio.name: Jonathan Osorio
Jonathan Osorio.summary: Jonathan Osorio (born June 12, 1992) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Toronto FC, which he captains, and the Canada national team. Osorio holds the Toronto FC club record for most appearances.
Jonathan Osorio.note: Osorio gives Canada midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Jonathan Osorio.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Canada来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Liam Millar.name: Liam Millar
Liam Millar.summary: Liam Alan Millar (born September 27, 1999) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for Premier League club Hull City and the Canada national team.
Liam Millar.note: Millar gives Canada midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Liam Millar.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Canada来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Luc De Fougerolles.name: Luc De Fougerolles
Luc De Fougerolles.summary: Luc Rollet de Fougerolles (French pronunciation: [lyk d (ə) fuʒʁɔl]; born 12 October 2005) is a professional football player who plays as a defender for Belgian Pro League club Dender EH, on loan from Fulham.
Luc De Fougerolles.note: Fougerolles gives Canada one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Luc De Fougerolles.noteZh: 他是Canada无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Mathieu Choiniere.name: Mathieu Choiniere
Mathieu Choiniere.summary: Mathieu Choinière (born February 7, 1999) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder, defensive midfielder or right winger for Major League Soccer club Los Angeles FC and the Canada national team.
Mathieu Choiniere.note: Choinière is midfield insurance for Canada. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Mathieu Choiniere.noteZh: 他给Canada一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Maxime Crepeau.name: Maxime Crepeau
Maxime Crepeau.summary: Maxime Crépeau (born May 11, 1994) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Orlando City and the Canada national team.
Maxime Crepeau.note: Crépeau is the last voice in Canada's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Maxime Crepeau.noteZh: 他承担了Canada的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Moise Bombito.name: Moise Bombito
Moise Bombito.summary: Moïse Bombito Lumpungu (born March 30, 2000) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Nice and the Canada national team.
Moise Bombito.note: Bombito is defensive rotation for Canada. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Moise Bombito.noteZh: 他是Canada后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Niko Sigur.name: Niko Sigur
Niko Sigur.summary: Niko Kristian Sigur (born September 9, 2003) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder or right-back for HNL club Hajduk Split and the Canada national team.
Niko Sigur.note: Sigur is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Canada, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Niko Sigur.noteZh: 他给Canada提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Owen Goodman.name: Owen Goodman
Owen Goodman.summary: Owen Olamidayo Goodman (born 27 November 2003) is a British Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Crystal Palace. Born in England, he represents the Canada national team.
Owen Goodman.note: Goodman is goalkeeper cover for Canada. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Owen Goodman.noteZh: 他是Canada门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Richie Laryea.name: Richie Laryea
Richie Laryea.summary: Richmond Mamah Laryea ( La-RAY-a; Ga: LAH-yee; born January 7, 1995) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a right-back or midfielder for Major League Soccer club Toronto and the Canada national team.
Richie Laryea.note: Laryea gives Canada one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Richie Laryea.noteZh: 他是Canada无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Tajon Buchanan.name: Tajon Buchanan
Tajon Buchanan.summary: Tajon Trevor Buchanan (born February 8, 1999) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays for La Liga club Villarreal and the Canada national team.
Tajon Buchanan.note: Buchanan has been part of Canada's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Tajon Buchanan.noteZh: 他在Canada体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Tani Oluwaseyi.name: Tani Oluwaseyi
Tani Oluwaseyi.summary: Tanitoluwa Oluwatimilehin Oluwaseyi (born May 15, 2000) is a professional soccer player who plays as a forward for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in Nigeria, he represents the Canada national team.
Tani Oluwaseyi.note: Oluwaseyi has been part of Canada's front-line plan. He stretches defenders first, then looks for the touch that turns pressure into a chance.
Tani Oluwaseyi.noteZh: 他是Canada前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Alfie Jones.name: Alfie Jones
Alfie Jones.summary: Alfie Charles Jones (born 7 October 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for EFL Championship club Middlesbrough. Born in England, he plays for the Canada national team.
Alfie Jones.note: Jones is back-line insurance for Canada. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Alfie Jones.noteZh: 他给Canada那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Dayne St. Clair.name: Dayne St. Clair
Dayne St. Clair.summary: Dayne Tristan St. Clair (born May 9, 1997) is a Canadian professional soccer player who currently plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami and the Canada national team.
Dayne St. Clair.note: Clair gives Canada a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Dayne St. Clair.noteZh: 他在Canada首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Marcelo Flores.name: Marcelo Flores
Marcelo Flores.summary: Marcelo Flores Dorrell (born 1 October 2003) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Liga MX club Tigres UANL and the Canada national team.
Marcelo Flores.note: Flores gives Canada midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Marcelo Flores.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Canada来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Wilson Isidor.name: Wilson Isidor
Wilson Isidor.summary: Wilson Isidor (born 27 August 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in France, he represents the Haiti national team.
Wilson Isidor.note: Isidor has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Morocco. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Wilson Isidor.noteZh: 他已经为Haiti进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Yassine Bounou.name: Yassine Bounou
Yassine Bounou.summary: Yassine Bounou (born 5 April 1991), also known mononymously as Bono, is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Saudi Pro League club Al Hilal and the Morocco national team. Bono began his youth career in Morocco, playing for Wydad AC.
Yassine Bounou.note: Bounou remains Morocco's calmest presence behind the block. Even after the own goal against Haiti, his value is how little panic reaches the defenders in front of him.
Yassine Bounou.noteZh: 布努依然是摩洛哥防线身后最冷静的存在。即使对海地有过乌龙，他的价值仍是让身前后卫很少感到慌乱。

Amar Dedic.name: Amar Dedic
Amar Dedic.summary: Amar Dedić (pronounced [ǎmar dêːditɕ]; born 18 August 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Primeira Liga club Benfica. Born in Austria, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Amar Dedic.note: Dedić has been part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Amar Dedic.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Amar Memic.name: Amar Memic
Amar Memic.summary: Amar Memić (pronounced [ǎmar měmitɕ]; born 20 January 2001) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Czech First League club Viktoria Plzeň and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Amar Memic.note: Memić gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Amar Memic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Amir Hadziahmetovic.name: Amir Hadziahmetovic
Amir Hadziahmetovic.summary: Amir Hadžiahmetović (pronounced [âːmir xadʒiaxmêːtoʋitɕ]; born 8 March 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Hull City, on loan from Beşiktaş.
Amir Hadziahmetovic.note: Hadžiahmetović gives Bosnia and Herzegovina midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Amir Hadziahmetovic.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Arjan Malic.name: Arjan Malic
Arjan Malic.summary: Arjan Malić (pronounced [ǎrjan mâːlitɕ]; born 28 August 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Austrian Bundesliga club Sturm Graz. Born in Slovenia, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Arjan Malic.note: Malić is defensive cover for Bosnia and Herzegovina's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Arjan Malic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Armin Gigovic.name: Armin Gigovic
Armin Gigovic.summary: Armin Gigović (pronounced [ǎrmin ɡîːgoʋitɕ]; born 6 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swiss Super League club Young Boys. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Armin Gigovic.note: Gigović gives Bosnia and Herzegovina midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Armin Gigovic.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Benjamin Tahirovic.name: Benjamin Tahirovic
Benjamin Tahirovic.summary: Benjamin Tahirović (pronounced [běɲamin tâːxiroʋitɕ]; born 3 March 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Danish Superliga club Brøndby. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Benjamin Tahirovic.note: Tahirović gives Bosnia and Herzegovina midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Benjamin Tahirovic.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Dennis Hadzikadunic.name: Dennis Hadzikadunic
Dennis Hadzikadunic.summary: Dennis Hadžikadunić (pronounced [dêːnis xǎdʒikadunitɕ]; born 9 July 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie B club Sampdoria, on loan from Rostov. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Dennis Hadzikadunic.note: Hadžikadunić has supplied one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Dennis Hadzikadunic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Bosnia and Herzegovina创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Dzenis Burnic.name: Dzenis Burnic
Dzenis Burnic.summary: Dženis Burnić (pronounced [dʒêːnis bǔrnitɕ]; born 22 May 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for 2. Bundesliga club Karlsruher SC. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Dzenis Burnic.note: Burnić is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Bosnia and Herzegovina, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Dzenis Burnic.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Ermedin Demirovic.name: Ermedin Demirovic
Ermedin Demirovic.summary: Ermedin Demirović (pronounced [ermědin děmiroʋitɕ]; born 25 March 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club VfB Stuttgart. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Ermedin Demirovic.note: Demirović is part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's attacking shape, even when he is not the finisher. His movement decides who gets the next clear touch.
Ermedin Demirovic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Haris Tabakovic.name: Haris Tabakovic
Haris Tabakovic.summary: Haris Tabaković (pronounced [xâːris tǎbakoʋitɕ]; born 20 June 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach, on loan from TSG Hoffenheim.
Haris Tabakovic.club: Borussia Mönchengladbach (on loan from TSG Hoffenheim)
Haris Tabakovic.note: Tabaković is attacking depth for Bosnia and Herzegovina. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Haris Tabakovic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Ivan Basic.name: Ivan Basic
Ivan Basic.summary: Ivan Bašić (pronounced [ǐʋan bǎʃitɕ]; born 30 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Kazakhstan Premier League club Astana. Born in Croatia, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Ivan Basic.note: Bašić has one tournament assist in the bank for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Ivan Basic.noteZh: 他已经帮Bosnia and Herzegovina制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Ivan Sunjic.name: Ivan Sunjic
Ivan Sunjic.summary: Ivan Šunjić (born 9 October 1996) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Cyprus First Division club Pafos and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Ivan Sunjic.note: Šunjić is a tempo player for Bosnia and Herzegovina. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Ivan Sunjic.noteZh: 他让Bosnia and Herzegovina在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Martin Zlomislic.name: Martin Zlomislic
Martin Zlomislic.summary: Martin Zlomislić (born 16 August 1998) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Azerbaijan Premier League club Qarabağ FK and Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Martin Zlomislic.note: Zlomislić is goalkeeper cover for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Martin Zlomislic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Mladen Jurkas.name: Mladen Jurkas
Mladen Jurkas.summary: Mladen Jurkas (born 7 October 2007) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bosnian Premier League club Borac Banja Luka and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Mladen Jurkas.note: Jurkas sits behind the starter for Bosnia and Herzegovina, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Mladen Jurkas.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Nihad Mujakic.name: Nihad Mujakic
Nihad Mujakic.summary: Nihad Mujakić (pronounced [nǐxad mǔjakitɕ]; born 15 April 1998) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Gaziantep, on loan from Partizan, and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Nihad Mujakic.note: Mujakić gives Bosnia and Herzegovina cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Nihad Mujakic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Nikola Katic.name: Nikola Katic
Nikola Katic.summary: Nikola Katić (pronounced [nǐkola kâtitɕ]; born 10 October 1996) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Schalke 04 and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Nikola Katic.note: Katić is in the quiet-work part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Nikola Katic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Nikola Vasilj.name: Nikola Vasilj
Nikola Vasilj.summary: Nikola Vasilj (pronounced [nǐkola ʋǎsiʎ]; born 2 December 1995) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for 2. Bundesliga club FC St. Pauli and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Nikola Vasilj.note: Vasilj is the last voice in Bosnia and Herzegovina's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Nikola Vasilj.noteZh: 他承担了Bosnia and Herzegovina的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Samed Bazdar.note: Baždar gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Samed Bazdar.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Stjepan Radeljic.summary: Stjepan Radeljić (pronounced [stjêpan rǎdeʎitɕ]; born 5 September 1997) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Croatian Football League club Rijeka and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.

Stjepan Radeljic.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Tarik Muharemovic.note: Muharemović has been part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Tarik Muharemovic.noteZh: 他在Bosnia and Herzegovina体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Abdulaziz Hatem.name: Abdulaziz Hatem
Abdulaziz Hatem.summary: Abdulaziz Hatem Mohammed Abdullah (Arabic: عَبْد الْعَزِيز حَاتِم مُحَمَّد عَبْد الله; born 1 January 1990) is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Al Rayyan and captains the Qatar national team.
Abdulaziz Hatem.note: Hatem is midfield insurance for Qatar. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Abdulaziz Hatem.noteZh: 他给Qatar一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Ahmed Alaaeldin.name: Ahmed Alaaeldin
Ahmed Alaaeldin.summary: Ahmed Alaaeldin Abdelmotaal (Arabic: أحمد علاء الدين عبد المتعال; born 31 January 1993), simply known as Ahmed Alaaeldin or Alaa, is a professional footballer who plays for Al-Rayyan. Born in Egypt, he plays for the Qatar national team.
Ahmed Alaaeldin.note: Alaaeldin is attacking depth for Qatar. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Ahmed Alaaeldin.noteZh: 他是Qatar前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Edmilson Junior.noteZh: 他已经参与了Qatar的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Meshaal Barsham.noteZh: 他是Qatar的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。
