Ayoube Amaimouni.noteZh: 阿迈穆尼是摩洛哥比赛后段的年轻边路跑动点。如果球队需要新鲜体能，他的任务就是追逐空当球，让边后卫再防一次冲刺。

Ayyoub Bouaddi.name: Ayyoub Bouaddi
Ayyoub Bouaddi.summary: Ayyoub Bouaddi (Arabic: أيوب بوعدي, Berber languages: ⴰⵢⵢⵓⴱ ⴱⵓⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉ; born 2 October 2007) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in France, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Ayyoub Bouaddi.note: Bouaddi has been trusted in Morocco's midfield despite his age. He keeps passes moving beside the more adventurous runners and helps the team breathe under pressure.
Ayyoub Bouaddi.noteZh: 布阿迪虽然年轻，却已经被摩洛哥信任在中场使用。他在更冒险的跑动者身边保持传球流动，也帮助球队在压力下喘口气。

Azzedine Ounahi.name: Azzedine Ounahi
Azzedine Ounahi.summary: Azzedine Ounahi (Arabic: عز الدين أوناحي, pronounced [ʕiz ʔad.di:n u:na:ħi:]; born 19 April 2000) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Segunda División club Girona and the Morocco national team.
Azzedine Ounahi.note: Ounahi turned the Canada tie into his match with two second-half goals. His value is the glide from midfield that arrives as a shot before defenders quite notice him.
Azzedine Ounahi.noteZh: 乌纳希用下半场两个进球把对加拿大的比赛变成了自己的比赛。他的价值在于从中场滑进禁区，在防守者完全察觉前完成射门。

Chadi Riad.name: Chadi Riad
Chadi Riad.summary: Chadi Riad Dnanou (Arabic: شادي رياض دنانو; born 17 June 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Crystal Palace. Born in Spain, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Chadi Riad.note: Riad gives Morocco a left-footed defender who can do more than clear the ball. His assist against Haiti showed why his first pass can start attacks, not just end pressure.
Chadi Riad.noteZh: 里亚德让摩洛哥拥有一名不只会解围的左脚中卫。他对海地的助攻说明，他的第一脚传球能发动进攻，而不只是结束压力。

Chemsdine Talbi.name: Chemsdine Talbi
Chemsdine Talbi.summary: Chemsdine Talbi (Arabic: شَمْس الدِّين الطَّالِبِيّ; born 9 May 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Chemsdine Talbi.note: Talbi is the young winger Morocco can use when the match needs direct speed. His late assist against the Netherlands showed he can still change a game from the bench.
Chemsdine Talbi.noteZh: 塔尔比是摩洛哥需要直接速度时可以使用的年轻边锋。他对荷兰的后段助攻说明，他替补登场仍能改变比赛。

Gessime Yassine.name: Gessime Yassine
Gessime Yassine.summary: Gessime Ben Youssef Mustapha Yassine (born 22 November 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Gessime Yassine.note: Yassine already has a late World Cup goal in this run. He is a fresh wide runner who makes sense when Morocco want one more carry into open grass.
Gessime Yassine.noteZh: 亚辛在这段世界杯征程中已经有过后段进球。他是新鲜的边路跑动点，适合摩洛哥还想再向开阔空间推进时使用。

Issa Diop.name: Issa Diop
Issa Diop.summary: Issa Diop is a Morocco centre-back who plays for Fulham and adds aerial defending, physical duels, and back-line depth to the national team.
Issa Diop.note: Diop has been part of Morocco's main defensive spine and even supplied the late answer against the Netherlands. His card is about size, box defending, and set-piece danger.
Issa Diop.noteZh: 迪奥普是摩洛哥主要防线骨架的一部分，还在对荷兰时打进后段回应球。他的看点是身材、禁区防守和定位球威胁。

Marwane Saadane.name: Marwane Saadane
Marwane Saadane.summary: Marwane Saâdane (Arabic: مروان سعدان; born 17 January 1992) is a Moroccan professional football player who plays for Saudi Professional League club Al-Fateh and the Morocco national team.
Marwane Saadane.note: Saadane is protection more than a headline player. Morocco can use him if the midfield needs another body to win contact and close the match down.
Marwane Saadane.noteZh: 萨达内更像保护型球员，而不是焦点人物。如果摩洛哥中场需要多一个身体对抗点来收住比赛，就可以使用他。

Noussair Mazraoui.name: Noussair Mazraoui
Noussair Mazraoui.summary: Noussair Mazraoui (Arabic: نُصَيْر مَزرَاوِيّ; born 14 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Manchester United and the Morocco national team.
Noussair Mazraoui.note: Mazraoui gives Morocco a calmer left-back base behind the Hakimi and Brahim side of the attack. He helps the team build without losing its defensive shape.
Noussair Mazraoui.noteZh: 马兹拉维在哈基米和布拉欣主导的进攻侧身后，给摩洛哥提供更冷静的左后卫底座。他帮助球队组织，同时不丢防守形状。

Redouane Halhal.name: Redouane Halhal
Redouane Halhal.summary: Redouane Halhal (Arabic: رضوان حلحل; born 5 March 2003) is a footballer who plays as a defender for Belgian club Mechelen. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Redouane Halhal.note: Halhal has stepped into knockout minutes at centre-back. His job is simple and important: win the first contact and keep Morocco from getting stretched.
Redouane Halhal.noteZh: 哈尔哈尔已经在淘汰赛中进入中卫轮换。他的任务简单但重要：赢下第一下对抗，避免摩洛哥阵型被拉开。

Sofyan Amrabat.name: Sofyan Amrabat
Sofyan Amrabat.summary: Sofyan Amrabat (Arabic: سفيان أمرابط, Berber languages: ⵙⵓⴼⵢⴰⵏ ⴰⵎⵕⴰⴱⵟ; born 21 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Real Betis, on loan from Süper Lig side Fenerbahçe, and the Morocco national team.
Sofyan Amrabat.note: Amrabat is Morocco's closing midfielder. He reads the counter before it becomes dangerous and gives the more creative players permission to take risks.
Sofyan Amrabat.noteZh: 阿姆拉巴特是摩洛哥收口的中场。他会在反击真正危险前读到它，也让更有创造力的队友敢于冒险。

Youssef Belammari.name: Youssef Belammari
Youssef Belammari.summary: Youssef Belammari (Arabic: يُوسُف بَلْعُمَرِيّ; born 20 September 1998) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Morocco national team.
Youssef Belammari.note: Belammari is left-side cover for a Morocco team that changes its full-back mix by opponent. He keeps the flank honest when the match asks for safer minutes.
Youssef Belammari.noteZh: 贝拉马里是摩洛哥左侧的防守深度，球队会根据对手调整边后卫组合。当比赛需要更安全的时间段时，他能守住边路。

Bilal El Khannouss.name: Bilal El Khannouss
Bilal El Khannouss.summary: Bilal El Khannouss (Arabic: بلال الخنوس; born 10 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club VfB Stuttgart and the Morocco national team.
Bilal El Khannouss.note: El Khannouss has been Morocco's left-side link in the main XI. He receives in pockets, keeps the next pass alive, and helps Brahim avoid carrying the whole creative load.
Bilal El Khannouss.noteZh: 埃尔哈努斯是摩洛哥主力阵容中的左侧连接点。他在空当接球，让下一脚传递继续，也帮助布拉欣不用承担全部创造任务。

Munir El Kajoui.name: Munir El Kajoui
Munir El Kajoui.summary: Munir El Kajoui (Arabic: منير الكجوي; born 10 May 1989), known as Munir, is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Botola Pro club RS Berkane, whom he captains, and the Morocco national team.
Munir El Kajoui.note: Munir is veteran insurance behind Bounou. His card matters if Morocco need a keeper who has already lived through tense international nights.
Munir El Kajoui.noteZh: 穆尼尔是布努身后的老将保险。如果摩洛哥需要一名经历过紧张国家队夜晚的门将，他的价值就会出现。

Neil El Aynaoui.name: Neil El Aynaoui
Neil El Aynaoui.summary: Neil Yoni El Aynaoui (Arabic: نائل العيناوي; born 2 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Roma and the Morocco national team.
Neil El Aynaoui.note: El Aynaoui has been a steady midfield starter in Morocco's run. He gives the team carrying power and second-ball strength beside Bouaddi.
Neil El Aynaoui.noteZh: 埃尔艾纳维是摩洛哥这段征程中的稳定首发中场。他在布阿迪身边提供带球推进和第二落点力量。

Samir El Mourabet.name: Samir El Mourabet
Samir El Mourabet.summary: Samir El Mourabet (Arabic: سمير المرابط; born 6 October 2005) is a professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Samir El Mourabet.note: El Mourabet is young midfield depth for the harder minutes. Morocco would use him when fresh legs and simple ball-winning matter more than invention.
Samir El Mourabet.noteZh: 埃尔穆拉贝特是摩洛哥年轻的中场深度，适合更艰难的时间段。当新鲜体能和简单抢球比创造力更重要时，他就有意义。

Soufiane Rahimi.name: Soufiane Rahimi
Soufiane Rahimi.summary: Soufiane Rahimi (Arabic: سُفْيَان رَحِيمِيّ; born 2 June 1996) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE Pro League club Al Ain and the Morocco national team.
Soufiane Rahimi.note: Rahimi has already rewarded Morocco from late attacking situations, scoring against Haiti and Canada. He is the runner who attacks tired spaces after the starters have tilted the game.
Soufiane Rahimi.noteZh: 拉希米已经在比赛后段回报了摩洛哥，对海地和加拿大都有进球。他是首发球员把比赛倾斜后，继续冲击疲劳空间的跑动者。

Zakaria El Ouahdi.name: Zakaria El Ouahdi
Zakaria El Ouahdi.summary: Zakaria El Ouahdi (Moroccan Arabic: زكرياء الواحدي; born 31 December 2001), is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or a right-back for Belgian Pro League club Genk. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Zakaria El Ouahdi.note: El Ouahdi is the energetic right-back behind Hakimi. His path is late minutes, overlap runs, and enough recovery speed to keep the flank from breaking open.
Zakaria El Ouahdi.noteZh: 埃尔瓦赫迪是哈基米身后的活力型右后卫。他的路径是后段出场、套边跑动，以及用回追速度避免边路被打开。

Alexandre Pierre.name: Alexandre Pierre
Alexandre Pierre.summary: Alexandre Pierre (born 25 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 2 club Sochaux. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Alexandre Pierre.note: Pierre gives Haiti a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Alexandre Pierre.noteZh: 他在Haiti首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Carl Sainte.name: Carl Sainte
Carl Sainte.summary: Carl Fred Sainté (born 9 August 2002) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for USL Championship club El Paso Locomotive and the Haiti national team.
Carl Sainte.note: Sainté gives Haiti midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Carl Sainte.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Haiti来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Carlens Arcus.name: Carlens Arcus
Carlens Arcus.summary: Carlens Arcus (born 28 June 1996) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Angers and the Haiti national team.
Carlens Arcus.note: Arcus is defensive rotation for Haiti. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Carlens Arcus.noteZh: 他给Haiti那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Danley Jean Jacques.name: Danley Jean Jacques
Danley Jean Jacques.summary: Danley Jean Jacques (born 20 May 2000) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union and the Haiti national team. He usually plays as a central midfielder or defensive midfielder.
Danley Jean Jacques.note: Jacques is a tempo player for Haiti. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Danley Jean Jacques.noteZh: 他让Haiti在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Derrick Etienne.name: Derrick Etienne
Derrick Etienne.summary: Derrick Etienne Jr. is a Haiti winger who plays for Toronto FC and gives the national team direct carrying, left-side width, and transition speed.
Derrick Etienne.note: Jr is the forward Haiti can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Derrick Etienne.noteZh: 他给Haiti替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Dominique Simon.name: Dominique Simon
Dominique Simon.summary: Dominique Célidor Simon (born 29 July 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Slovak First Football League club Tatran Prešov. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Dominique Simon.note: Simon is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Haiti, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Dominique Simon.noteZh: 他给Haiti提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Garven Metusala.name: Garven Metusala
Garven Metusala.summary: Garven-Michée Metusala (born 31 December 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for USL Championship club Colorado Springs Switchbacks. Born in Canada, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Garven Metusala.note: Metusala is defensive cover for Haiti's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Garven Metusala.noteZh: 他是Haiti在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Hannes Delcroix.name: Hannes Delcroix
Hannes Delcroix.summary: Hannes Piterson Delcroix (born 28 February 1999) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Swiss Super League club Lugano and the Haiti national team.
Hannes Delcroix.note: Delcroix has been part of Haiti's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Hannes Delcroix.noteZh: 他给Haiti后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Jean-Kevin Duverne.name: Jean-Kevin Duverne
Jean-Kevin Duverne.summary: Jean-Kévin Duverne (born 12 July 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Belgian Pro League club Gent on loan from French club Nantes. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Jean-Kevin Duverne.note: Duverne has supplied one of Haiti's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Jean-Kevin Duverne.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Haiti创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Johny Placide.name: Johny Placide
Johny Placide.summary: Johny Placide (born 29 January 1988) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. Born in France, he plays for and captains the Haiti national team since 2011.
Johny Placide.note: Placide gives Haiti the calmest first pass from the back. Watch how quickly he turns a save or claim into a reset.
Johny Placide.noteZh: 他是Haiti这段征程中的门将。价值在于让禁区保持冷静，并让下一次进攻能干净开始。

Josue Casimir.name: Josue Casimir
Josue Casimir.summary: Josué Casimir (born 24 September 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back, right wing-back or striker for French Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in Guadeloupe, he represents the Haiti national team.
Josue Casimir.note: Casimir gives Haiti defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Josue Casimir.noteZh: 他是Haiti艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Josue Duverger.name: Josue Duverger
Josue Duverger.summary: Josué Duverger (born 27 April 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Rheinlandliga club Cosmos Koblenz. Born in Canada, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Josue Duverger.note: Duverger sits behind the starter for Haiti, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Josue Duverger.noteZh: 他给Haiti保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Keeto Thermoncy.name: Keeto Thermoncy
Keeto Thermoncy.summary: Keeto Thermoncy (born 29 March 2006) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the U21 team of Young Boys in the Promotion League. Born in Switzerland, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Keeto Thermoncy.note: Thermoncy gives Haiti cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Keeto Thermoncy.noteZh: 他是Haiti后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Louicius Deedson.name: Louicius Deedson
Louicius Deedson.summary: Don Deedson Louicius (born 11 February 2001), commonly known as Louicius Deedson, is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for MLS club FC Dallas and the Haiti national team.
Louicius Deedson.note: Deedson is an attacking change-up for Haiti. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Louicius Deedson.noteZh: 他是Haiti的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Markhus Lacroix.name: Markhus Lacroix
Markhus Lacroix.summary: Markhus "Duke" Lacroix (born 14 October 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Colorado Springs Switchbacks in the USL Championship. Born in the United States, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Markhus Lacroix.note: Lacroix gives Haiti cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Markhus Lacroix.noteZh: 他是Haiti后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Martin Experience.name: Martin Experience
Martin Experience.summary: Martin Yves Expérience (born 9 March 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for French Ligue 2 club Nancy. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Martin Experience.note: Expérience is in the quiet-work part of Haiti's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Martin Experience.noteZh: 他是Haiti主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Ricardo Ade.name: Ricardo Ade
Ricardo Ade.summary: Ricardo Adé Kat (born 21 May 1990) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ecuadorian club L.D.U. Quito and the Haiti national team.
Ricardo Ade.note: Adé has been part of Haiti's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Ricardo Ade.noteZh: 他在Haiti体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Ruben Providence.name: Ruben Providence
Ruben Providence.summary: Ruben Fritzner Providence (born 7 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Dutch Eerste Divisie club Almere City. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Ruben Providence.note: Providence is part of Haiti's attacking shape, even when he is not the finisher. His movement decides who gets the next clear touch.
Ruben Providence.noteZh: 他是Haiti在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Wilguens Paugain.name: Wilguens Paugain
Wilguens Paugain.summary: Wilguens Raphael Polynice Paugain (born 24 August 2001) is a Haitian professional football player who plays as right-back for Zulte Waregem. A former youth international for France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Wilguens Paugain.note: Paugain is defensive cover for Haiti's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Wilguens Paugain.noteZh: 他是Haiti在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Woodensky Pierre.name: Woodensky Pierre
Woodensky Pierre.summary: Olivier Woodensky Pierre (born 30 December 2004) is a Haitian footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue Haïtienne team Violette AC and the Haiti national team.
Woodensky Pierre.note: Pierre gives Haiti a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Woodensky Pierre.noteZh: 他是Haiti的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Yassin Fortune.name: Yassin Fortune
Yassin Fortune.summary: Yassin Enzo Fortuné (born 30 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga Portugal 2 club Vizela. Born in France, he represents the Haiti national team.
Yassin Fortune.note: Fortuné gives Haiti a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Yassin Fortune.noteZh: 他是Haiti的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Alexandr Sojka.name: Alexandr Sojka
Alexandr Sojka.summary: Alexandr Sojka (born 2 April 2003) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Viktoria Plzeň and the Czech Republic national team.
Alexandr Sojka.note: Sojka has one tournament assist in the bank for Czechia. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Alexandr Sojka.noteZh: 他已经帮Czechia制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

David Doudera.name: David Doudera
David Doudera.summary: David Douděra (born 31 May 1998) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a right midfielder for Czech First League side Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
David Doudera.note: Douděra gives Czechia midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
David Doudera.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Czechia来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

David Jurasek.name: David Jurasek
David Jurasek.summary: David Jurásek (born 7 August 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Czech First League club Slavia Prague. He also represents the Czech Republic national team.
David Jurasek.note: Jurásek is defensive cover for Czechia's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
David Jurasek.noteZh: 他是Czechia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

David Zima.name: David Zima
David Zima.summary: David Zima (born 8 November 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defender for Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
David Zima.note: Zima is defensive cover for Czechia's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
David Zima.noteZh: 他是Czechia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Denis Visinsky.name: Denis Visinsky
Denis Visinsky.summary: Denis Višinský (born 21 March 2003) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a winger for Viktoria Plzeň and the Czech Republic national team.
Denis Visinsky.note: Višinský gives Czechia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Denis Visinsky.noteZh: 他是Czechia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Hugo Sochurek.name: Hugo Sochurek
Hugo Sochurek.summary: Hugo Sochůrek is a Czechia central midfielder from Sparta Prague who adds youthful passing range, pressure resistance, and long-term upside to the squad.
Hugo Sochurek.note: Sochůrek is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Czechia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.

Roshon van Eijma.name: Roshon van Eijma
Roshon van Eijma.summary: Róshón Felix Romar Jordan van Eijma (born 9 June 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eerste Divisie club RKC Waalwijk. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Roshon van Eijma.note: Eijma is defensive cover for Curaçao's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Roshon van Eijma.noteZh: 他是Curaçao在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Alban Lafont.name: Alban Lafont
Alban Lafont.summary: Alban-Marc Lafont (born 23 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as goalkeeper for Ligue 2 club Nantes. Born in Burkina Faso and raised in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Alban Lafont.note: Lafont sits behind the starter for Côte d'Ivoire, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Alban Lafont.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Ange-Yoan Bonny.name: Ange-Yoan Bonny
Ange-Yoan Bonny.summary: Ange-Yoan Bonny is a Côte d'Ivoire centre-forward at Inter Milan who gives the national team hold-up play, box presence, and power running.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.note: Bonny has been part of how Côte d'Ivoire turns territory into chances. Watch the run before the pass, not only the shot after it.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Bazoumana Toure.name: Bazoumana Toure
Bazoumana Toure.summary: Bazoumana Touré (born 2 March 2006) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Ivory Coast national team.
Bazoumana Toure.note: Touré is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Côte d'Ivoire, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Bazoumana Toure.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Christ Inao Oulai.name: Christ Inao Oulai
Christ Inao Oulai.summary: Christ Ravynel Inao Oulaï (born 6 April 2006) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Trabzonspor and the Ivory Coast national team.
Christ Inao Oulai.note: Oulaï gives Côte d'Ivoire midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Christ Inao Oulai.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Côte d'Ivoire来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Christopher Operi.name: Christopher Operi
Christopher Operi.summary: Christopher Téa Opéri (born 29 April 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir and the Ivory Coast national team.
Christopher Operi.note: Opéri is back-line insurance for Côte d'Ivoire. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Christopher Operi.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Elye Wahi.name: Elye Wahi
Elye Wahi.summary: Sepe Elye Delmas Wahi (born 2 January 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Nice, on loan from Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Elye Wahi.note: Wahi is attacking depth for Côte d'Ivoire. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Elye Wahi.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Emmanuel Agbadou.name: Emmanuel Agbadou
Emmanuel Agbadou.summary: Badobre Emmanuel Elysee Djedje Agbadou (born 17 June 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Beşiktaş and the Ivory Coast national team.
Emmanuel Agbadou.note: Agbadou is in the quiet-work part of Côte d'Ivoire's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Emmanuel Agbadou.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Evan Ndicka.name: Evan Ndicka
Evan Ndicka.summary: Obite Evan Ndicka (born 20 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Roma. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Evan Ndicka.note: Ndicka is the kind of defender Côte d'Ivoire can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Evan Ndicka.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Ghislain Konan.name: Ghislain Konan
Ghislain Konan.summary: Ghislain N'Clomande Konan (born 27 December 1995) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Primeira Liga club Gil Vicente and the Ivory Coast national team.
Ghislain Konan.note: Konan gives Côte d'Ivoire one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Ghislain Konan.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Guela Doue.name: Guela Doue
Guela Doue.summary: Guéla Maho Lewis Doué (born 17 October 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Guela Doue.note: Doué is in the quiet-work part of Côte d'Ivoire's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Guela Doue.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Ibrahim Sangare.name: Ibrahim Sangare
Ibrahim Sangare.summary: Ibrahim Sangaré (born 2 December 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the Ivory Coast national team.
Ibrahim Sangare.note: Sangaré has supplied one of Côte d'Ivoire's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ibrahim Sangare.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Côte d'Ivoire创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Jean Michael Seri.name: Jean Michael Seri
Jean Michael Seri.summary: Jean Michaël Seri (born 19 July 1991) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Slovenian PrvaLiga club Maribor and the Ivory Coast national team.
Jean Michael Seri.note: Seri gives Côte d'Ivoire a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Jean Michael Seri.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Mohamed Kone.name: Mohamed Kone
Mohamed Kone.summary: Mohamed Koné (born 7 March 2002) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Belgian club Charleroi and the Ivory Coast national team.
Mohamed Kone.note: Koné is goalkeeper cover for Côte d'Ivoire. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Mohamed Kone.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Nicolas Pepe.name: Nicolas Pepe
Nicolas Pepe.summary: Nicolas Pépé (born 29 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or forward for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Nicolas Pepe.note: Pépé has given Côte d'Ivoire both the finish and the pass, including goals against Curaçao. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Nicolas Pepe.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了Côte d'Ivoire的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Odilon Kossounou.name: Odilon Kossounou
Odilon Kossounou.summary: Kouakou Odilon Dorgeless Kossounou ([ɔdilɔ̃ kɔsunu]; born 4 January 2001), better known as Odilon Kossounou, is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Atalanta and the Ivory Coast national team.
Odilon Kossounou.note: Kossounou has been part of Côte d'Ivoire's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Odilon Kossounou.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Oumar Diakite.name: Oumar Diakite
Oumar Diakite.summary: Oumar Diakité (born 20 December 2003) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Belgian Pro League club Cercle Brugge, on loan from Ligue 2 club Reims, and the Ivory Coast national team.
Oumar Diakite.note: Diakité gives Côte d'Ivoire a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Oumar Diakite.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ousmane Diomande.name: Ousmane Diomande
Ousmane Diomande.summary: Ousmane Diomande (born 4 December 2003) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Ivory Coast national team.
Ousmane Diomande.note: Diomande is defensive cover for Côte d'Ivoire's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Ousmane Diomande.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Parfait Guiagon.name: Parfait Guiagon
Parfait Guiagon.summary: Parfait Guiagon is a Côte d'Ivoire left winger at Charleroi who gives the national team tight-space dribbling, left-side creativity, and quick combinations.
Parfait Guiagon.note: Guiagon gives Côte d'Ivoire a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Parfait Guiagon.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Seko Fofana.name: Seko Fofana
Seko Fofana.summary: Seko Mohamed Fofana (born 7 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Porto, on loan from Ligue 1 club Rennes. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Seko Fofana.note: Fofana is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Côte d'Ivoire, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Seko Fofana.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Wilfried Singo.name: Wilfried Singo
Wilfried Singo.summary: Wilfried Stephane Singo (born 25 December 2000) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Ivory Coast national team.
Wilfried Singo.note: Singo has already made a goal happen for Côte d'Ivoire. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Wilfried Singo.noteZh: 他已经为Côte d'Ivoire送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Yahia Fofana.name: Yahia Fofana
Yahia Fofana.summary: Yahia Fofana (born 21 August 2000) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Süper Lig club Çaykur Rizespor. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Yahia Fofana.note: Fofana has been Côte d'Ivoire's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Yahia Fofana.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Yan Diomande.name: Yan Diomande
Yan Diomande.summary: Yan Diomande (born 14 November 2006) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Ivory Coast national team.
Yan Diomande.note: Diomande has one tournament assist in the bank for Côte d'Ivoire. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Yan Diomande.noteZh: 他已经帮Côte d'Ivoire制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Ao Tanaka.name: Ao Tanaka
Ao Tanaka.summary: Ao Tanaka (田中 碧, Tanaka Ao; born 10 September 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Leeds United and the Japan national team.
Ao Tanaka.note: Tanaka gives Japan midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Ao Tanaka.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Japan来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Ayumu Seko.name: Ayumu Seko
Ayumu Seko.summary: Ayumu Seko (瀬古 歩夢, Seko Ayumu; born 7 June 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Le Havre and the Japan national team.
Ayumu Seko.note: Seko is defensive cover for Japan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Ayumu Seko.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Daizen Maeda.name: Daizen Maeda
Daizen Maeda.summary: Daizen Maeda (前田 大然, Maeda Daizen; born 20 October 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership side Celtic and the Japan national team.
Daizen Maeda.note: Maeda is on the scoresheet for Japan, with his goal coming against Sweden. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Daizen Maeda.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Hiroki Ito.name: Hiroki Ito
Hiroki Ito.summary: Hiroki Ito is a Japan left-footed centre-back at Bayern Munich who gives the national team passing balance, recovery cover, and aerial defending.
Hiroki Ito.note: Ito gives Japan one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Hiroki Ito.noteZh: 他是Japan无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Junnosuke Suzuki.name: Junnosuke Suzuki
Junnosuke Suzuki.summary: Junnosuke Suzuki (鈴木 淳之介, Suzuki Junnosuke; born 12 July 2003) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Copenhagen and the Japan national team.
Junnosuke Suzuki.note: Suzuki gives Japan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Junnosuke Suzuki.noteZh: 他是Japan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Kaishu Sano.name: Kaishu Sano
Kaishu Sano.summary: Kaishu Sano (佐野 海舟, Sano Kaishū; born 30 December 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club Mainz 05 and the Japan national team.
Kaishu Sano.note: Sano has already given Japan a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Kaishu Sano.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Keisuke Goto.name: Keisuke Goto
Keisuke Goto.summary: Keisuke Gotō (後藤 啓介, Gotō Keisuke; born 3 June 2005) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Japan national team.
Keisuke Goto.note: Gotō is attacking depth for Japan. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Keisuke Goto.noteZh: 他是Japan前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Keisuke Osako.name: Keisuke Osako
Keisuke Osako.summary: Keisuke Ōsako (大迫 敬介, Ōsako Keisuke; born 28 July 1999) is a Japanese footballer who currently plays as a goalkeeper for J1 League club Sanfrecce Hiroshima and the Japan national team.
Keisuke Osako.note: Ōsako sits behind the starter for Japan, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Keisuke Osako.noteZh: 他给Japan保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Kento Shiogai.name: Kento Shiogai
Kento Shiogai.summary: Kento Shiogai (塩貝 健人, Shiogai Kento; born 26 March 2005) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for German 2. Bundesliga club VfL Wolfsburg and the Japan national team.
Kento Shiogai.note: Shiogai gives Japan a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Kento Shiogai.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Koki Ogawa.name: Koki Ogawa
Koki Ogawa.summary: Koki Ogawa is a Japan centre-forward at NEC Nijmegen who gives the national team penalty-box finishing, aerial presence, and striker depth.
Koki Ogawa.note: Ogawa has supplied one of Japan's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Koki Ogawa.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Japan创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Kou Itakura.name: Kou Itakura
Kou Itakura.summary: Ko Itakura (板倉 滉, Itakura Kō; born 27 January 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax and captains the Japan national team.
Kou Itakura.note: Itakura has already created a goal for Japan in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Kou Itakura.noteZh: 他已经参与了Japan的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Shogo Taniguchi.name: Shogo Taniguchi
Shogo Taniguchi.summary: Shōgo Taniguchi (谷口 彰悟, Taniguchi Shōgo; born 15 July 1991) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Belgian Pro League club Sint-Truiden and the Japan national team.
Shogo Taniguchi.note: Taniguchi gives Japan defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Shogo Taniguchi.noteZh: 他是Japan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Shuto Machino.name: Shuto Machino
Shuto Machino.summary: Shūto Machino (町野 修斗, Machino Shūto; born 30 September 1999) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the Japan national team.
Shuto Machino.note: Machino is attacking depth for Japan. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Shuto Machino.noteZh: 他是Japan前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Takehiro Tomiyasu.name: Takehiro Tomiyasu
Takehiro Tomiyasu.summary: Takehiro Tomiyasu (冨安 健洋, Tomiyasu Takehiro; born 5 November 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Japan national team. Mainly a full back, he can also be deployed as a centre-back.
Takehiro Tomiyasu.note: Tomiyasu is defensive rotation for Japan. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Takehiro Tomiyasu.noteZh: 他是Japan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Tomoki Hayakawa.name: Tomoki Hayakawa
Tomoki Hayakawa.summary: Tomoki Hayakawa (早川 友基, Hayakawa Tomoki; born 3 March 1999) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for J1 League club Kashima Antlers and the Japan national team.
Tomoki Hayakawa.note: Hayakawa is goalkeeper cover for Japan. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Tomoki Hayakawa.noteZh: 他是Japan门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Tsuyoshi Watanabe.name: Tsuyoshi Watanabe
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.summary: Tsuyoshi Watanabe (渡辺 剛, Watanabe Tsuyoshi; born 5 February 1997) is a Japanese football player who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Feyenoord and the Japan national team.
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.note: Watanabe is defensive cover for Japan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Yuito Suzuki.name: Yuito Suzuki
Yuito Suzuki.summary: Yuito Suzuki (鈴木 唯人, Suzuki Yuito; born 25 October 2001) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Japan national team.
Yuito Suzuki.note: Suzuki is midfield insurance for Japan. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Yuito Suzuki.noteZh: 他给Japan一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Yukinari Sugawara.name: Yukinari Sugawara
Yukinari Sugawara.summary: Yukinari Sugawara (菅原 由勢, Sugawara Yukinari; born 28 June 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Southampton and the Japan national team. Sugawara began his senior career at Nagoya Grampus.
Yukinari Sugawara.note: Sugawara is defensive cover for Japan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Yukinari Sugawara.noteZh: 他是Japan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Yuto Nagatomo.name: Yuto Nagatomo
Yuto Nagatomo.summary: Yūto Nagatomo (長友 佑都, Nagatomo Yūto; born 12 September 1986) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a full back for J1 League club FC Tokyo and the Japan national team.
Yuto Nagatomo.note: Nagatomo gives Japan another trusted body for the awkward minutes. One clean decision can keep the match from tilting.
Yuto Nagatomo.noteZh: 他是Japan赛事深度的一部分。压力下还能让简单选择出现，这就是这张卡的意义。

Zion Suzuki.name: Zion Suzuki
Zion Suzuki.summary: Zion Suzuki (鈴木 彩艶, Suzuki Zaion; born 21 August 2002) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Parma. Born in the United States, he represents the Japan national team.
Zion Suzuki.note: Suzuki has carried the keeper minutes for Japan. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Zion Suzuki.noteZh: 他是Japan防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Alexander Bernhardsson.name: Alexander Bernhardsson
Alexander Bernhardsson.summary: Alexander Olof Bernhardsson (born 8 September 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a forward for 2. Bundesliga club Holstein Kiel and the Sweden national team.
Alexander Bernhardsson.note: Bernhardsson gives Sweden a front-line rhythm that keeps defenders facing their own goal. His value often starts before the ball reaches him.
Alexander Bernhardsson.noteZh: 他给Sweden替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Benjamin Nygren.name: Benjamin Nygren
Benjamin Nygren.summary: Erik Benjamin Nygren (born 8 July 2001) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the Sweden national team.
Benjamin Nygren.note: Nygren gives Sweden midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Benjamin Nygren.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Sweden来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Besfort Zeneli.name: Besfort Zeneli
Besfort Zeneli.summary: Besfort Zeneli (born 21 November 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Belgian Pro League club Union Saint-Gilloise and the Sweden national team.
Besfort Zeneli.note: Zeneli is midfield insurance for Sweden. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.

Paul Izzo.noteZh: 他在Australia首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Paul Okon-Engstler.name: Paul Okon-Engstler
Paul Okon-Engstler.summary: Paul Michael Junior Okon-Engstler (West Flemish: [ˈoːkɔn ˈɛŋstlər]: born 24 January 2005), also known as Paul Okon Junior, is a professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Sydney FC in the A-League Men.
Paul Okon-Engstler.note: Okon-Engstler has supplied one of Australia's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Paul Okon-Engstler.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Australia创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Tete Yengi.name: Tete Yengi
Tete Yengi.summary: Tete Owen Yengi (born 28 November 2000) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a striker for J1 League club Machida Zelvia, on loan from Scottish Championship club Livingston, and the Australia national team.
Tete Yengi.note: Yengi gives Australia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Tete Yengi.noteZh: 他是Australia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Alexander Sorloth.name: Alexander Sorloth
Alexander Sorloth.summary: Alexander Sørloth (born 5 December 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Norway national team.
Alexander Sorloth.note: Sorloth has often started wide of Haaland, which makes Norway more physical without losing a striker's instincts. He pins defenders so the main service lane stays open.
Alexander Sorloth.noteZh: 索尔洛特常常在哈兰德身边偏边路首发，让挪威更有身体对抗，同时不失前锋本能。他牵制防守者，让主要传球线路保持打开。

Andreas Schjelderup.name: Andreas Schjelderup
Andreas Schjelderup.summary: Andreas Rædergård Schjelderup (born 1 June 2004) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Norway national team.
Andreas Schjelderup.note: Schjelderup became Norway's late-game key against Brazil, assisting both Haaland goals. He is the left-sided creator who can make one tired defensive step fatal.
Andreas Schjelderup.noteZh: 谢尔德鲁普在对巴西时成为挪威后段关键，两次助攻哈兰德。他是左侧创造者，能让防守者一次疲劳脚步付出代价。

Egil Selvik.name: Egil Selvik
Egil Selvik.summary: Egil Selvik (born 30 July 1997) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford and the Norway national team.
Egil Selvik.note: Selvik is Norway's goalkeeper depth and already started the France match. He gives direct distribution when Norway need the first pass to travel quickly.
Egil Selvik.noteZh: 塞尔维克是挪威的门将深度，也已经在对法国时首发。当挪威需要第一脚传球快速推进时，他提供直接出球。

Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.name: Fredrik Andre Bjorkan
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.summary: Fredrik André Bjørkan (born 21 August 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.note: Bjorkan is Norway's left-back runner for rotated matches. He gives overlap energy, but his bigger job is recovering before the counter reaches the centre-backs.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.noteZh: 比约尔坎是挪威轮换比赛中的左后卫跑动点。他提供套边活力，但更大的任务是在反击到达中卫前回追。

Fredrik Aursnes.name: Fredrik Aursnes
Fredrik Aursnes.summary: Fredrik Aursnes (born 10 December 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays primarily as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Norway national team.
Fredrik Aursnes.note: Aursnes is Norway's plug-in problem solver. He has appeared in midfield and wider roles, giving Odegaard and Haaland the platform to stay aggressive.
Fredrik Aursnes.noteZh: 奥尔斯内斯是挪威哪里需要补哪里的解题人。他踢过中场也踢过更宽的位置，为厄德高和哈兰德保持进攻性提供平台。

Henrik Falchener.name: Henrik Falchener
Henrik Falchener.summary: Henrik Sælebakke Falchener (born 8 May 2003) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Viking and the Norway national team.
Henrik Falchener.note: Falchener is young centre-back size for Norway. He is there when the match needs height, simple clearances, and a defender who does not overplay.
Henrik Falchener.noteZh: 法尔赫纳是挪威年轻的高大型中卫。当比赛需要身高、简单解围和不多处理球的防守者时，他有价值。

Jens Petter Hauge.name: Jens Petter Hauge
Jens Petter Hauge.summary: Jens Petter Hauge (born 12 October 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Jens Petter Hauge.note: Hauge is a bench route to a left-sided dribble. Norway would use him if the first plan has become too direct and the attack needs another touch before the shot.
Jens Petter Hauge.noteZh: 豪格是挪威替补席上左侧带球路线。如果第一计划变得过于直接，而进攻需要射门前多一脚处理，他就有意义。

Kristian Thorstvedt.name: Kristian Thorstvedt
Kristian Thorstvedt.summary: Kristian Thorstvedt (born 13 March 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Norway national team.
Kristian Thorstvedt.note: Thorstvedt gives Norway a taller midfielder who can arrive after Haaland has occupied the centre-backs. He turns second waves into real shots.
Kristian Thorstvedt.noteZh: 托斯特维特给挪威提供更高大的中场，在哈兰德牵制中卫后插上。他能把第二波进攻变成真正射门。

Kristoffer Ajer.name: Kristoffer Ajer
Kristoffer Ajer.summary: Kristoffer Vassbakk Köpp Ajer (born 17 April 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays either as centre-back or right-back for Premier League club Brentford and the Norway national team.
Kristoffer Ajer.note: Ajer gives Norway the defender who can carry the ball out instead of only clearing it. That matters when England press and Norway need the first escape.
Kristoffer Ajer.noteZh: 阿耶尔让挪威拥有能带球出来而不只是解围的后卫。对英格兰压迫时，这条第一出路很重要。

Morten Thorsby.name: Morten Thorsby
Morten Thorsby.summary: Morten Thorsby (born 5 May 1996) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie B club Cremonese and the Norway national team.
Morten Thorsby.note: Thorsby is Norway's contact midfielder. If the match against England turns scrappy, he is built for second balls and slowing the next runner.
Morten Thorsby.noteZh: 托尔斯比是挪威的对抗型中场。如果对英格兰变成混战，他适合争第二落点并拖慢下一名跑动者。

Orjan Nyland.name: Orjan Nyland
Orjan Nyland.summary: Ørjan Nyland is a Norway goalkeeper from Sevilla FC who gives the national team veteran shot stopping, box command, and tournament experience.
Orjan Nyland.note: Nyland is the veteran goalkeeper behind Norway's knockout push. His calm matters because this team can invite pressure while waiting for Haaland's moment.
Orjan Nyland.noteZh: 尼兰是挪威淘汰赛推进背后的老将门将。他的冷静很重要，因为这支球队会在等待哈兰德时刻时承受压力。

Oscar Bobb.name: Oscar Bobb
Oscar Bobb.summary: Oscar Bobb (born 12 July 2003) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Premier League club Fulham and the Norway national team.
Oscar Bobb.note: Bobb is Norway's silkier wide creator. He did not start every big match, but he is the player who can receive in traffic and make the attack less predictable.
Oscar Bobb.noteZh: 鲍勃是挪威更细腻的边路创造者。他并非每场大赛都首发，但能在人群中接球，让进攻不那么容易预测。

Patrick Berg.name: Patrick Berg
Patrick Berg.summary: Patrick Berg (born 24 November 1997) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Patrick Berg.note: Berg has quietly supplied big moments, including Haaland against Senegal and the winner against Côte d'Ivoire. He gives Norway early passes from deeper zones.
Patrick Berg.noteZh: 贝格安静地提供了关键时刻，包括对塞内加尔助攻哈兰德、对科特迪瓦助攻制胜球。他从更深位置送出早传。

Sander Berge.name: Sander Berge
Sander Berge.summary: Sander Gard Bolin Berge also known as Sandy Berge (born 14 February 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer from Asker who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Fulham and the Norway national team.
Sander Berge.note: Berge gives Norway the stride through midfield. When opponents crowd Odegaard, Berge can carry the ball far enough to change the angle.
Sander Berge.noteZh: 贝格给挪威提供中场大步推进。当对手围住厄德高时，他能带球推进到足够远，改变进攻角度。

Sander Tangvik.name: Sander Tangvik
Sander Tangvik.summary: Sander Tangvik (born 29 November 2002) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for German Bundesliga club Hamburger SV and the Norway national team.
Sander Tangvik.note: Tangvik is Norway's younger goalkeeper depth. His tournament role is cover behind Nyland and Selvik rather than a likely quarter-final story.
Sander Tangvik.noteZh: 唐维克是挪威更年轻的门将深度。他在这届赛事中的角色是尼兰和塞尔维克身后的保障，而不是八强战主线。

Sondre Langas.name: Sondre Langas
Sondre Langas.summary: Sondre Klingen Langås (born 2 February 2001) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Derby County and the Norway national team. Langås made his debut in the Norwegian Eliteserien for Viking.
Sondre Langas.note: Langas is centre-back cover for the aerial spells. Norway would use him when the box needs one more defender who can attack the first ball.
Sondre Langas.noteZh: 朗格斯是挪威应对空中阶段的中卫深度。当禁区需要多一名能争第一点的防守者时，他有价值。

Thelo Aasgaard.name: Thelo Aasgaard
Thelo Aasgaard.summary: Thelonious "Thelo" Gerard Aasgaard (pronounced /ˈtɛloʊ ˈæzɡɑːrd/; TELL-oh AZ-gard; Norwegian pronunciation: [ˈtɛlːʊ ˈoːsɡoːr]; born 2 May 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Rangers.
Thelo Aasgaard.note: Aasgaard scored Norway's consolation against France and stays interesting as a late midfield runner. He can make the second wave more than just support.
Thelo Aasgaard.noteZh: 奥斯高在对法国时打进挪威的安慰球，也仍是有趣的后插上中场。他能让第二波进攻不只是支援。

Torbjorn Heggem.name: Torbjorn Heggem
Torbjorn Heggem.summary: Torbjørn Lysaker Heggem (born 12 January 1999) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Bologna and the Norway national team. Primarily a centre-back, Heggem can also play as a left-back.
Torbjorn Heggem.note: Heggem has been part of Norway's main defensive shape. He is the steady left-sided cover who keeps the back line from chasing every wide run.
Torbjorn Heggem.noteZh: 赫格姆是挪威主要防守结构的一部分。他是稳定的左侧保护，避免整条后防线都去追每一次边路跑动。

David Moller Wolfe.name: David Moller Wolfe
David Moller Wolfe.summary: David Møller Wolfe (born 23 April 2002) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Norway national team.
David Moller Wolfe.note: Wolfe assisted Haaland in the opener and has kept giving Norway left-side width. He is a release valve when the midfield cannot turn cleanly.
David Moller Wolfe.noteZh: 沃尔夫在首战助攻哈兰德，也持续给挪威左路宽度。当中场无法干净转身时，他是出球阀门。

Jorgen Strand Larsen.name: Jorgen Strand Larsen
Jorgen Strand Larsen.summary: Jørgen Strand Larsen (Norwegian: [ˈjøːɾɡən strɑn ˈlɑːɾsən], born 6 February 2000) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the Norway national team.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.note: Strand Larsen is the alternate centre-forward when Norway rotate away from Haaland. He keeps centre-backs occupied and lets the wide runners play off a target.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.noteZh: 斯特兰德·拉尔森是挪威轮换哈兰德时的替代中锋。他牵制中卫，让边路跑动者能围绕支点踢球。

Adrien Rabiot.name: Adrien Rabiot
Adrien Rabiot.summary: Adrien Thibault Marie Rabiot (French pronunciation: [adʁijɛ̃ tibo maʁi ʁabjo]; born 3 April 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club AC Milan and the France national team.
Adrien Rabiot.note: Rabiot has been France's quiet balance in midfield. He keeps the left side sturdy, then sneaks forward late enough to become the extra runner.
Adrien Rabiot.noteZh: 拉比奥是法国中场安静的平衡点。他让左侧更稳，也会在合适的时机后插上，成为多出来的接应点。

Aurelien Tchouameni.name: Aurelien Tchouameni
Aurelien Tchouameni.summary: Aurélien Djani Tchouaméni (French pronunciation: [oʁeljɛ̃ dʒani tʃuameni, tʃwa-]; born 27 January 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or a centre-back for La Liga club Real Madrid and the France national team.
Aurelien Tchouameni.note: Tchouameni anchors France when the game starts stretching. He wins the first duel and can turn it into the longer pass that sends the forwards running.
Aurelien Tchouameni.noteZh: 楚阿梅尼在比赛被拉开时稳住法国中场。他先赢下第一下对抗，再用更长的传球把前锋送出去。

Brice Samba.name: Brice Samba
Brice Samba.summary: Brice Lauriche Samba (born 25 April 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Rennes. Born in the Republic of the Congo, he plays for the France national team.
Brice Samba.note: Samba is the experienced keeper France can turn to if Maignan is unavailable. His card is about command, reach, and comfort in traffic.
Brice Samba.noteZh: 如果迈尼昂无法出场，桑巴是法国可以依靠的经验门将。他的看点是指挥、覆盖范围，以及在人群中处理球的稳定。

Dayot Upamecano.name: Dayot Upamecano
Dayot Upamecano.summary: Dayotchanculle Oswald Upamecano (French: [upamekano]; born 27 October 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich and the France national team.
Dayot Upamecano.note: Upamecano lets France defend with space behind them. He steps into duels early, then has the speed to recover if the first challenge does not finish the play.
Dayot Upamecano.noteZh: 于帕梅卡诺让法国敢在身后留出空间。他会提前上抢，如果第一下没有解决问题，也有速度回追。

Desire Doue.name: Desire Doue
Desire Doue.summary: Désiré Nonka-Maho Doué (French pronunciation: [deziʁe dwe, -due]; born 3 June 2005) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.
Desire Doue.note: Doue is the young attacker France use to change the rhythm on the left. He receives in tight pockets and tries the touch that makes a defender turn.
Desire Doue.noteZh: 杜埃是法国用来改变左路节奏的年轻攻击手。他能在狭小区域接球，并用第一下触球迫使防守者转身。

Ibrahima Konate.name: Ibrahima Konate
Ibrahima Konate.summary: Ibrahima Konaté (French pronunciation: [ibʁaimˈa konatˈe]; born 25 May 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Liverpool and the France national team.
Ibrahima Konate.note: Konate is the centre-back France can add when the match becomes about crosses, contact, and protecting a lead.
Ibrahima Konate.noteZh: 当比赛变成传中、身体对抗和守住领先时，科纳特是法国可以换上的中卫。

Jean-Philippe Mateta.name: Jean-Philippe Mateta
Jean-Philippe Mateta.summary: Jean-Philippe Mateta (born 28 June 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the France national team.
Jean-Philippe Mateta.note: Mateta is France's late-game target. If the match gets direct, he gives Mbappe a rest and gives crosses a bigger body to find.
Jean-Philippe Mateta.noteZh: 马特塔是法国比赛后段的支点。如果比赛变得更直接，他能让姆巴佩休息，也让传中有更强壮的目标。

Jules Kounde.name: Jules Kounde
Jules Kounde.summary: Jules Olivier Koundé (French pronunciation: [ʒyl ɔlivje kunde]; born 12 November 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for La Liga club Barcelona and the France national team.
Jules Kounde.note: Kounde is the quiet lock on France's right side. He holds the flank steady so the front four can take more risks ahead of him.
Jules Kounde.noteZh: 孔德是法国右侧安静的锁。他把边路守稳，让身前的四名攻击手可以承担更多风险。

Lucas Digne.name: Lucas Digne
Lucas Digne.summary: Lucas Digne (French pronunciation: [lyka diɲ]; born 20 July 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Aston Villa and the France national team.
Lucas Digne.note: Digne has become France's steadier left-back choice in the knockout run. He offers early service and calmer defending while Hernandez waits as the power option.
Lucas Digne.noteZh: 迪涅在淘汰赛阶段成了法国更稳的左后卫选择。他提供早传和更冷静的防守，而埃尔南德斯保留着力量型选择。

Lucas Hernandez.name: Lucas Hernandez
Lucas Hernandez.summary: Lucas François Bernard Hernandez (French pronunciation: [lukas ɛʁnɑ̃dɛz, - ɛʁnandɛs]; born 14 February 1996) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.
Lucas Hernandez.note: Lucas Hernandez is the harder defensive version on the left. France can use him when the flank needs bite more than extra attacking runs.
Lucas Hernandez.noteZh: 卢卡斯·埃尔南德斯是左侧更强硬的防守版本。当边路更需要硬度而不是更多前插时，法国可以使用他。

Maghnes Akliouche.name: Maghnes Akliouche
Maghnes Akliouche.summary: Maghnes Akliouche (born 25 February 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ligue 1 club Monaco and the France national team.
Maghnes Akliouche.note: Akliouche is a late attacking craft option for France. His appeal is the small touch near the box that turns a safe possession spell into a chance.
Maghnes Akliouche.noteZh: 阿克利乌什是法国比赛后段的细腻进攻选择。他的价值在于禁区附近的小触球，能把安全控球变成机会。

Malo Gusto.name: Malo Gusto
Malo Gusto.summary: Malo Arthur Gusto (born 19 May 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the France national team.
Malo Gusto.note: Gusto is the right-back France use when Kounde's side needs fresh legs. He can push high, then still sprint back into the wide duel.
Malo Gusto.noteZh: 当孔德这一侧需要新鲜体能时，古斯托是法国的右后卫选择。他能压上，也能再冲刺回到边路对抗。

Manu Kone.name: Manu Kone
Manu Kone.summary: Kouadio Emmanuel Boris Koné (born 17 May 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Roma and the France national team.
Manu Kone.note: Kone has become one of France's legs in midfield. He carries through contact and helps the press start again after the ball is lost.
Manu Kone.noteZh: 科内已经成为法国中场的跑动腿。他能带球穿过对抗，也能在丢球后帮助球队再次压迫。

Marcus Thuram.name: Marcus Thuram
Marcus Thuram.summary: Marcus Lilian Thuram-Ulien (French pronunciation: [maʁkys tyʁam]; born 6 August 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Inter Milan. Born in Italy, he plays for the France national team.
Marcus Thuram.note: Thuram gives France a forward who can drift wide without leaving the box empty. He is a late-game way to add running power around Mbappe.
Marcus Thuram.noteZh: 图拉姆让法国拥有一个能拉边但不让禁区空掉的前锋。他是比赛后段在姆巴佩身边增加跑动冲击的选择。

Maxence Lacroix.name: Maxence Lacroix
Maxence Lacroix.summary: Maxence Guy Lacroix (French pronunciation: [maksɑ̃s lakʁwa]; born 6 April 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the France national team.
Maxence Lacroix.note: Lacroix is France's pace cover at centre-back. He is there for games where the defensive line has to live high and still survive the ball over the top.
Maxence Lacroix.noteZh: 拉克鲁瓦是法国中卫位置的速度保险。当防线必须站得很高，还要防住身后球时，他就有价值。

Mike Maignan.name: Mike Maignan
Mike Maignan.summary: Mike Peterson Maignan (French pronunciation: [mɛɲɑ̃]; born 3 July 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club AC Milan, which he captains, and the France national team.
Mike Maignan.note: Maignan is the calm base behind France's high line. His range and distribution let the defenders play forward without every turnover feeling like an emergency.
Mike Maignan.noteZh: 迈尼昂是法国高位防线身后的冷静底座。他的覆盖范围和出球能力，让后卫敢向前踢，而不是每次丢球都像警报。

Ngolo Kante.name: Ngolo Kante
Ngolo Kante.summary: N'Golo Kanté (born 29 March 1991) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the France national team.
Ngolo Kante.note: Kante is the emergency brake France can still call on in midfield. Even now, his best trait is seeing the counter before it looks like one.
Ngolo Kante.noteZh: 坎特依然是法国中场可以启用的紧急刹车。即使现在，他最强的特质仍是能在反击成形前就看见危险。

Rayan Cherki.name: Rayan Cherki
Rayan Cherki.summary: Mathis Rayan Cherki (born 17 August 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Manchester City and the France national team.
Rayan Cherki.note: Cherki is the bench player for strange endings. When the shape loosens, he wants the ball at his feet and the pass nobody else is brave enough to try.
Rayan Cherki.noteZh: 谢尔基是法国应对奇怪收尾阶段的替补。当阵型开始松动时，他想要球在脚下，也敢传别人不敢尝试的球。

Robin Risser.name: Robin Risser
Robin Risser.summary: Robin François Philippe Risser (born 2 December 2004) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Lens.
Robin Risser.note: Risser is France's developmental goalkeeper in this squad. The card matters mostly as depth behind Maignan and Samba, not as a likely match story yet.
Robin Risser.noteZh: 里塞尔是法国这支名单里的培养型门将。他目前更像迈尼昂和桑巴身后的深度，而不是马上会成为比赛主线的人。

Theo Hernandez.name: Theo Hernandez
Theo Hernandez.summary: Théo Bernard François Hernandez (French pronunciation: [teo ɛʁnɑ̃dɛz, - ɛʁnandɛs]; born 6 October 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays primarily as a left-back for Saudi Pro League club Al Hilal and the France national team.
Theo Hernandez.note: Theo Hernandez is the left-back who changes the speed of France's attack. One regain can become a carry that drags the whole team upfield.
Theo Hernandez.noteZh: 特奥·埃尔南德斯是能改变法国进攻速度的左后卫。一次夺回球权，就可能变成把全队带上去的推进。

Warren Zaire-Emery.name: Warren Zaire-Emery
Warren Zaire-Emery.summary: Warren Marie Jean-Pierre Zaïre-Emery (born 8 March 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.
Warren Zaire-Emery.note: Zaire-Emery is the midfield reset option if France need fresher legs and cleaner circulation. His value is keeping attacks moving without making the game louder.
Warren Zaire-Emery.noteZh: 如果法国需要更新鲜的体能和更干净的中场流转，扎伊尔-埃梅里是重置选择。他的价值是让进攻继续运转，而不把比赛变得更吵。

Abdoulaye Seck.name: Abdoulaye Seck
Abdoulaye Seck.summary: Abdoulaye Seck (born 4 June 1992) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Israeli Premier League club Maccabi Haifa and the Senegal national team.
Abdoulaye Seck.note: Seck has already created a goal for Senegal in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Abdoulaye Seck.noteZh: 他已经参与了Senegal的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Antoine Mendy.name: Antoine Mendy
Antoine Mendy.summary: Antoine Alpha Mendy (born 27 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back and centre-back for Ligue 1 club Nice. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Antoine Mendy.note: Mendy gives Senegal cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Antoine Mendy.noteZh: 他是Senegal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Assane Diao.name: Assane Diao
Assane Diao.summary: Assane Diao (born 7 September 2005) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Como and the Senegal national team.
Assane Diao.note: Diao is attacking depth for Senegal. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Assane Diao.noteZh: 他是Senegal前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Bamba Dieng.name: Bamba Dieng
Bamba Dieng.summary: Cheikh Ahmadou Bamba Mbacke Dieng (born 23 March 2000) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Lorient and the Senegal national team.
Bamba Dieng.note: Dieng is the forward Senegal can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Bamba Dieng.noteZh: 他给Senegal替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Cherif Ndiaye.name: Cherif Ndiaye
Cherif Ndiaye.summary: Pape Cherif Ndiaye (born 23 January 1996) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Süper Lig club Samsunspor and the Senegal national team.
Cherif Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye gives Senegal a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Cherif Ndiaye.noteZh: 他是Senegal在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Edouard Mendy.name: Edouard Mendy
Edouard Mendy.summary: Édouard Osoque Mendy (born 1 March 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Edouard Mendy.note: Mendy gives Senegal a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Edouard Mendy.noteZh: 他在Senegal首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Habib Diarra.name: Habib Diarra
Habib Diarra.summary: Mouhamadou Habib Mbacke Diarra (born 3 January 2004) is a French-Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland and the Senegal national team.
Habib Diarra.note: Diarra has already punished Iraq and Belgium for Senegal. The watch point is how little room he needs once the chance is alive.
Habib Diarra.noteZh: 他让Senegal拥有一个必须被惦记的得分点。每个松散球都可能突然变重。

Iliman Ndiaye.name: Iliman Ndiaye
Iliman Ndiaye.summary: Iliman Cheikh Baroy Ndiaye (born 6 March 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder for Premier League club Everton. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Iliman Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye has both scored and created for Senegal in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Iliman Ndiaye.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Ismail Jakobs.name: Ismail Jakobs
Ismail Jakobs.summary: Ismail Joshua Jakobs (born 17 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray. Born in Germany, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Ismail Jakobs.note: Jakobs gives Senegal defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Ismail Jakobs.noteZh: 他是Senegal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Krepin Diatta.name: Krepin Diatta
Krepin Diatta.summary: Krépin Diatta (born 25 February 1999) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Monaco and the Senegal national team.
Krepin Diatta.note: Diatta gives Senegal a front-line rhythm that keeps defenders facing their own goal. His value often starts before the ball reaches him.
Krepin Diatta.noteZh: 他给Senegal替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Lamine Camara.name: Lamine Camara
Lamine Camara.summary: Lamine Camara (born 1 January 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Monaco and the Senegal national team.
Lamine Camara.note: Camara has supplied one of Senegal's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Lamine Camara.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Senegal创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Mamadou Sarr.name: Mamadou Sarr
Mamadou Sarr.summary: Mamadou Sarr (born 29 August 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Chelsea. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Mamadou Sarr.note: Sarr is the kind of defender Senegal can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Mamadou Sarr.noteZh: 他是Senegal艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mory Diaw.name: Mory Diaw
Mory Diaw.summary: Mory Diaw (born 22 June 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Le Havre. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Mory Diaw.note: Diaw is goalkeeper cover for Senegal. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Mory Diaw.noteZh: 他是Senegal门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Moussa Niakhate.name: Moussa Niakhate
Moussa Niakhate.summary: Moussa Niakhaté (born 8 March 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lyon. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Moussa Niakhate.note: Niakhaté has supplied one of Senegal's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Moussa Niakhate.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Senegal创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Pape Gueye.name: Pape Gueye
Pape Gueye.summary: Pape Alassane Gueye (born 24 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Pape Gueye.note: Gueye has put goals and service into Senegal's tournament, with finishes against Iraq. His card is the next action after the first touch.
Pape Gueye.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Senegal带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Pathe Ciss.name: Pathe Ciss
Pathe Ciss.summary: Pathé Ismaël Ciss (born 16 March 1994) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a central or defensive midfielder for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano and the Senegal national team.
Pathe Ciss.note: Ciss gives Senegal a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Pathe Ciss.noteZh: 他是Senegal的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Yehvann Diouf.name: Yehvann Diouf
Yehvann Diouf.summary: Yehvann Djibril Victor Diouf (born 16 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Nice. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Yehvann Diouf.note: Diouf is goalkeeper cover for Senegal. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Yehvann Diouf.noteZh: 他是Senegal门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.name: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.summary: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye is a Senegal central midfielder from Bayern Munich who gives the national team youthful ball carrying, midfield mobility, and long-term upside.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye is midfield insurance for Senegal. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.noteZh: 他给Senegal一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

El Hadji Malick Diouf.name: El Hadji Malick Diouf
El Hadji Malick Diouf.summary: El Hadji Malick Diouf (born 29 December 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Senegal national team.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.note: Diouf is defensive rotation for Senegal. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.noteZh: 他是Senegal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Idrissa Gueye.name: Idrissa Gueye
Idrissa Gueye.summary: Idrissa Gana Gueye (born 26 September 1989) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Everton and the Senegal national team.
Idrissa Gueye.note: Gueye gives Senegal structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Idrissa Gueye.noteZh: 他给Senegal控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Pape Matar Sarr.name: Pape Matar Sarr
Pape Matar Sarr.summary: Pape Matar Sarr (French pronunciation: [pap matɑʁ sɑʁ]; born 14 September 2002) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Senegal national team.
Pape Matar Sarr.note: Sarr is midfield insurance for Senegal. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Pape Matar Sarr.noteZh: 他给Senegal一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Ahmed Basil.note: Fadhil sits behind the starter for Iraq, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Ahmed Basil.noteZh: 他给Iraq保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Ahmed Qasem.name: Ahmed Qasem
Ahmed Qasem.summary: Ahmed Ihab Ahmed, known as Ahmed Qasem (Arabic: أحمد قاسم, romanized: ʾAḥmad Qāsim pronounced [ˈ(ʔ)aħmad ˈqaː.sɪm]; born 12 July 2003), is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.
Ahmed Qasem.note: Qasem gives Iraq midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Ahmed Qasem.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Iraq来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Aimar Sher.name: Aimar Sher
Aimar Sher.summary: Aimar Hazar Anwar Sher (born 20 December 2002) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Sarpsborg 08 and the Iraq national team.
Aimar Sher.note: Sher gives Iraq midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Aimar Sher.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Iraq来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Akam Hashim.name: Akam Hashim
Akam Hashim.summary: Akam Hashim Rahman (Arabic: اكام هاشم رحمن; Kurdish: ئاکام هاشم ڕەحمان; born 16 August 1998) is a Kurdish Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or midfielder for Al-Zawraa and the Iraq national team.
Akam Hashim.note: Hashem gives Iraq one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Akam Hashim.noteZh: 他是Iraq无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Ali Yousif.name: Ali Yousif
Ali Yousif.summary: Ali Yousif Hashim Najatee (Arabic: علي يوسف هاشم; born 19 January 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for Al-Talaba and the Iraq national team.
Ali Yousif.note: Yousif gives Iraq a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Ali Yousif.noteZh: 他是Iraq在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Fahad Talib.name: Fahad Talib
Fahad Talib.summary: Fahad Talib Raheem (Arabic: فَهْد طَالِب رَحِيم; born 21 October 1994) is an Iraqi professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper for Iraq Stars League club Al Talaba and the Iraq national team.
Fahad Talib.note: Talib sits behind the starter for Iraq, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Fahad Talib.noteZh: 他给Iraq保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Frans Putros.name: Frans Putros
Frans Putros.summary: Frans Dhia Jirjis Haddad (born 14 July 1993), commonly known as Frans Putros (Arabic: فرانس بطرس; Syriac: ܦܪܢܣ ܦܘܛܪܘܣ), is a professional footballer who plays as a Centre-back, Full-back or Defensive midfielder for Super League club Persib Bandung.
Frans Putros.note: Putros is defensive cover for Iraq's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Frans Putros.noteZh: 他是Iraq在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Hussein Ali.name: Hussein Ali
Hussein Ali.summary: Hussein Ali Jasim Al Saedi (Arabic: حسين علي جاسم الساعدي; born 29 November 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays for Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Hussein Ali.note: Ali is midfield insurance for Iraq. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Hussein Ali.noteZh: 他给Iraq一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Ibrahim Bayesh.name: Ibrahim Bayesh
Ibrahim Bayesh.summary: Ibrahim Bayesh Kamil Al-Kaabawi (Arabic: إبرَاهِيْم بَايَش كَامِل الْكَعْبَاوِيّ; born 1 May 2000) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays Al-Dhafra as a midfielder for UAE Pro League club Al-Dhafra and the Iraq national team.
Ibrahim Bayesh.note: Bayesh has been one of Iraq's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Ibrahim Bayesh.noteZh: 他是Iraq这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Jalal Hassan.name: Jalal Hassan
Jalal Hassan.summary: Jalal Hassan Hachem (Arabic: جَلَال حَسَن هَاشِم; born 18 May 1991) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains both Al-Zawraa and the Iraq football team.
Jalal Hassan.note: Hassan is goalkeeper cover for Iraq. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Jalal Hassan.noteZh: 他是Iraq门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Kevin Yakob.summary: Kevin Enkido Yakob William (Syriac: ܟܒܢ ܝܥܩܘܒ, born 10 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Danish Superliga club AGF. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Kevin Yakob.note: Yakob is midfield insurance for Iraq. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Kevin Yakob.noteZh: 他给Iraq一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Marko Farji.summary: Marko Zana Hussein Farji (Arabic: ماركو زانا حسين فرج; Kurdish: Marko Zana Husên Fercî; born 16 March 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Venezia. Born in Norway, he plays for the Iraq national team.

Marko Farji.noteZh: 他是Iraq前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Merchas Doski.summary: Merchas Ghazi Salih Doski (Kurdish: مێرخاس غازی ساڵح دۆسکی, romanized: Mîrxas Qazî Salih Doskî, Arabic: ميرخاس غازي صالح دوسكي) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Viktoria Plzeň. Born in Germany, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Merchas Doski.note: Doski is in the quiet-work part of Iraq's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Merchas Doski.noteZh: 他是Iraq主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Mohanad Ali.name: Mohanad Ali
Mohanad Ali.summary: Mohanad Ali Kadhim Al-Shammari (Arabic: مُهَنَّد عَلِيّ كَاظِم الشَّمَّرِيّ, born 20 June 2000), commonly known in Iraq as Mimi (Arabic: ميمي), is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE club Dibba and the Iraq national team.
Mohanad Ali.note: Ali is attacking depth for Iraq. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Mohanad Ali.noteZh: 他是Iraq前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。
