Munaf Younus.summary: Manaf Younus Hashim Al-Tekreeti (Arabic: مَنَاف يُونُس هَاشِم التِّكرِيْتِيّ; born 16 November 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Munaf Younus.note: Younis is back-line insurance for Iraq. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Munaf Younus.noteZh: 他给Iraq那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Mustafa Saadoon.name: Mustafa Saadoon
Mustafa Saadoon.summary: Mustafa Saadoon is an Iraq right-back from Al-Shorta who gives the national team wide defending, recovery speed, and overlap support.
Mustafa Saadoon.note: Saadoon is the kind of defender Iraq can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.

Rebin Sulaka.summary: Rebin Gharib Sulaka Adhamat (Arabic: ريبين غريب سولاقا عظمت; born 12 April 1992) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Thai League 1 club Port and the Iraq national team.

Rebin Sulaka.noteZh: 他是Iraq在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Youssef Amyn.noteZh: 他是Iraq的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Ahmed Maknzi.name: Ahmed Maknzi
Ahmed Maknzi.summary: Ahmed Maknzi is an Iraq left-back from Al-Karma who gives the national team wide defending, recovery runs, and defensive flexibility.

Ahmed Maknzi.noteZh: 他是Iraq在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Nawaf Boushal.name: Nawaf Boushal
Nawaf Boushal.summary: Nawaf Boushal is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Nassr who brings overlap energy, recovery speed, and wide defensive bite.
Nawaf Boushal.note: Boushal is back-line insurance for Saudi Arabia. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Nawaf Boushal.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Saleh Al-Shehri.name: Saleh Al-Shehri
Saleh Al-Shehri.summary: Saleh Khalid Mohammed Al-Shehri (Arabic: صالح خالد محمد الشهري; born 1 November 1993) is a Saudi Arabian professional football player who plays as a striker for Al-Ittihad and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Saleh Al-Shehri.note: Al-Shehri gives Saudi Arabia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Saleh Al-Shehri.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Musab Al-Juwayr.name: Musab Al-Juwayr
Musab Al-Juwayr.summary: Musab Fahd Al-Juwayr (Arabic: مُصْعَب فَهْد الْجُوَيْر; born 20 June 2003) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Qadsiah. Since 2023, he has also played for the Saudi Arabia national team.
Musab Al-Juwayr.note: Al-Juwayr is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Saudi Arabia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Musab Al-Juwayr.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Ziyad Al-Johani.name: Ziyad Al-Johani
Ziyad Al-Johani.summary: Ziyad Al-Johani is a Saudi Arabia defensive midfielder from Al-Ahli who adds ball winning, central coverage, and short progression.
Ziyad Al-Johani.note: Al-Johani is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Saudi Arabia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Ziyad Al-Johani.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Brian Rodriguez.name: Brian Rodriguez
Brian Rodriguez.summary: Paul Brian Rodríguez Bravo (born 20 May 2000) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club América and the Uruguay national team.
Brian Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez gives Uruguay a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Brian Rodriguez.noteZh: 他是Uruguay在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Emiliano Martinez.name: Emiliano Martinez
Emiliano Martinez.summary: Emiliano Martínez Toranza (born 17 August 1999) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras and the Uruguay national team.
Emiliano Martinez.note: Martínez gives Uruguay midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Emiliano Martinez.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Uruguay来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Facundo Pellistri.name: Facundo Pellistri
Facundo Pellistri.summary: Facundo Pellistri Rebollo (Spanish pronunciation: [faˈkundo peˈlistɾi]; born 20 December 2001) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Greek Super League club Panathinaikos and the Uruguay national team.
Facundo Pellistri.note: Pellistri is attacking depth for Uruguay. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Facundo Pellistri.noteZh: 他是Uruguay前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Federico Vinas.name: Federico Vinas
Federico Vinas.summary: Federico Sebastián Viñas Barboza (born 30 June 1998) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Segunda División club Real Oviedo, on loan from Liga MX club León, and the Uruguay national team.
Federico Vinas.note: Viñas is attacking depth for Uruguay. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Federico Vinas.noteZh: 他是Uruguay前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Fernando Muslera.name: Fernando Muslera
Fernando Muslera.summary: Néstor Fernando Muslera Micol (Spanish: [feɾˈnando musˈleɾa]; born 16 June 1986) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Estudiantes and the Uruguay national team.
Fernando Muslera.note: Muslera gives Uruguay the calmest first pass from the back. Watch how quickly he turns a save or claim into a reset.
Fernando Muslera.noteZh: 他是Uruguay这段征程中的门将。价值在于让禁区保持冷静，并让下一次进攻能干净开始。

Giorgian De Arrascaeta.name: Giorgian De Arrascaeta
Giorgian De Arrascaeta.summary: Giorgian Daniel de Arrascaeta Benedetti (born 1 June 1994) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Flamengo and the Uruguay national team.
Giorgian De Arrascaeta.note: Arrascaeta gives Uruguay midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Giorgian De Arrascaeta.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Uruguay来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Guillermo Varela.name: Guillermo Varela
Guillermo Varela.summary: Guillermo Varela Olivera ([ɡiˈʝeɾmo βaˈɾela oliˈβeɾa]; born 24 March 1993) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Flamengo and the Uruguay national team.
Guillermo Varela.note: Varela has been part of Uruguay's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Guillermo Varela.noteZh: 他给Uruguay后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Joaquin Piquerez.name: Joaquin Piquerez
Joaquin Piquerez.summary: Joaquín Piquerez Moreira (born 24 August 1998) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as an left-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras and the Uruguay national team.
Joaquin Piquerez.note: Piquerez is back-line insurance for Uruguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Joaquin Piquerez.noteZh: 他给Uruguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Jose Maria Gimenez.name: Jose Maria Gimenez
Jose Maria Gimenez.summary: José María Giménez de Vargas (Spanish pronunciation: [xoˈse maˈɾi.a xiˈmenes ðe ˈβaɾɣas]; born 20 January 1995) is an Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and captains the Uruguay national team.
Jose Maria Gimenez.note: Giménez is back-line insurance for Uruguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Jose Maria Gimenez.noteZh: 他给Uruguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Juan Manuel Sanabria.name: Juan Manuel Sanabria
Juan Manuel Sanabria.summary: Juan Manuel Sanabria Magole (born 29 March 2000) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or left-back for Major League Soccer club Real Salt Lake and the Uruguay national team.
Juan Manuel Sanabria.note: Sanabria gives Uruguay another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Juan Manuel Sanabria.noteZh: 他是Uruguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Manuel Ugarte.name: Manuel Ugarte
Manuel Ugarte.summary: Manuel Ugarte Ribeiro (Spanish pronunciation: [maˈnwel uˈɣaɾte]; born 11 April 2001) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United and the Uruguay national team.
Manuel Ugarte.note: Ugarte gives Uruguay structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Manuel Ugarte.noteZh: 他给Uruguay控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Mathias Olivera.name: Mathias Olivera
Mathias Olivera.summary: Mathías Olivera Miramontes (born 31 October 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a left-back or centre-back for Serie A club Napoli and the Uruguay national team.
Mathias Olivera.note: Olivera has been part of Uruguay's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Mathias Olivera.noteZh: 他给Uruguay后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Matias Vina.name: Matias Vina
Matias Vina.summary: Matías Nicolás Viña Susperreguy (born 9 November 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Flamengo and the Uruguay national team.
Matias Vina.note: Viña gives Uruguay cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Matias Vina.noteZh: 他是Uruguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Nicolas De La Cruz.name: Nicolas De La Cruz
Nicolas De La Cruz.summary: Diego Nicolás de la Cruz Arcosa (born 1 June 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A club Flamengo and the Uruguay national team.
Nicolas De La Cruz.note: Cruz is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Uruguay, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Nicolas De La Cruz.noteZh: 他给Uruguay提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Rodrigo Aguirre.name: Rodrigo Aguirre
Rodrigo Aguirre.summary: Rodrigo Sebastián Aguirre Soto (born 1 October 1994) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Liga MX club Tigres UANL and the Uruguay national team.
Rodrigo Aguirre.note: Aguirre is an attacking change-up for Uruguay. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Rodrigo Aguirre.noteZh: 他是Uruguay的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Rodrigo Bentancur.name: Rodrigo Bentancur
Rodrigo Bentancur.summary: Rodrigo Bentancur Colman (born 25 June 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Uruguay national team.
Rodrigo Bentancur.note: Bentancur has been one of Uruguay's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Rodrigo Bentancur.noteZh: 他是Uruguay这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Rodrigo Zalazar.name: Rodrigo Zalazar
Rodrigo Zalazar.summary: Rodrigo Zalazar Martínez (born 12 August 1999) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Braga and the Uruguay national team. He will join Sporting CP on 1 July 2026.
Rodrigo Zalazar.note: Zalazar is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Uruguay, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Rodrigo Zalazar.noteZh: 他给Uruguay提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Santiago Bueno.name: Santiago Bueno
Santiago Bueno.summary: Santiago Ignacio Bueno Sciutto (born 9 November 1998) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Uruguay national team.
Santiago Bueno.note: Bueno gives Uruguay cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Santiago Bueno.noteZh: 他是Uruguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Santiago Mele.name: Santiago Mele
Santiago Mele.summary: Santiago Andrés Mele Castañero (born 6 September 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club Monterrey and the Uruguay national team.
Santiago Mele.note: Mele gives Uruguay a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Santiago Mele.noteZh: 他在Uruguay首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Sebastian Caceres.name: Sebastian Caceres
Sebastian Caceres.summary: Sebastián Enzo Cáceres Ramos (born 18 August 1999) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club América and the Uruguay national team.
Sebastian Caceres.note: Cáceres gives Uruguay one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Sebastian Caceres.noteZh: 他是Uruguay无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Sergio Rochet.name: Sergio Rochet
Sergio Rochet.summary: Sergio Ramón Rochet Álvarez (born 23 March 1993) is an Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Internacional and Uruguay national team.
Sergio Rochet.note: Rochet sits behind the starter for Uruguay, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Sergio Rochet.noteZh: 他给Uruguay保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Alex Baena.name: Alex Baena
Alex Baena.summary: Alejandro "Álex" Baena Rodríguez (born 20 July 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or attacking midfielder for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Spain national team.
Alex Baena.note: Baena has given Spain left-side delivery and a goal against Uruguay. His best moments come when the defense expects another pass and he plays the sharper one.
Alex Baena.noteZh: 巴埃纳给西班牙提供左侧传递，也在对乌拉圭时进球。他最好的时刻，是防线以为还会横传时，他送出更尖锐的一脚。

Alex Grimaldo.name: Alex Grimaldo
Alex Grimaldo.summary: Alejandro "Álex" Grimaldo García (born 20 September 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left wing-back for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Spain national team.
Alex Grimaldo.note: Grimaldo is Spain's luxury left-footed service option. If the match needs cleaner delivery from deeper areas, he changes the crossing angle immediately.
Alex Grimaldo.noteZh: 格里马尔多是西班牙奢侈的左脚传中选择。如果比赛需要从更深位置送出更干净的传球，他会立刻改变传中角度。

Aymeric Laporte.name: Aymeric Laporte
Aymeric Laporte.summary: Aymeric Jean Louis Gérard Alphonse Laporte (French pronunciation: [ɛ.mə.ʁik la.pɔʁt]; born 27 May 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao. Born in France, he plays for the Spain national team.
Aymeric Laporte.note: Laporte keeps Spain's back line comfortable on the ball. His assist against Saudi Arabia showed how his passing can skip the safe option and find the scorer.
Aymeric Laporte.noteZh: 拉波尔特让西班牙后防在有球时更舒服。他对沙特的助攻说明，他的传球可以跳过安全选项，直接找到得分手。

Borja Iglesias.name: Borja Iglesias
Borja Iglesias.summary: Borja Iglesias Quintas (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈboɾxajˈɣlesjas]; born 17 January 1993) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Celta de Vigo and the Spain national team.
Borja Iglesias.note: Borja is Spain's more traditional penalty-area body. He matters if the match gets crowded and Spain need someone to hold off centre-backs instead of only combining around them.
Borja Iglesias.noteZh: 博尔哈是西班牙更传统的禁区身体点。如果比赛变得拥挤，西班牙需要有人顶住中卫，而不只是围着他们配合，他就有价值。

Dani Olmo.name: Dani Olmo
Dani Olmo.summary: Daniel Olmo Carvajal (Spanish pronunciation: [dˈani ˈolmo]; born 7 May 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Dani Olmo.note: Olmo is Spain's attacker for the pocket between midfield and defense. His assist against Saudi Arabia came from arriving in the right space before the back line adjusted.
Dani Olmo.noteZh: 奥尔莫是西班牙在中场和防线之间找空当的攻击手。他对沙特的助攻来自在后防调整前先到正确位置。

David Raya.name: David Raya
David Raya.summary: David Raya Martín (born 15 September 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Arsenal and the Spain national team.
David Raya.note: Raya is the goalkeeper who keeps Spain's first pass clean if Unai Simon is not used. His value is making pressure look like another passing drill.
David Raya.noteZh: 如果西蒙不出场，拉亚是能让西班牙第一脚出球保持干净的门将。他的价值是把压力处理得像一次普通传球练习。

Eric Garcia.name: Eric Garcia
Eric Garcia.summary: Eric García is a Spain centre-back from Barcelona who gives the national team build-up passing, tactical coverage, and calm defending.
Eric Garcia.note: Eric Garcia is defensive cover for a Spain side that wants centre-backs to pass, not only defend. He is there when the buildup needs another calm angle.
Eric Garcia.noteZh: 埃里克·加西亚是西班牙的防守深度，这支球队希望中卫不只是防守，也要传球。当后场组织需要另一个冷静角度时，他有价值。

Fabian Ruiz.name: Fabian Ruiz
Fabian Ruiz.summary: Fabián Ruiz Peña (Spanish pronunciation: [faˈβjan rwiθ ˈpeɲa]; born 3 April 1996), also known simply as Fabián, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Spain national team.
Fabian Ruiz.note: Fabian gives Spain another left-footed controller when the midfield needs patience. He slows the game, then changes the lane before pressure arrives.
Fabian Ruiz.noteZh: 法比安在中场需要耐心时，给西班牙另一名左脚控制者。他先放慢比赛，再在压力到来前改变线路。

Ferran Torres.name: Ferran Torres
Ferran Torres.summary: Ferran Torres García (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈferan ˈtores]; born 29 February 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Ferran Torres.note: Ferran has already made a late winner happen with the assist against Portugal. He is the wide forward who keeps attacking the scoring lane after the move looks finished.
Ferran Torres.noteZh: 费兰已经用对葡萄牙的助攻制造了后段绝杀。他是那种在进攻看似结束后，仍继续冲击得分线路的边锋。

Gavi.name: Gavi
Gavi.summary: Pablo Martín Páez Gavira (born 5 August 2004), known as Gavi, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Gavi.note: Gavi is Spain's pressure switch. If the match gets sleepy, he brings tackles, short combinations, and the kind of edge that makes possession feel alive again.
Gavi.noteZh: 加维是西班牙的压迫开关。如果比赛变得沉闷，他会带来抢断、短传配合，以及让控球重新有生命力的锋芒。

Joan Garcia.name: Joan Garcia
Joan Garcia.summary: Joan Garcia Pons (Catalan: [ʒuˈaŋ ɡəɾˈsiə]; born 4 May 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Joan Garcia.note: Joan Garcia is the high-upside goalkeeper depth. For this tournament card, he is insurance behind the keepers Spain trust to play short.
Joan Garcia.noteZh: 霍安·加西亚是上限很高的门将深度。在这届世界杯的卡片里，他是西班牙短传门将身后的保险。

Marc Cucurella.name: Marc Cucurella
Marc Cucurella.summary: Marc Cucurella Saseta (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈmaɾ(k) kukuˈɾeʎə səˈzɛtə]; born 22 July 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the Spain national team.
Marc Cucurella.note: Cucurella has turned left-back into a source of chances, assisting Oyarzabal twice against Austria. He presses hard, then still appears with the final pass.
Marc Cucurella.noteZh: 库库雷利亚把左后卫变成了机会来源，对奥地利两次助攻奥亚萨瓦尔。他压迫很凶，却仍会出现在最后一传的位置。

Marc Pubill.name: Marc Pubill
Marc Pubill.summary: Marc Pubill Pagès (born 20 June 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Spain national team.
Marc Pubill.note: Pubill gives Spain a taller right-back profile. He is the choice if the flank needs more size without giving up the option to overlap.
Marc Pubill.noteZh: 普比尔给西班牙提供更高大的右后卫类型。如果边路需要更多身高，同时仍保留套边选择，他就有意义。

Marcos Llorente.name: Marcos Llorente
Marcos Llorente.summary: Marcos Llorente Moreno (born 30 January 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or right-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Spain national team.
Marcos Llorente.note: Llorente is Spain's vertical utility piece. His assist against Uruguay fit the role: run beyond the neat passing and make the attack arrive faster.
Marcos Llorente.noteZh: 略伦特是西班牙的纵向多面手。他对乌拉圭的助攻正符合这个角色：跑到精细传递之外，让进攻更快到达。

Martin Zubimendi.name: Martin Zubimendi
Martin Zubimendi.summary: Martín Zubimendi Ibáñez (born 2 February 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and the Spain national team.
Martin Zubimendi.note: Zubimendi is the calm spare hinge behind Rodri. If Spain need control without changing the whole idea, he keeps the first pass simple.
Martin Zubimendi.noteZh: 祖比门迪是罗德里身后的冷静备用枢纽。如果西班牙需要控制但不想改变整体思路，他会让第一脚传球保持简单。

Mikel Merino.name: Mikel Merino
Mikel Merino.summary: Mikel Merino Zazón (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmikel meˈɾino]; born 22 June 1996) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or striker for Premier League club Arsenal and the Spain national team.
Mikel Merino.note: Merino owns Spain's biggest knockout moment so far, the 90+1 winner against Portugal. His game is timing: arrive late, make contact, leave no time to answer.
Mikel Merino.noteZh: 梅里诺拥有西班牙目前最大的淘汰赛时刻，对葡萄牙90+1分钟绝杀。他的比赛关键词是时机：后插上、完成触球、不给对手回应时间。

Pau Cubarsi.name: Pau Cubarsi
Pau Cubarsi.summary: Pau Cubarsí Paredes (born 22 January 2007) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Pau Cubarsi.note: Cubarsi lets Spain keep passing from the back even under pressure. He is young, but the point is how early he sees the forward lane.
Pau Cubarsi.noteZh: 库巴西让西班牙在压力下仍能从后场传出球。他很年轻，但关键在于他很早就能看见向前线路。

Pedro Porro.name: Pedro Porro
Pedro Porro.summary: Pedro Antonio Porro Sauceda (Spanish pronunciation: [peðɾo ˈporo]; born 13 September 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Spain national team.
Pedro Porro.note: Porro has given Spain a scoring right-back in this run. Against Austria, he arrived high enough to finish, not just serve from deep.
Pedro Porro.noteZh: 波罗在这段征程中给西班牙带来能进球的右后卫。对奥地利时，他前插到足够高的位置完成终结，而不只是从深处传球。

Rodri.name: Rodri
Rodri.summary: Rodrigo Hernández Cascante (born 22 June 1996), known as Rodri or Rodrigo, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and captains the Spain national team.
Rodri.note: Rodri is Spain's safety net and traffic controller. When Yamal and the wide players stretch the match, he decides whether Spain speed up or lock it down.
Rodri.noteZh: 罗德里是西班牙的安全网和交通指挥。当亚马尔和边路球员把比赛拉开时，他决定西班牙是加速还是收住。

Unai Simon.name: Unai Simon
Unai Simon.summary: Unai Simón Mendibil (born 11 June 1997) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team.
Unai Simon.note: Unai Simon has been Spain's tournament goalkeeper through the knockout run. His job is to defend space early enough that Spain can keep the back line brave.
Unai Simon.noteZh: 乌奈·西蒙是西班牙淘汰赛阶段的门将。他的任务是尽早处理身后空间，让西班牙防线继续保持勇敢。

Victor Munoz.name: Victor Munoz
Victor Munoz.summary: Víctor Muñoz Villanueva (born 13 July 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for La Liga club Osasuna and the Spain national team. He will join Premier League club Liverpool on 1 July 2026.
Victor Munoz.note: Munoz is a fresh-speed option for Spain's front line. He is there for matches that need one more sprint behind a tired defender.
Victor Munoz.noteZh: 穆尼奥斯是西班牙锋线的新鲜速度选择。当比赛需要再冲一次疲劳防守者身后时，他就有意义。

Yeremy Pino.name: Yeremy Pino
Yeremy Pino.summary: Yéremy Jesús Pino Santos (born 20 October 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the Spain national team.
Yeremy Pino.note: Yeremy is a work-rate winger for Spain's bench. He presses first, then slips inside when the possession chain needs another quick combination.
Yeremy Pino.noteZh: 耶雷米是西班牙替补席上的高跑动边锋。他先压迫，再在控球链条需要快速配合时内收。

Ahmed Fatouh.name: Ahmed Fatouh
Ahmed Fatouh.summary: Ahmed Mohamed Aboelfatouh Mohamed (Arabic: أحمد محمد أبو الفتوح محمد; born 22 March 1998), simply known as Ahmed Fatouh (Arabic: أحمد فتوح), is an Egyptian footballer who plays for Egyptian Premier League side Zamalek and the Egypt national team as a left-back...
Ahmed Fatouh.note: Fatouh has been part of Egypt's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Ahmed Fatouh.noteZh: 他给Egypt后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Haissem Hassan.name: Haissem Hassan
Haissem Hassan.summary: Haissem Yousry Fouad A Hassan (Egyptian Arabic: هيثم يسري فؤاد حسن; born 8 February 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Segunda División club Real Oviedo. Born in France, he plays for the Egypt national team.
Haissem Hassan.note: Hassan has one tournament assist in the bank for Egypt. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Haissem Hassan.noteZh: 他已经帮Egypt制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Hamdy Fathy.name: Hamdy Fathy
Hamdy Fathy.summary: Hamdy Fathy Abdelhalim Abdelfattah (Arabic: حمدي فتحي عبد الحليم عبد الفتاح; born 29 September 1994) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Qatar Stars League club Al-Wakrah and the Egypt national team.
Hamdy Fathy.note: Fathy gives Egypt structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Hamdy Fathy.noteZh: 他给Egypt控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Hamza Abdelkarim.name: Hamza Abdelkarim
Hamza Abdelkarim.summary: Hamza Mohamed Abdelkarim E Selim (Arabic: حمزة محمد عبد الكريم سليم; born 1 January 2008) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Segunda Federación – Group 3 club Barcelona Atlètic and the Egypt national team.
Hamza Abdelkarim.note: Abdelkarim is attacking depth for Egypt. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Hamza Abdelkarim.noteZh: 他是Egypt前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Hossam Abdelmaguid.name: Hossam Abdelmaguid
Hossam Abdelmaguid.summary: Hossam Abdelmageed Abdelsalam Abdelmegeed (Arabic: حسام عبد المجيد عبد السلام عبد المجيد; born 30 April 2001) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Egyptian Premier League club Zamalek and the Egypt national team.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.note: Abdelmaguid gives Egypt cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.noteZh: 他是Egypt后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Ibrahim Adel.name: Ibrahim Adel
Ibrahim Adel.summary: Ibrahim Adel Aly Mohamed Hassan (Arabic: إِبْرَاهِيم عَادِل عَلِيّ مُحَمَّد حَسَن; born 23 April 2001), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays for Danish Superliga club Nordsjælland, on loan from UAE Pro League side Al Jazira as a left winger and the...
Ibrahim Adel.note: Adel gives Egypt a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Ibrahim Adel.noteZh: 他是Egypt在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Karim Hafez.name: Karim Hafez
Karim Hafez.summary: Karim Hafez Ramadan Seifeldin (Arabic: كَرِيم حَافِظ رَمَضَان سَيْف الدِّين; born 12 March 1996) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays for Egyptian Premier League club Pyramids and the Egypt national team as a left-back.
Karim Hafez.note: Hafez has supplied one of Egypt's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Karim Hafez.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Egypt创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Mahdy Soliman.name: Mahdy Soliman
Mahdy Soliman.summary: El Mahdy Mohamed Soliman Ibrahim (Arabic: المهدي محمد سليمان إبراهيم; born 8 June 1987) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Egyptian Premier League side Zamalek SC and the Egypt national team.
Mahdy Soliman.note: Soliman gives Egypt a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Mahdy Soliman.noteZh: 他在Egypt首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Mahmoud Saber.name: Mahmoud Saber
Mahmoud Saber.summary: Mahmoud Saber Abdelmohsen Hassan Abdelmohsen (Arabic: مَحْمُود صَابِر عَبْد الْمُحْسِن حَسَنْ عَبْد الْمُحْسِن; born 30 July 2001) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Egyptian Premier League club ZED on loan from...
Mahmoud Saber.note: Saber is on the scoresheet for Egypt, with his goal coming against IR Iran. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Mahmoud Saber.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Marawan Attia.name: Marawan Attia
Marawan Attia.summary: Marwan Attia Fahim Ghallab (Arabic: مروان عطية فاهم غلاب رشوان; born 1 August 1998) is an Egyptian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.

Mohamed Alaa.note: Alaa is Egypt's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Mohamed Alaa.noteZh: 他是Egypt的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Mohamed El Shenawy.name: Mohamed El Shenawy
Mohamed El Shenawy.summary: Mohamed El Sayed Mohamed El Shenawy Gomaa (Arabic: محمد السيد محمد الشناوي جمعة; born 18 December 1988) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly, which he captains, and the Egypt national team.
Mohamed El Shenawy.note: Shenawy sits behind the starter for Egypt, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Mohamed El Shenawy.noteZh: 他给Egypt保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Mohanad Lashin.name: Mohanad Lashin
Mohanad Lashin.summary: Mohanad Lashin is an Egypt defensive midfielder from Pyramids FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and simple progression.

Mostafa Shoubir.name: Mostafa Shoubir
Mostafa Shoubir.summary: Mostafa Shoubir is an Egypt goalkeeper from Al Ahly who gives the national team reaction saves, line command, and close-range stops.
Mostafa Shoubir.note: Shobeir is the last voice in Egypt's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Mostafa Shoubir.noteZh: 他承担了Egypt的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Nabil Donga.name: Nabil Donga
Nabil Donga.summary: Nabil Emad Aly Elmahdy (Arabic: نبيل عماد علي المهدي; born 6 April 1996) also known as Donga (Arabic: دونجا), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Najma and the Egypt national team.
Nabil Donga.note: Emad gives Egypt a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Nabil Donga.noteZh: 他是Egypt的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ramy Rabia.name: Ramy Rabia
Ramy Rabia.summary: Ramy Hisham Abdel Aziz Mostafa Rabia (Arabic: رامي هشام عبد العزيز مصطفى ربيعة; born 20 May 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for UAE Pro League club Al Ain and the Egypt national team.
Ramy Rabia.note: Rabia is in the quiet-work part of Egypt's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Ramy Rabia.noteZh: 他是Egypt主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Tarek Alaa.name: Tarek Alaa
Tarek Alaa.summary: Tarek Alaa is an Egypt right-back from ZED FC who gives the national team right-side defending, overlap energy, and recovery runs.
Tarek Alaa.note: Alaa is defensive cover for Egypt's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Tarek Alaa.noteZh: 他是Egypt在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Yasser Ibrahim.name: Yasser Ibrahim
Yasser Ibrahim.summary: Yasser Ibrahim Ahmed El Hanafi (Arabic: يَاسِر إبرَاهِيْم أَحمَد الْحَنَفِي; born 10 February 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Yasser Ibrahim.note: Ibrahim already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Argentina. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Zizo.name: Zizo
Zizo.summary: Ahmed Mostafa Mohamed Sayed (Arabic: أحمد مصطفى محمد سيد; born 10 January 1996) commonly known as Zizo (Arabic: زيزو), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Zizo.note: Zizo is one of Egypt's named attacking routes in this tournament. His job is to make the first defender move so the finish or final pass can appear.
Zizo.noteZh: 他给Egypt一种把控球变成压力的路线。他要让防守者必须做选择。

Ali Alipour.name: Ali Alipour
Ali Alipour.summary: Ali Alipour (Persian: علی علیپور; born 11 November 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a Striker for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Ali Alipour.note: Alipour is an attacking change-up for IR Iran. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 他是IR Iran的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Ali Nemati.name: Ali Nemati
Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.
Ali Nemati.note: team has been part of IR Iran's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Ali Nemati.noteZh: 他给IR Iran后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Alireza Beiranvand.name: Alireza Beiranvand
Alireza Beiranvand.summary: Alireza Safar Beiranvand (born 21 September 1992) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Persian Gulf Pro League club Tractor and the Iran national team.
Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand has carried the keeper minutes for IR Iran. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Alireza Beiranvand.noteZh: 他是IR Iran防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.name: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.note: S.C is the forward IR Iran can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.noteZh: 他给IR Iran替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.name: Amirmohammad Razaghinia
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.summary: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia is an IR Iran central midfielder from Esteghlal FC who gives the national team midfield legs, duel pressure, and simple progression.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.note: Razzaghinia gives IR Iran a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.noteZh: 他是IR Iran的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Arya Yousefi.name: Arya Yousefi
Arya Yousefi.summary: Arya Yousefi is an IR Iran right-back from Sepahan FC who gives the national team overlap timing, recovery defending, and right-side energy.
Arya Yousefi.note: G is the kind of defender IR Iran can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Arya Yousefi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Danial Iri.name: Danial Iri
Danial Iri.summary: Danial Eiri is an IR Iran centre-back from Malavan Bandar Anzali who gives the national team centre-back depth, aerial defending, and box protection.
Danial Iri.note: Eiri is back-line insurance for IR Iran. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Danial Iri.noteZh: 他给IR Iran那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Dennis Dargahi.note: Ayensa is the forward IR Iran can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.

Hossein Hosseini.summary: Seyed Hossein Hosseini (Persian: سید حسین حسینی; born 30 June 1992) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Persian Gulf Pro League club Sepahan and the Iran national team.
Hossein Hosseini.note: Hosseini is goalkeeper cover for IR Iran. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Hossein Hosseini.noteZh: 他是IR Iran门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Hossein Kanani.name: Hossein Kanani
Hossein Kanani.summary: Mohammad Hossein Kanaanizadegan (Persian: محمد حسین کنعانی زادگان; born 23 March 1994), known as Hossein Kanaani, is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and Iran national team.
Hossein Kanani.note: Kanaanizadegan gives IR Iran defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Hossein Kanani.noteZh: 他是IR Iran艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mehdi Ghayedi.name: Mehdi Ghayedi

Milad Mohammadi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Payam Niazmand.name: Payam Niazmand

Roozbeh Cheshmi.name: Roozbeh Cheshmi

Roozbeh Cheshmi.note: Cheshmi gives IR Iran cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Roozbeh Cheshmi.noteZh: 他是IR Iran后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Saeid Ezatolahi.name: Saeid Ezatolahi
Saeid Ezatolahi.summary: Saeid Ezatolahi Afagh (Persian: سعید عزت‌اللهی آفاق; born 1 October 1996) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for club Shabab Al Ahli in UAE Pro League and the Iran national team.

Saleh Hardani.name: Saleh Hardani

Shoja Khalilzadeh.name: Shoja Khalilzadeh
Shoja Khalilzadeh.summary: Shojae Khalilzadeh (Persian: شجاع خلیل‌زاده; born 14 May 1989) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Persian Gulf Pro League club Tractor and Iran national team. He is known for his pace, artistic tackles and positional sense.
Shoja Khalilzadeh.note: Khalilzadeh is in the quiet-work part of IR Iran's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Shoja Khalilzadeh.noteZh: 他是IR Iran主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Alex Paulsen.name: Alex Paulsen
Alex Paulsen.summary: Alexander Noah Paulsen (born 4 July 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for I liga club Lechia Gdańsk, on loan from Bournemouth, and the New Zealand national team.
Alex Paulsen.note: Paulsen is goalkeeper cover for New Zealand. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Alex Paulsen.noteZh: 他是New Zealand门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Alex Rufer.name: Alex Rufer
Alex Rufer.summary: Alex Arthur Rufer (/ˈɹuːfə(ɹ)/; born 12 June 1996) is a New Zealand professional footballer who captains and plays as a defensive midfielder for Wellington Phoenix in the A-League. Born in Switzerland, he represents the New Zealand national team.
Alex Rufer.note: Rufer gives New Zealand a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Alex Rufer.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ben Old.name: Ben Old
Ben Old.summary: Benjamin Craig Old (born 13 August 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ligue 2 club Saint-Étienne and the New Zealand national team.
Ben Old.note: Old gives New Zealand a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Ben Old.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ben Waine.name: Ben Waine
Ben Waine.summary: Benjamin Peter Waine (born 11 June 2001) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Port Vale and the New Zealand national team.
Ben Waine.note: Waine is an attacking change-up for New Zealand. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Ben Waine.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Callan Elliot.name: Callan Elliot
Callan Elliot.summary: Callan Rennie Elliot (born 7 July 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a right back for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Callan Elliot.note: Elliot gives New Zealand another trusted body for the awkward minutes. One clean decision can keep the match from tilting.
Callan Elliot.noteZh: 他是New Zealand赛事深度的一部分。压力下还能让简单选择出现，这就是这张卡的意义。

Callum McCowatt.name: Callum McCowatt
Callum McCowatt.summary: Callum William McCowatt (born 30 April 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Danish Superliga club Silkeborg and the New Zealand national team.
Callum McCowatt.note: McCowatt is the forward New Zealand can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Callum McCowatt.noteZh: 他给New Zealand替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Francis De Vries.name: Francis De Vries
Francis De Vries.summary: Francis de Vries (Dutch: [ˈfrɑn.sɪs də ˈvrizə]; born 28 November 1994) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Francis De Vries.note: Vries is the kind of defender New Zealand can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Francis De Vries.noteZh: 他是New Zealand艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Jesse Randall.name: Jesse Randall
Jesse Randall.summary: Jesse Carmichael Randall (born 19 August 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United and the New Zealand national team.
Jesse Randall.note: Randall is the forward New Zealand can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Jesse Randall.noteZh: 他给New Zealand替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Joe Bell.name: Joe Bell
Joe Bell.summary: Joe Zen Robert Bell (born 27 April 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eliteserien club Viking and the New Zealand national team.
Joe Bell.note: Bell is a tempo player for New Zealand. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Joe Bell.noteZh: 他让New Zealand在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Kosta Barbarouses.name: Kosta Barbarouses
Kosta Barbarouses.summary: Konstantinos "Kosta" Barbarouses (Greek: Κωνσταντίνος "Κώστας" Μπαρμπαρούσης, pronounced [konstaˈndinos barbaruˈsis]; born 19 February 1990) is a New Zealand professional footballer who last played as a winger for A-League Men club Western Sydney Wanderers and...
Kosta Barbarouses.note: Barbarouses gives New Zealand a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Kosta Barbarouses.noteZh: 他是New Zealand在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Lachlan Bayliss.name: Lachlan Bayliss
Lachlan Bayliss.summary: Lachlan Ryan Bayliss (born 24 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for A-League Men side Auckland FC. Born in Australia, he represents the New Zealand national team.
Lachlan Bayliss.note: Bayliss gives New Zealand a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Lachlan Bayliss.noteZh: 他是New Zealand的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Logan Rogerson.name: Logan Rogerson
Logan Rogerson.summary: Logan Tipene Rogerson (Māori: [ˈti.pɛ.nɛ]; born 28 May 1998) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a winger for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Logan Rogerson.note: Rogerson is the forward New Zealand can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Logan Rogerson.noteZh: 他给New Zealand替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Marko Stamenic.name: Marko Stamenic
Marko Stamenic.summary: Marko Seufatu Nikola Stamenić (Serbian Cyrillic: Марко Сеуфату Никола Стаменић; born 19 February 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the New Zealand national team.
Marko Stamenic.note: Stamenic gives New Zealand structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Marko Stamenic.noteZh: 他给New Zealand控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Max Crocombe.name: Max Crocombe
Max Crocombe.summary: Maxime Teremoana Crocombe (born 12 August 1993) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Millwall and the New Zealand national team.
Max Crocombe.note: Crocombe is the last voice in New Zealand's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Max Crocombe.noteZh: 他承担了New Zealand的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Michael Boxall.name: Michael Boxall
Michael Boxall.summary: Michael Joseph Boxall (born 18 August 1988) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Minnesota United and the New Zealand national team.
Michael Boxall.note: Boxall gives New Zealand defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Michael Boxall.noteZh: 他是New Zealand后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Michael Woud.name: Michael Woud
Michael Woud.summary: Michael Cornelis Woud (Dutch: [ʋʌut]; born 16 January 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Michael Woud.note: Woud sits behind the starter for New Zealand, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Michael Woud.noteZh: 他给New Zealand保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Nando Pijnaker.name: Nando Pijnaker
Nando Pijnaker.summary: Nando Zen Pijnaker (Dutch: [ˈnɑndo zɛn ˈpɛi̯.nɑ.kər]; born 25 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre back for A-League Men club Auckland FC. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the New Zealand national team.
Nando Pijnaker.note: Pijnaker is part of New Zealand's tournament depth. His card is about making the simple play feel available under pressure.
Nando Pijnaker.noteZh: 他是New Zealand赛事深度的一部分。压力下还能让简单选择出现，这就是这张卡的意义。

Ryan Thomas.name: Ryan Thomas
Ryan Thomas.summary: Ryan Jared Thomas (born 20 December 1994) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle and the New Zealand national team.
Ryan Thomas.note: Thomas matters for New Zealand when possession reaches crowded areas. He is there to turn a small opening into a real choice.
Ryan Thomas.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对New Zealand来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Tim Payne.name: Tim Payne
Tim Payne.summary: Tim Payne is a New Zealand right-back from Wellington Phoenix who gives the national team right-back reliability, wide defending, and overlap support.
Tim Payne.note: Payne has one tournament assist in the bank for New Zealand. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Tim Payne.noteZh: 他已经帮New Zealand制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Tommy Smith.name: Tommy Smith
Tommy Smith.summary: Tommy Smith is a New Zealand centre-back from Auckland FC who gives the national team experience, aerial duels, and back-line organization.
Tommy Smith.note: Smith is defensive cover for New Zealand's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Tommy Smith.noteZh: 他是New Zealand在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Tyler Bindon.name: Tyler Bindon
Tyler Bindon.summary: Tyler Grant Bindon (born 27 January 2005) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League side Nottingham Forest, and the New Zealand national team.
Tyler Bindon.note: Bindon is the kind of defender New Zealand can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Tyler Bindon.noteZh: 他是New Zealand艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Alexis Saelemaekers.name: Alexis Saelemaekers
Alexis Saelemaekers.summary: Alexis Jesse M. Saelemaekers (born 27 June 1999) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a winger or wing-back for Serie A club AC Milan and the Belgium national team.
Alexis Saelemaekers.note: Saelemaekers gives Belgium running balance on the outside. His late goal against New Zealand showed he can still arrive after doing the less glamorous work.
Alexis Saelemaekers.noteZh: 萨勒马克尔斯给比利时边路提供跑动平衡。他对新西兰的后段进球说明，做完不显眼的工作后，他仍能到位。

Amadou Onana.name: Amadou Onana
Amadou Onana.summary: Amadou Ba Zeund Georges Mvom Onana (born 16 August 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Aston Villa. Born in Senegal, he represents the Belgium national team.
Amadou Onana.note: Onana gives Belgium size in midfield when games become about second balls. Against Spain, his value is making the first contact hard enough for De Bruyne to play after it.
Amadou Onana.noteZh: 奥纳纳在比赛变成第二落点争夺时给比利时中场提供身材。对西班牙时，他的价值是把第一下对抗做硬，让德布劳内能在之后处理球。

Arthur Theate.name: Arthur Theate
Arthur Theate.summary: Arthur Nicolas R. Theate (born 25 May 2000) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Belgium national team.
Arthur Theate.note: Theate is left-side defensive strength for a Belgium back line that has rotated often. He helps when the match asks for contact more than clean buildup.
Arthur Theate.noteZh: 泰特是比利时轮换后防中的左侧力量点。当比赛更需要身体对抗而不是干净组织时，他能帮上忙。

Axel Witsel.name: Axel Witsel
Axel Witsel.summary: Axel Laurent Angel Lambert Witsel (born 12 January 1989) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for Segunda División club Girona and the Belgium national team.
Axel Witsel.note: Witsel is Belgium's emergency calm. If the match starts moving too fast, he gives them the veteran pass and position that lower the temperature.
Axel Witsel.noteZh: 维特塞尔是比利时的紧急冷静按钮。如果比赛开始过快，他用老将的传球和站位帮球队降温。

Brandon Mechele.name: Brandon Mechele
Brandon Mechele.summary: Brandon Erik Mechele (born 28 January 1993) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Belgian Pro League side Club Brugge and the Belgium national team.
Brandon Mechele.note: Mechele has been a regular centre-back through Belgium's run. His job is not fancy: clear the first ball, organize the box, and let the creators decide the other end.
Brandon Mechele.noteZh: 梅赫勒是比利时这段征程中的常规中卫。他的任务并不花哨：处理第一点、组织禁区，再让进攻端的创造者决定比赛。

Charles De Ketelaere.name: Charles De Ketelaere
Charles De Ketelaere.summary: Charles Marc S. De Ketelaere (Dutch pronunciation: [də ˈkeːtəˌlaːrə]; born 10 March 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for Serie A club Atalanta and the Belgium national team.
Charles De Ketelaere.note: De Ketelaere turned the United States match with two early goals and an assist. He gives Belgium height up front without making the attack feel stiff.
Charles De Ketelaere.noteZh: 德凯特拉雷用两个早段进球和一次助攻改变了对美国的比赛。他给比利时锋线提供身高，却不会让进攻变得僵硬。

Diego Moreira.name: Diego Moreira
Diego Moreira.summary: Diego Manuel Jadon da Silva Moreira (Portuguese pronunciation: [diˈɛɣu muˈɾɐjɾɐ]; born 6 August 2004), also known as Moreira Jr., is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left-back, left wing-back or left midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg and...
Diego Moreira.note: Moreira is Belgium's left-side speed card from the bench. He matters if Spain pin Belgium back and the first outlet has to travel fast.
Diego Moreira.noteZh: 莫雷拉是比利时替补席上的左侧速度牌。如果西班牙把比利时压回去，而第一条出路必须很快，他就有价值。

Dodi Lukebakio.name: Dodi Lukebakio
Dodi Lukebakio.summary: Dodi Lukébakio Ngandoli (born 24 September 1997) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right winger or right midfielder for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Belgium national team.
Dodi Lukebakio.note: Lukebakio has become the direct wide runner in Belgium's knockout mix. Even when he misses, like the bar before the Senegal penalty, he changes the pressure.
Dodi Lukebakio.noteZh: 卢克巴基奥已经成为比利时淘汰赛组合中的直接边路跑动点。即使没有进球，比如对塞内加尔点球前击中横梁，他也会改变压力。

Hans Vanaken.name: Hans Vanaken
Hans Vanaken.summary: Hans Vanaken (born 24 August 1992) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Belgian Pro League club Club Brugge and the Belgium national team.
Hans Vanaken.note: Vanaken has given Belgium late height and timing, scoring against the United States and setting up Lukaku. He arrives when defenders are already watching the ball.
Hans Vanaken.noteZh: 瓦纳肯给比利时比赛后段带来身高和时机，对美国进球并助攻卢卡库。他会在防守者已经盯球时到达。

Joaquin Seys.name: Joaquin Seys
Joaquin Seys.summary: Joaquin Ronny Seys (born 28 March 2005) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Belgian Pro League club Club Brugge and the Belgium national team.
Joaquin Seys.note: Seys is young full-back energy for Belgium. His path is late minutes, outside pressure, and keeping the flank from feeling tired.
Joaquin Seys.noteZh: 塞斯是比利时年轻的边后卫活力。他的路径是后段出场、边路施压，并让这一侧不显得疲劳。

Koni De Winter.name: Koni De Winter
Koni De Winter.summary: Koni De Winter (born 12 June 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as centre-back for Serie A club AC Milan and the Belgium national team.
Koni De Winter.note: De Winter is mobile defensive cover if Belgium need another passer at the back. He gives them a cleaner exit without losing too much range.
Koni De Winter.noteZh: 德温特是比利时需要后场多一名出球者时的机动防守深度。他能提供更干净的出路，同时不损失太多覆盖范围。

Matias Fernandez-Pardo.name: Matias Fernandez-Pardo
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.summary: Matias Fernandez-Pardo (born 3 February 2005) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder or forward for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.note: Fernandez-Pardo is a late wide-speed option. Belgium would use him when the match has opened and tired full-backs can be made to turn again.
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.noteZh: 费尔南德斯-帕尔多是比赛后段的边路速度选择。当比赛已经打开、疲劳边后卫还要再次转身时，比利时会用到他。

Maxim De Cuyper.name: Maxim De Cuyper
Maxim De Cuyper.summary: Maxim Peter M. De Cuyper (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmɑksɪm də ˈkœypər]; born 22 December 2000) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a full-back or left midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Belgium national team.
Maxim De Cuyper.note: De Cuyper has settled into Belgium's left-back role in the knockouts. He gives them service from deep and enough recovery work to survive counters.
Maxim De Cuyper.noteZh: 德库伊佩尔已经在淘汰赛中稳住比利时左后卫位置。他提供深处传球，也有足够回追来应对反击。

Mike Penders.name: Mike Penders
Mike Penders.summary: Mike Louis Penders (born 31 July 2005) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Chelsea and the Belgium national team.
Mike Penders.note: Penders is young goalkeeper depth behind Courtois and Lammens. For this tournament, his role is insurance rather than a likely match story.
Mike Penders.noteZh: 彭德斯是库尔图瓦和拉门斯身后的年轻门将深度。在这届世界杯中，他更像保险，而不是马上会成为比赛主线的人。

Nathan Ngoy.name: Nathan Ngoy
Nathan Ngoy.summary: Nathan Ngoy (born 10 June 2003) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Nathan Ngoy.note: Ngoy has started several matches as Belgium's athletic centre-back. He gives them recovery runs when the game gets stretched around De Bruyne's riskier passes.
Nathan Ngoy.noteZh: 恩戈伊已经多次作为比利时运动型中卫首发。当德布劳内更冒险的传球让比赛被拉开时，他提供回追能力。

Nicolas Raskin.name: Nicolas Raskin
Nicolas Raskin.summary: Nicolas Thierry Y. Raskin (born 23 February 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Rangers and the Belgium national team.
Nicolas Raskin.note: Raskin gave Belgium a key assist for Lukaku against New Zealand. He is the midfield bite who tries to turn a loose touch into a forward pass.
Nicolas Raskin.noteZh: 拉斯金对新西兰为卢卡库送出关键助攻。他是有咬劲的中场，试图把一次松散触球变成向前传球。

Senne Lammens.name: Senne Lammens
Senne Lammens.summary: Senne Lammens (Dutch: ['sɛnə 'lɑməns]; born 7 July 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester United and the Belgium national team. Lammens commenced his senior football career at Club Brugge.
Senne Lammens.note: Lammens is Belgium's big goalkeeper cover. He is there if the match asks for reach, crosses, and a calmer penalty-area presence behind Courtois.
Senne Lammens.noteZh: 拉门斯是比利时高大型门将保障。如果比赛需要覆盖范围、处理传中，以及库尔图瓦身后的冷静禁区存在感，他就有价值。

Thibaut Courtois.name: Thibaut Courtois
Thibaut Courtois.summary: Thibaut Nicolas Marc Courtois (French pronunciation: [tibo kuʁtwa]; Dutch pronunciation: [ˈtiboː kurˈtʋaː]; born 11 May 1992) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Belgium national team.
Thibaut Courtois.note: Courtois gives Belgium the freedom to survive messy stretches. Against Spain, one reaction save can matter as much as anything De Bruyne creates.
Thibaut Courtois.noteZh: 库尔图瓦让比利时有能力熬过混乱阶段。对西班牙时，一次反应扑救可能和德布劳内创造的机会一样重要。

Thomas Meunier.name: Thomas Meunier
Thomas Meunier.summary: Thomas André A. Meunier (French pronunciation: [tɔma mønje]; born 12 September 1991) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Thomas Meunier.note: Meunier's cross reopened the Senegal comeback for Lukaku. He is the veteran wide player Belgium trust when the box needs one more high ball.
Thomas Meunier.noteZh: 默尼耶的传中为卢卡库打开了逆转塞内加尔的门。他是比利时在禁区还需要一次高球时信任的老将边路。

Timothy Castagne.name: Timothy Castagne
Timothy Castagne.summary: Timothy Castagne (French pronunciation: [timɔti kastaɲ]; born 5 December 1995) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a full back for Premier League club Fulham and the Belgium national team.
Timothy Castagne.note: Castagne has switched defensive jobs without changing Belgium's plan. He gives them a full-back who can survive either flank while the attack rotates ahead.
Timothy Castagne.noteZh: 卡斯塔涅在比利时防线中换过职责，却不改变球队计划。他让球队拥有能应付两侧的边后卫，身前进攻也能轮换。

Youri Tielemans.name: Youri Tielemans
Youri Tielemans.summary: Youri Marion A. Tielemans (born 7 May 1997) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Aston Villa and captains the Belgium national team.
Youri Tielemans.note: Tielemans owns Belgium's wildest moment so far, the equalizer and 120+5 penalty against Senegal. His value is the calm shot when the match is anything but calm.
Youri Tielemans.noteZh: 蒂勒曼斯拥有比利时目前最疯狂的时刻，对塞内加尔扳平并在120+5分钟罚进点球。他的价值是在比赛完全不冷静时，仍能冷静射门。

Zeno Debast.name: Zeno Debast
Zeno Debast.summary: Zeno Koen Debast (born 24 October 2003) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Belgium national team. Primarily a centre-back, he can also be deployed as a defensive midfielder.
Zeno Debast.note: Debast is Belgium's passing centre-back option. If Spain force long defensive spells, he can help the first pass come out cleaner.
Zeno Debast.noteZh: 德巴斯特是比利时的传球型中卫选择。如果西班牙迫使比利时长时间防守，他能让第一脚出球更干净。

Alberto Quintero.name: Alberto Quintero
Alberto Quintero.summary: Alberto Abdiel Quintero Medina (born 18 December 1987) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays for C.D. Plaza Amador and the Panama national team as a winger.
Alberto Quintero.note: Quintero gives Panama a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Alberto Quintero.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Andres Andrade.name: Andres Andrade
Andres Andrade.summary: Andrés Alberto Andrade Cedeño (born 16 October 1998) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Austrian Football Bundesliga club LASK and the Panama national team.
Andres Andrade.note: Andrade is in the quiet-work part of Panama's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Andres Andrade.noteZh: 他是Panama主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Anibal Godoy.name: Anibal Godoy
Anibal Godoy.summary: Aníbal Casis Godoy Lemus (Spanish: [aˈniβal ɣoˈðoj]; born 10 February 1990) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and captains the Panama national team.
Anibal Godoy.note: Godoy gives Panama a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Anibal Godoy.noteZh: 他是Panama的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Azarias Londono.name: Azarias Londono
Azarias Londono.summary: Azarias Emmanuel Londoño González (born 21 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as forward for Universidad Católica, on loan from Alianza, and the Panama national team.
Azarias Londono.note: Londoño is an attacking change-up for Panama. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Azarias Londono.noteZh: 他是Panama的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Carlos Harvey.name: Carlos Harvey
Carlos Harvey.summary: Carlos Miguel Harvey Cesneros (born 3 February 2000) is a Panamaian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club Minnesota United FC and the Panama national team.
Carlos Harvey.note: Harvey gives Panama structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Carlos Harvey.noteZh: 他给Panama控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Cecilio Waterman.name: Cecilio Waterman
Cecilio Waterman.summary: Cecilio Alfonso Waterman Ruiz (born 13 April 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Chilean club Universidad de Concepción and the Panama national team.
Cecilio Waterman.note: Waterman is attacking depth for Panama. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Cecilio Waterman.noteZh: 他是Panama前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Cesar Blackman.name: Cesar Blackman
Cesar Blackman.summary: César Rodolfo Blackman Camarena (born 2 April 1998) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Slovak First Football League club Slovan Bratislava and the Panama national team.
Cesar Blackman.note: Blackman gives Panama defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Cesar Blackman.noteZh: 他是Panama艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Cesar Samudio.name: Cesar Samudio
Cesar Samudio.summary: César Jair Samudio Murillo (born 23 February 1994) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Honduran side Marathón and the Panama national team.
Cesar Samudio.note: Samudio is Panama's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Cesar Samudio.noteZh: 他是Panama的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Cesar Yanis.name: Cesar Yanis
Cesar Yanis.summary: César Augusto Yanis Velasco (born 28 January 1996) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as left winger for Chilean club Cobresal, on loan from Costa Rican club San Carlos, and the Panama national team.
Cesar Yanis.note: Yanis gives Panama a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Cesar Yanis.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Cristian Martinez.name: Cristian Martinez
Cristian Martinez.summary: Cristian Jesús Martínez (born 6 February 1997) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Israeli Premier League club Ironi Kiryat Shmona and the Panama national team.
Cristian Martinez.note: Martínez gives Panama structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Cristian Martinez.noteZh: 他给Panama控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Edgar Yoel Barcenas.name: Edgar Yoel Barcenas
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.summary: Édgar Yoel Bárcenas Herrera (born 23 October 1993) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Panama national team.
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.note: Bárcenas has been part of Panama's front-line plan. He stretches defenders first, then looks for the touch that turns pressure into a chance.
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.noteZh: 他是Panama前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Edgardo Farina.name: Edgardo Farina
Edgardo Farina.summary: Edgardo Issac Fariña Wynter (born 19 October 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Russian Premier League club Pari Nizhny Novgorod and the Panama national team.
Edgardo Farina.note: Fariña is the kind of defender Panama can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Edgardo Farina.noteZh: 他是Panama艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Eric Davis.name: Eric Davis
Eric Davis.summary: Eric Javier Davis Grajales (born 31 March 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Plaza Amador and the Panama national team.
Eric Davis.note: Davis is defensive cover for Panama's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Eric Davis.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Fidel Escobar.name: Fidel Escobar
Fidel Escobar.summary: Fidel Escobar Mendieta (born 9 January 1995) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga FPD club Saprissa and the Panama national team.
Fidel Escobar.note: Escobar is back-line insurance for Panama. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Fidel Escobar.noteZh: 他给Panama那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Jiovany Ramos.name: Jiovany Ramos
Jiovany Ramos.summary: Jiovany Javier Ramos Díaz (born 26 January 1997) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Venezuelan Primera División side Puerto Cabello, on loan from CAI, and the Panama national team.
Jiovany Ramos.note: Ramos gives Panama defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Jiovany Ramos.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Jorge Gutierrez.name: Jorge Gutierrez
Jorge Gutierrez.summary: Jorge Abdiel Gutiérrez Cornejo (born 1 September 1998) is a Panamanian football player who plays as left-back for Deportivo La Guaira, and the Panama national team.
Jorge Gutierrez.note: Gutiérrez gives Panama cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Jorge Gutierrez.noteZh: 他是Panama后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jose Cordoba.name: Jose Cordoba
Jose Cordoba.summary: José Ángel Córdoba Chambers (born 3 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Panama national team.
Jose Cordoba.note: Córdoba has been part of Panama's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Jose Cordoba.noteZh: 他在Panama体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Jose Fajardo.name: Jose Fajardo
Jose Fajardo.summary: José Fajardo Nelson (born 18 August 1993) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a forward for Universidad Catolica del Ecuador on loan from CAI and the Panama national team.
Jose Fajardo.note: Fajardo is an attacking change-up for Panama. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Jose Fajardo.noteZh: 他是Panama的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Jose Luis Rodriguez.name: Jose Luis Rodriguez
Jose Luis Rodriguez.summary: José Luis Rodríguez Francis (born 19 June 1998), commonly known as Puma, is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Liga MX club Juárez and the Panama national team.
Jose Luis Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez gives Panama a front-line rhythm that keeps defenders facing their own goal. His value often starts before the ball reaches him.
Jose Luis Rodriguez.noteZh: 他给Panama替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Luis Mejia.name: Luis Mejia
Luis Mejia.summary: Luis Ricardo Mejía Cajar (born 16 March 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Uruguayan Primera División club Nacional and the Panama national team.
Luis Mejia.note: Mejía sits behind the starter for Panama, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Luis Mejia.noteZh: 他给Panama保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Orlando Mosquera.name: Orlando Mosquera
Orlando Mosquera.summary: Orlando Mosquera (born 25 December 1994), commonly known as Kuty Mosquera, is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Saudi Pro League club Al-Fayha and the Panama national team.
Orlando Mosquera.note: Mosquera has carried the keeper minutes for Panama. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Orlando Mosquera.noteZh: 他是Panama防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Roderick Miller.name: Roderick Miller
Roderick Miller.summary: Roderick Alonso Miller Molina (born 3 April 1992) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Azerbaijan Premier League club Turan Tovuz and the Panama national team.
Roderick Miller.note: Miller is defensive cover for Panama's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Roderick Miller.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Tomas Rodriguez.name: Tomas Rodriguez
Tomas Rodriguez.summary: Tomás Abdiel Rodríguez Mena (born 9 March 1999) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a forward for Monagas and Panama national team.
Tomas Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez is the forward Panama can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Tomas Rodriguez.noteZh: 他给Panama替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Anthony Gordon.name: Anthony Gordon
Anthony Gordon.summary: Anthony Michael Gordon (born 24 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays primarily as a winger for Premier League club Newcastle United and the England national team.
Anthony Gordon.note: Gordon has become England's late-game accelerator, assisting both Kane goals against DR Congo. He makes tired defenders face one more sprint and one more cross.
Anthony Gordon.noteZh: 戈登已经成为英格兰比赛后段的加速器，对刚果民主共和国两次助攻凯恩。他让疲劳防守者再面对一次冲刺和一次传中。

Bukayo Saka.name: Bukayo Saka
Bukayo Saka.summary: Bukayo Ayoyinka Temidayo Moses Saka (, born 5 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.
Bukayo Saka.note: Saka has supplied England's biggest runners, assisting Rashford and Bellingham. Even managed carefully, his first touch gives England a cleaner final action.
Bukayo Saka.noteZh: 萨卡已经为英格兰最重要的跑动者送出助攻，包括拉什福德和贝林厄姆。即使被谨慎管理，他的第一下触球也让英格兰最后一脚更干净。

Dan Burn.name: Dan Burn
Dan Burn.summary: Daniel Johnson Burn (born 9 May 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Newcastle United and the England national team.
Dan Burn.note: Burn is England's size card on the left side of defense. He matters if Norway turn the match into crosses, set pieces, and Haaland traffic.
Dan Burn.noteZh: 伯恩是英格兰左侧防线的身材牌。如果挪威把比赛变成传中、定位球和哈兰德周围的混战，他就有价值。

Dean Henderson.name: Dean Henderson
Dean Henderson.summary: Dean Bradley Henderson (born 12 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Crystal Palace, whom he captains, and the England national team.
Dean Henderson.note: Henderson is England's sharp goalkeeper cover behind Pickford. His role is readiness: claim crosses, restart quickly, and keep the box loud.
Dean Henderson.noteZh: 亨德森是皮克福德身后的敏锐门将保障。他的角色是随时准备：摘传中、快速重新开球，并让禁区保持清晰指挥。

Djed Spence.name: Djed Spence
Djed Spence.summary: Diop Tehuti Djed-Hotep Spence (born 9 August 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the England national team.
Djed Spence.note: Spence has been used for right-back speed in England's rotation. He is there when the flank needs a runner who can chase forward and back.
Djed Spence.noteZh: 斯彭斯在英格兰轮换中提供右后卫速度。当边路需要能前后都追的跑动者时，他就有意义。

Eberechi Eze.name: Eberechi Eze
Eberechi Eze.summary: Eberechi Oluchi "Ebere" Eze ( ə-BAIR-ə-tchee EZ-ə ; born 29 June 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.
Eberechi Eze.note: Eze is England's dribble answer when the block refuses to move. He changes the angle himself instead of waiting for the pass to do it.
Eberechi Eze.noteZh: 当对手低位不动时，埃泽是英格兰的带球答案。他会自己改变角度，而不是等传球来改变。

Elliot Anderson.name: Elliot Anderson
Elliot Anderson.summary: Elliot Junior Anderson (born 6 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the England national team.
Elliot Anderson.note: Anderson has quietly started much of England's run and assisted Bellingham against Croatia. He keeps the midfield pressure alive without demanding the spotlight.
Elliot Anderson.noteZh: 安德森安静地首发了英格兰多场比赛，并在对克罗地亚时助攻贝林厄姆。他不抢镜，却让中场压力持续存在。

Ezri Konsa.name: Ezri Konsa
Ezri Konsa.summary: Ezri Ngoyo Konsa (born 23 October 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for Premier League club Aston Villa and the England national team.
Ezri Konsa.note: Konsa has been England's steady centre-back through the run. His value is clean positioning while the full-backs and midfielders take the louder roles.
Ezri Konsa.noteZh: 孔萨是英格兰这段征程中的稳定中卫。他的价值是干净站位，让边后卫和中场承担更显眼的任务。

Ivan Toney.name: Ivan Toney
Ivan Toney.summary: Ivan Benjamin Elijah Toney (born 16 March 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli and the England national team.
Ivan Toney.note: Toney is the physical forward route if England need to change the game state. He gives Kane support, penalty-box contact, and another set-piece target.
Ivan Toney.noteZh: 如果英格兰需要改变比赛状态，托尼是身体型前锋路线。他给凯恩支援、禁区对抗，也提供另一个定位球目标。

James Trafford.name: James Trafford
James Trafford.summary: James Harrington Trafford (born 10 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.
James Trafford.note: Trafford is young goalkeeper depth for England. This tournament card is about cover and distribution upside, not a likely quarter-final role.
James Trafford.noteZh: 特拉福德是英格兰年轻门将深度。这届赛事中，他的卡片更多是保障和出球潜力，而不是八强战主线。

Jarell Quansah.name: Jarell Quansah
Jarell Quansah.summary: Jarell Amorin Quansah (born 29 January 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the England national team.
Jarell Quansah.note: Quansah has filled the right-back slot in England's rotation despite being a centre-back by trade. That tells you the staff value his calm and size.
Jarell Quansah.noteZh: 宽萨虽然本职是中卫，却在英格兰轮换中补过右后卫。这说明教练组看重他的冷静和身材。

John Stones.name: John Stones
John Stones.summary: John Stones (born 28 May 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.
John Stones.note: Stones is England's route from defense into midfield when he is used. He gives the back line a passer who can step forward without making it look risky.
John Stones.noteZh: 斯通斯出场时，是英格兰从防线进入中场的路线。他给后防线提供一名能前顶传球、却不显得冒险的球员。

Jordan Henderson.name: Jordan Henderson
Jordan Henderson.summary: Jordan Brian Henderson (born 17 June 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Brentford and the England national team. He is known for his leadership, versatility, and physicality.
Jordan Henderson.note: Henderson is England's game-management voice. If the last 20 minutes get ragged, he gives the midfield instructions as much as touches.
Jordan Henderson.noteZh: 亨德森是英格兰管理比赛的声音。如果最后20分钟变得混乱，他给中场的不只是触球，还有指令。

Jordan Pickford.name: Jordan Pickford
Jordan Pickford.summary: Jordan Lee Pickford (né Logan; born 7 March 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Everton and the England national team.
Jordan Pickford.note: Pickford remains England's tournament keeper. The saves matter, but so does the direct pass that lets England skip pressure and find Kane early.
Jordan Pickford.noteZh: 皮克福德依然是英格兰的赛事门将。扑救很重要，但他直接找凯恩、帮助球队跳过压力的传球同样重要。

Kobbie Mainoo.name: Kobbie Mainoo
Kobbie Mainoo.summary: Kobbie Boateng Mainoo (; born 19 April 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United and the England national team. He is known for his dribbling and composure.
Kobbie Mainoo.note: Mainoo is England's calm-in-traffic midfielder. If Norway's pressure arrives through the middle, he can carry out instead of forcing the first pass.
Kobbie Mainoo.noteZh: 梅努是英格兰在人群中保持冷静的中场。如果挪威从中路压上，他可以带球出来，而不是勉强传第一脚。

Marc Guehi.name: Marc Guehi
Marc Guehi.summary: Addji Keaninkin Marc-Israel Guéhi ( GAY-ee; born 13 July 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.
Marc Guehi.note: Guehi has helped settle England's knockout back line. He reads the channel early, which matters against Haaland's first movement and Norway's second runners.
Marc Guehi.noteZh: 格伊帮助英格兰淘汰赛防线稳定下来。他很早读到通道，这对防哈兰德第一步和挪威第二波跑动很重要。

Morgan Rogers.name: Morgan Rogers
Morgan Rogers.summary: Morgan Elliot Rogers (born 26 July 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Aston Villa and the England national team.
Morgan Rogers.note: Rogers gives England a stronger carrying option between midfield and attack. He is the choice if the match needs someone to run through contact.
Morgan Rogers.noteZh: 罗杰斯给英格兰提供中前场之间更强壮的推进选择。如果比赛需要有人带球穿过对抗，他就有意义。

Nico Oreilly.name: Nico Oreilly
Nico Oreilly.summary: Nico O'Reilly is an England midfielder from Manchester City who gives the national team midfield height, late box arrivals, and left-footed progression.
Nico Oreilly.note: O'Reilly has been trusted at left-back in England's reshuffled defense. His card is about height, composure, and doing an unfamiliar job cleanly.
Nico Oreilly.noteZh: 奥赖利在英格兰重组防线中被信任踢左后卫。他的看点是身高、冷静，以及把不熟悉的位置完成得干净。

Noni Madueke.name: Noni Madueke
Noni Madueke.summary: Chukwunonso Azuka Tristan "Noni" Madueke (English: ; born 10 March 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.
Noni Madueke.note: Madueke has started several matches as England's one-on-one winger. He gives the attack a player who wants to beat the defender, not just recycle the ball.
Noni Madueke.noteZh: 马杜埃凯已经多次作为英格兰一对一边锋首发。他给进攻提供一个想过人而不是只回传的球员。

Ollie Watkins.name: Ollie Watkins
Ollie Watkins.summary: Oliver George Arthur Watkins (born 30 December 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Aston Villa and the England national team.
Ollie Watkins.note: Watkins is England's runner behind the line. If Kane drops and the defense follows, Watkins is the option that turns the empty space into a race.
Ollie Watkins.noteZh: 沃特金斯是英格兰冲击防线身后的跑动者。如果凯恩回撤而防线跟出，沃特金斯就是把空当变成冲刺的选择。

Reece James.name: Reece James
Reece James.summary: Reece Lewis James (born 8 December 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Chelsea, which he captains, and the England national team.
Reece James.note: James gives England the strongest right-back delivery in the squad when fit. Against Norway, his crosses would force defenders to watch Kane and the far runner at once.
Reece James.noteZh: 健康时，詹姆斯给英格兰提供队内最强的右后卫传中。对挪威时，他的传球会迫使防守者同时盯凯恩和远端跑动者。

Trevoh Chalobah.name: Trevoh Chalobah
