Trevoh Chalobah.summary: Trevoh Tom Chalobah (born 5 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Chelsea. Born in Sierra Leone, he plays for the England national team.
Trevoh Chalobah.note: Chalobah is defensive flexibility for England's bench. He can protect the right channel or add centre-back depth if the match becomes about defending the box.
Trevoh Chalobah.noteZh: 查洛巴是英格兰替补席上的防守灵活性。他能保护右侧通道，也能在比赛变成禁区防守时增加中卫深度。

Andrej Kramaric.name: Andrej Kramaric
Andrej Kramaric.summary: Andrej Kramarić (Croatian pronunciation: [ǎndrej krǎmaritɕ]; born 19 June 1991) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Croatia national team.
Andrej Kramaric.note: Kramarić gives Croatia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Andrej Kramaric.noteZh: 他是Croatia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Dominik Kotarski.name: Dominik Kotarski
Dominik Kotarski.summary: Dominik Kotarski (Croatian pronunciation: [dôminik kôtarskiː, domǐ-]; born 10 February 2000) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Danish Superliga club Copenhagen and the Croatia national team.
Dominik Kotarski.note: Kotarski is Croatia's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Dominik Kotarski.noteZh: 他是Croatia的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Dominik Livakovic.name: Dominik Livakovic
Dominik Livakovic.summary: Dominik Livaković (Croatian pronunciation: [dôminik liʋǎːkoʋitɕ, domǐ-]; born 9 January 1995) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Croatian Football League club Dinamo Zagreb, on loan from Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe, and the...
Dominik Livakovic.note: Livaković has carried the keeper minutes for Croatia. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Dominik Livakovic.noteZh: 他是Croatia防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Duje Caleta-Car.name: Duje Caleta-Car
Duje Caleta-Car.summary: Duje Ćaleta-Car (Croatian pronunciation: [dǔːje tɕâleta tsâr]; born 17 September 1996) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Real Sociedad, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lyon, and the Croatia national team.
Duje Caleta-Car.note: Ćaleta-Car gives Croatia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Duje Caleta-Car.noteZh: 他是Croatia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Igor Matanovic.name: Igor Matanovic
Igor Matanovic.summary: Igor Matanović (born 31 March 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg. Born in Germany, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Igor Matanovic.note: Matanović gives Croatia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Igor Matanovic.noteZh: 他是Croatia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ivan Perisic.name: Ivan Perisic
Ivan Perisic.summary: Ivan Perišić (Croatian pronunciation: [ǐʋan pěriʃitɕ]; born 2 February 1989) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club PSV and the Croatia national team.
Ivan Perisic.note: Perišić has both scored and created for Croatia in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Ivan Perisic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Croatia贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Ivor Pandur.name: Ivor Pandur
Ivor Pandur.summary: Ivor Pandur (born 25 March 2000) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Hull City and the Croatia national team.
Ivor Pandur.note: Pandur sits behind the starter for Croatia, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Ivor Pandur.noteZh: 他给Croatia保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Josip Stanisic.name: Josip Stanisic
Josip Stanisic.summary: Josip Stanišić (Croatian pronunciation: [jǒsip stǎniʃitɕ]; born 2 April 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich. Born in Germany, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Josip Stanisic.note: Stanišić has supplied one of Croatia's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Josip Stanisic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Croatia创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Josip Sutalo.name: Josip Sutalo
Josip Sutalo.summary: Josip Šutalo (born 28 February 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Ajax. Born in Bosnia and Herzegovina, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Josip Sutalo.note: Šutalo has been part of Croatia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Josip Sutalo.noteZh: 他给Croatia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Kristijan Jakic.name: Kristijan Jakic
Kristijan Jakic.summary: Kristijan Jakić (born 14 May 1997) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder, and can play as a centre-back and right-back for Bundesliga club FC Augsburg and the Croatia national team.
Kristijan Jakic.note: Jakić gives Croatia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Kristijan Jakic.noteZh: 他是Croatia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Luka Sucic.name: Luka Sucic
Luka Sucic.summary: Luka Sučić (Croatian pronunciation: [lûːka sûtʃitɕ]; born 8 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Sociedad. Born in Austria, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Luka Sucic.note: Sučić gives Croatia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Luka Sucic.noteZh: 他是Croatia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Luka Vuskovic.name: Luka Vuskovic
Luka Vuskovic.summary: Luka Vušković (born 24 February 2007) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur, and the Croatia national team.
Luka Vuskovic.note: Vušković is defensive cover for Croatia's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Luka Vuskovic.noteZh: 他是Croatia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Marco Pasalic.name: Marco Pasalic
Marco Pasalic.summary: Marco Pašalić (Croatian pronunciation: [mâːrko pǎʃalitɕ]; born 14 September 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Major League Soccer club Orlando City. Born in Germany, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Marco Pasalic.note: Pašalić is an attacking change-up for Croatia. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Marco Pasalic.noteZh: 他是Croatia的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Marin Pongracic.name: Marin Pongracic
Marin Pongracic.summary: Marin Pongračić (Croatian pronunciation: [mâriːn pǒnɡratʃitɕ]; born 11 September 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Fiorentina. Born in Germany, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Marin Pongracic.note: Pongračić has been part of Croatia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Marin Pongracic.noteZh: 他给Croatia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Mario Pasalic.name: Mario Pasalic
Mario Pasalic.summary: Mario Pašalić (Croatian pronunciation: [mâːrio pǎʃalitɕ]; born 9 February 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A side Atalanta. Born in Germany, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Mario Pasalic.note: Pašalić is midfield insurance for Croatia. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Mario Pasalic.noteZh: 他给Croatia一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Martin Erlic.name: Martin Erlic
Martin Erlic.summary: Martin Erlić (Croatian pronunciation: [mǎrtin êːrlitɕ]; born 24 January 1998) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the Danish club Midtjylland and the Croatia national team.
Martin Erlic.note: Erlić is the kind of defender Croatia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Martin Erlic.noteZh: 他是Croatia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Nikola Moro.name: Nikola Moro
Nikola Moro.summary: Nikola Moro (Italian pronunciation: [nǐkola môːro]; born 12 March 1998) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Bologna and the Croatia national team.
Nikola Moro.note: Moro is midfield insurance for Croatia. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Nikola Moro.noteZh: 他给Croatia一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Nikola Vlasic.name: Nikola Vlasic
Nikola Vlasic.summary: Nikola Vlašić (Croatian pronunciation: [nǐkola ʋlâʃitɕ]; born 4 October 1997) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Torino and the Croatia national team.
Nikola Vlasic.note: Vlašić already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Ghana. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Nikola Vlasic.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Petar Sucic.name: Petar Sucic
Petar Sucic.summary: Petar Sučić (born 25 October 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Inter Milan. Born in Bosnia and Herzegovina, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Petar Sucic.note: Sučić has both scored and created for Croatia in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Petar Sucic.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Toni Fruk.name: Toni Fruk
Toni Fruk.summary: Toni Fruk (born 9 March 2001) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for Croatian Football League club Rijeka and the Croatia national team.
Toni Fruk.note: Fruk gives Croatia midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Toni Fruk.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Croatia来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Aaron Tshibola.name: Aaron Tshibola
Aaron Tshibola.summary: Aaron Tshibola (born 2 January 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. Born in England, he represents the DR Congo national team.
Aaron Tshibola.note: Tshibola is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For DR Congo, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Aaron Tshibola.noteZh: 他给DR Congo提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Alessandro Schopf.name: Alessandro Schopf
Alessandro Schopf.summary: Alessandro André Schöpf (German pronunciation: [aleˈsandʁo ˈʃœpf]; born 7 February 1994) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Austrian Bundesliga club Wolfsberger AC and the Austria national team.
Alessandro Schopf.note: Schöpf is midfield insurance for Austria. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Alessandro Schopf.noteZh: 他给Austria一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Alexander Prass.name: Alexander Prass
Alexander Prass.summary: Alexander Prass (born 26 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or left wing-back for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Austria national team.
Alexander Prass.note: Prass is defensive cover for Austria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Alexander Prass.noteZh: 他是Austria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Alexander Schlager.name: Alexander Schlager
Alexander Schlager.summary: Alexander Schlager (born 1 February 1996) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Austrian Bundesliga club Red Bull Salzburg and the Austria national team.
Alexander Schlager.note: Schlager has carried the keeper minutes for Austria. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Alexander Schlager.noteZh: 他是Austria防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Alexis Mac Allister.name: Alexis Mac Allister
Alexis Mac Allister.summary: Alexis Mac Allister (Spanish pronunciation: [a'leksis ma'kalisteɾ]; born 24 December 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Argentina national team.
Alexis Mac Allister.note: Mac Allister is Argentina's calm connector under pressure. His extra-time assist against Cabo Verde showed how he keeps seeing the clean pass after the match has become messy.
Alexis Mac Allister.noteZh: 麦卡利斯特是阿根廷压力下的冷静连接点。他对佛得角加时的助攻说明，即使比赛变乱，他仍能看见干净传球。

Arthur Masuaku.name: Arthur Masuaku
Arthur Masuaku.summary: Fuka-Arthur Masuaku Kawela (born 7 November 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back or centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lens, on loan from Premier League club Sunderland. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Arthur Masuaku.note: Masuaku has one tournament assist in the bank for DR Congo. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Arthur Masuaku.noteZh: 他已经帮DR Congo制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Axel Tuanzebe.name: Axel Tuanzebe
Axel Tuanzebe.summary: Axel Tuanzebe (born 14 November 1997) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Burnley and the DR Congo national team.
Axel Tuanzebe.note: Tuanzebe has been part of DR Congo's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Axel Tuanzebe.noteZh: 他在DR Congo体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Brian Cipenga.name: Brian Cipenga
Brian Cipenga.summary: Brian Kibambe Cipenga (born 11 March 1998) is a Congolese footballer who plays as a left winger for Spanish club CD Castellón and the DR Congo national team.
Brian Cipenga.note: Cipenga's World Cup has already included a goal against England. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Brian Cipenga.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Carney Chukwuemeka.name: Carney Chukwuemeka
Carney Chukwuemeka.summary: Carney Chibueze Chukwuemeka (; born 20 October 2003) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Austria national team.
Carney Chukwuemeka.note: Chukwuemeka gives Austria midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Carney Chukwuemeka.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Austria来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Cedric Bakambu.name: Cedric Bakambu
Cedric Bakambu.summary: Cédric Bakambu (born 11 April 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or a winger for La Liga club Real Betis and the DR Congo national team.
Cedric Bakambu.note: Bakambu has been part of how DR Congo turns territory into chances. Watch the run before the pass, not only the shot after it.
Cedric Bakambu.noteZh: 他是DR Congo的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Chancel Mbemba.name: Chancel Mbemba
Chancel Mbemba.summary: Chancel Mangulu Mbemba (born 8 August 1994) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lille and the DR Congo national team, of which he is the captain.
Chancel Mbemba.note: Mbemba has already created a goal for DR Congo in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Chancel Mbemba.noteZh: 他已经参与了DR Congo的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Charles Pickel.name: Charles Pickel
Charles Pickel.summary: Charles Monginda Pickel (born 15 May 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Espanyol. Born in Switzerland, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Charles Pickel.note: Pickel gives DR Congo midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Charles Pickel.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对DR Congo来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Cristian Romero.name: Cristian Romero
Cristian Romero.summary: Cristian Gabriel Romero (born 27 April 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur, whom he captains, and the Argentina national team.
Cristian Romero.note: Romero sparked Argentina's comeback against Egypt with the first late goal. He is the defender who attacks danger at both ends, sometimes before anyone else has reacted.
Cristian Romero.noteZh: 罗梅罗用第一个后段进球点燃了阿根廷对埃及的逆转。他是会在两端主动攻击危险的后卫，有时比别人反应更早。

Damian Emiliano Martinez.name: Damian Emiliano Martinez
Damian Emiliano Martinez.summary: Damián Emiliano Martínez Romero (born 2 September 1992), also known as Dibu Martínez, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Aston Villa and the Argentina national team.
Damian Emiliano Martinez.note: Martinez gives Argentina the belief that chaos can still be survived. His tournament card is saves, penalties, and the confidence that changes nervous defenders.
Damian Emiliano Martinez.noteZh: 马丁内斯让阿根廷相信混乱仍能被熬过去。他的赛事卡片是扑救、点球，以及能改变紧张后卫的信心。

David Affengruber.name: David Affengruber
David Affengruber.summary: David Leopold Affengruber (born 19 March 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Elche and the Austria national team.
David Affengruber.note: Affengruber gives Austria cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
David Affengruber.noteZh: 他是Austria后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Dejan Ljubicic.name: Dejan Ljubicic
Dejan Ljubicic.summary: Dejan Ljubičić (born 8 October 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Schalke 04 and the Austria national team.
Dejan Ljubicic.note: Ljubičić is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Austria, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Dejan Ljubicic.noteZh: 他给Austria提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Dylan Batubinsika.name: Dylan Batubinsika
Dylan Batubinsika.summary: Buduka Dylan Batubinsika (born 15 February 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Super League Greece club AEL. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Dylan Batubinsika.note: Batubinsika gives DR Congo cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Dylan Batubinsika.noteZh: 他是DR Congo后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Edo Kayembe.name: Edo Kayembe
Edo Kayembe.summary: Edouard Kayembe (born 3 June 1998) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford and the DR Congo national team.
Edo Kayembe.note: Kayembe gives DR Congo a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Edo Kayembe.noteZh: 他是DR Congo的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Exequiel Palacios.name: Exequiel Palacios
Exequiel Palacios.summary: Exequiel Alejandro Palacios (Spanish pronunciation: [ekseˈkjel paˈla.sjos]; born 5 October 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Argentina national team.
Exequiel Palacios.note: Palacios is Argentina's tidy midfield cover. He is there when the team needs possession to calm down rather than another risky pass toward Messi.
Exequiel Palacios.noteZh: 帕拉西奥斯是阿根廷整洁的中场深度。当球队需要控球降温，而不是再冒险找梅西时，他有价值。

Facundo Medina.name: Facundo Medina
Facundo Medina.summary: Facundo Axel Medina (born 28 May 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Ligue 1 club Marseille, on loan from Lens, and the Argentina national team.
Facundo Medina.note: Medina has been Argentina's left-side defender and already assisted Messi against Austria. He gives aggression at the back plus a first pass that can matter.
Facundo Medina.noteZh: 梅迪纳是阿根廷左侧防守者，也已经在对奥地利时助攻梅西。他既给后场带来侵略性，也有可能送出重要第一传。

Fiston Mayele.name: Fiston Mayele
Fiston Mayele.summary: Mayele Fiston Kalala (born 24 June 1994), commonly known as Fiston Mayele, is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Egyptian Premier League club Pyramids FC and the DR Congo national team.
Fiston Mayele.note: Mayele already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Uzbekistan. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Fiston Mayele.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Florian Grillitsch.name: Florian Grillitsch
Florian Grillitsch.summary: Florian Grillitsch (born 7 August 1995) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre back for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Braga and the Austria national team.
Florian Grillitsch.note: Grillitsch gives Austria a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Florian Grillitsch.noteZh: 他是Austria的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Florian Wiegele.name: Florian Wiegele
Florian Wiegele.summary: Florian Wiegele (born 21 March 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Czech First League club Viktoria Plzeň and the Austria national team.
Florian Wiegele.note: Wiegele is Austria's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Florian Wiegele.noteZh: 他是Austria的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Gael Kakuta.name: Gael Kakuta
Gael Kakuta.summary: Gaël Romeo Kakuta Mambenga (born 21 June 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Greek Super League club AEL. Born in France, he represents the DR Congo national team.
Gael Kakuta.note: Kakuta is attacking depth for DR Congo. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Gael Kakuta.noteZh: 他是DR Congo前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Gedeon Kalulu.name: Gedeon Kalulu
Gedeon Kalulu.summary: Gédéon Tshingoma Kalulu Kyatengwa (born 29 August 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Cypriot club Aris Limassol. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Gedeon Kalulu.note: Kalulu is back-line insurance for DR Congo. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Gedeon Kalulu.noteZh: 他给DR Congo那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Geronimo Rulli.name: Geronimo Rulli
Geronimo Rulli.summary: Gerónimo Rulli (Spanish pronunciation: [xeˈɾonimo ˈruli]; born 20 May 1992) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Marseille and the Argentina national team.
Geronimo Rulli.note: Rulli is experienced goalkeeper cover behind Martinez. His job is to be ready if Argentina need a calmer keeper to manage possession spells.
Geronimo Rulli.noteZh: 鲁利是马丁内斯身后的经验门将保障。如果阿根廷需要一名更冷静的门将管理控球阶段，他要随时准备。

Giovani Lo Celso.name: Giovani Lo Celso
Giovani Lo Celso.summary: Giovani Lo Celso (born 9 April 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Real Betis and the Argentina national team.
Giovani Lo Celso.note: Lo Celso scored in the rotated Jordan match and remains Argentina's left-footed pocket passer. He gives Messi another player who understands the soft space.
Giovani Lo Celso.noteZh: 洛塞尔索在轮换对约旦时进球，依然是阿根廷左脚空当传球手。他给梅西身边再添一个理解柔软空间的人。

Giuliano Simeone.name: Giuliano Simeone
Giuliano Simeone.summary: Giuliano Simeone Baldini (born 18 December 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Giuliano Simeone.note: Simeone is Argentina's energy forward. He presses like the possession can be won back immediately, then runs the channel before defenders settle.
Giuliano Simeone.noteZh: 小西蒙尼是阿根廷的活力前锋。他压迫时像球马上就能抢回来，然后在防守者站稳前冲击通道。

Gonzalo Montiel.name: Gonzalo Montiel
Gonzalo Montiel.summary: Gonzalo Ariel Montiel (born 1 January 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as right-back for the Argentine Primera División club River Plate and the Argentina national team.
Gonzalo Montiel.note: Montiel assisted Messi's late winner against Egypt and still carries late-game trust. Argentina know he can survive tense minutes and make one simple pass count.
Gonzalo Montiel.noteZh: 蒙铁尔助攻梅西打进对埃及的后段反超球，也依然承载比赛后段的信任。阿根廷知道他能熬过紧张时刻，并让一次简单传球产生价值。

Joris Kayembe.name: Joris Kayembe
Joris Kayembe.summary: Joris Kayembe Ditu (born 8 August 1994) is a professional footballer who as a winger plays for Belgian Pro League club Genk. Born in Belgium and formerly a Belgium international in a pair of friendly matches, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Joris Kayembe.note: Kayembe is defensive cover for DR Congo's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Joris Kayembe.noteZh: 他是DR Congo在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Jose Manuel Lopez.name: Jose Manuel Lopez
Jose Manuel Lopez.summary: José Manuel Alberto López (born 6 December 2000), commonly known as Flaco López, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras and the Argentina national team.
Jose Manuel Lopez.note: Lopez is Argentina's taller box option. If Switzerland force the game wide, he gives crosses a target and centre-backs a different problem.
Jose Manuel Lopez.noteZh: 洛佩斯是阿根廷更高大的禁区选择。如果瑞士迫使比赛走边路，他会给传中一个目标，也给中卫不同问题。

Juan Musso.name: Juan Musso
Juan Musso.summary: Juan Agustín Musso (born 6 May 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Juan Musso.note: Musso is experienced goalkeeper depth. He is there for training-ground standards and emergency cover, not as a likely quarter-final storyline.
Juan Musso.noteZh: 穆索是经验门将深度。他的价值是训练标准和紧急保障，而不是八强战很可能出现的主线。

Kevin Danso.name: Kevin Danso
Kevin Danso.summary: Kevin Danso (born 19 September 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Austria national team.
Kevin Danso.note: Danso gives Austria another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Kevin Danso.noteZh: 他给Austria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Lautaro Martinez.name: Lautaro Martinez
Lautaro Martinez.summary: Lautaro Javier Martínez (born 22 August 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Serie A club Inter Milan, which he captains, and the Argentina national team.
Lautaro Martinez.note: Lautaro has scored in this tournament and assisted Enzo's late winner against Egypt. He keeps the box occupied while Messi decides where the opening really is.
Lautaro Martinez.noteZh: 劳塔罗这届赛事已经进球，也助攻恩佐打进对埃及的后段制胜球。他占住禁区，让梅西决定真正的空当在哪里。

Leandro Paredes.name: Leandro Paredes
Leandro Paredes.summary: Leandro Daniel Paredes (Spanish pronunciation: [leˈandɾo paˈɾeðes]; born 29 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors and the Argentina national team.
Leandro Paredes.note: Paredes gives Argentina a deeper passing reset when the midfield gets frantic. He can slow the game before Messi has to solve everything himself.
Leandro Paredes.noteZh: 帕雷德斯在中场变得急躁时给阿根廷更深的传球重置。他能先把比赛放慢，而不是让梅西独自解决一切。

Lionel Mpasi.name: Lionel Mpasi
Lionel Mpasi.summary: Lionnel Mpasi Nzau (born 1 August 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Le Havre. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Lionel Mpasi.note: Mpasi has been DR Congo's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Lionel Mpasi.noteZh: 他给DR Congo提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Lisandro Martinez.name: Lisandro Martinez
Lisandro Martinez.summary: Lisandro Martínez (born 18 January 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester United and the Argentina national team. Nicknamed "The Butcher", he is known for his aggressive style of play.
Lisandro Martinez.note: Lisandro has been both defender and emergency scorer, assisting Messi against Cabo Verde before scoring in extra time. His bite comes with a forward pass.
Lisandro Martinez.noteZh: 利桑德罗既是防守者，也是紧急得分点，对佛得角先助攻梅西再在加时进球。他的硬度还带着向前传球。

Marco Friedl.name: Marco Friedl
Marco Friedl.summary: Marco Friedl (born 16 March 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, which he captains, and the Austria national team.
Marco Friedl.note: Friedl is back-line insurance for Austria. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Marco Friedl.noteZh: 他给Austria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Marcos Senesi.name: Marcos Senesi
Marcos Senesi.summary: Marcos Nicolás Senesi Barón (born 10 May 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Argentina national team. He will join Tottenham Hotspur on 1 July 2026.
Marcos Senesi.note: Senesi is left-sided centre-back cover for Argentina's rotation. He keeps the passing angle alive when the staff want control more than pure aggression.
Marcos Senesi.noteZh: 塞内西是阿根廷轮换中的左侧中卫深度。当教练组想要控制多于纯粹侵略性时，他能保持传球角度。

Matthieu Epolo.name: Matthieu Epolo
Matthieu Epolo.summary: Matthieu Epolo Luka (born 15 January 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Belgian Pro League club Standard Liège. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Matthieu Epolo.note: Epolo sits behind the starter for DR Congo, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Matthieu Epolo.noteZh: 他给DR Congo保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Meschack Elia.name: Meschack Elia
Meschack Elia.summary: Meschak Elia Lina (born 6 August 1997) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Süper Lig club Alanyaspor and the DR Congo national team.
Meschack Elia.note: Elia has already made a goal happen for DR Congo. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Meschack Elia.noteZh: 他已经为DR Congo送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Michael Gregoritsch.name: Michael Gregoritsch
Michael Gregoritsch.summary: Michael Gregoritsch (born 18 April 1994) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club FC Augsburg, and the Austria national team.
Michael Gregoritsch.note: Gregoritsch has already created a goal for Austria in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Michael Gregoritsch.noteZh: 他已经参与了Austria的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Michael Svoboda.name: Michael Svoboda
Michael Svoboda.summary: Michael Svoboda (born 15 October 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Venezia and the Austria national team.
Michael Svoboda.note: Svoboda is defensive cover for Austria's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Michael Svoboda.noteZh: 他是Austria在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Nahuel Molina.name: Nahuel Molina
Nahuel Molina.summary: Nahuel Molina Lucero (born 6 April 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Nahuel Molina.note: Molina has been Argentina's main right-back in the knockout run. His job is to run beyond De Paul and still recover before counters reach Romero.
Nahuel Molina.noteZh: 莫利纳是阿根廷淘汰赛阶段的主要右后卫。他要在德保罗身前前插，同时在反击到达罗梅罗前回追。

Nathanael Mbuku.name: Nathanael Mbuku
Nathanael Mbuku.summary: Nathanaël Mbuku Wa Mbuku (born 16 March 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 2 club Montpellier, on loan from Bundesliga club Augsburg. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Nathanael Mbuku.note: Mbuku is the forward DR Congo can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Nathanael Mbuku.noteZh: 他给DR Congo替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Ngalayel Mukau.name: Ngalayel Mukau
Ngalayel Mukau.summary: Ngal'ayel Mukau (born 3 November 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Ngalayel Mukau.note: Mukau gives DR Congo structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Ngalayel Mukau.noteZh: 他给DR Congo控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Nico Gonzalez.name: Nico Gonzalez
Nico Gonzalez.summary: Nicolás Iván González (Spanish pronunciation: [nikoˈlas iˈβaŋ ɡonˈsales]; born 6 April 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Atlético Madrid, on loan from Serie A club Juventus, and the Argentina national team.
Nico Gonzalez.note: Gonzalez assisted Messi in the opener and remains Argentina's hard-running wide option. He attacks the far post and does the work that keeps the front line balanced.
Nico Gonzalez.noteZh: 尼科·冈萨雷斯在首战助攻梅西，仍是阿根廷高强度跑动的边路选择。他冲击远端，也做保持锋线平衡的工作。

Nico Paz.name: Nico Paz
Nico Paz.summary: Nicolás Paz Martínez (born 8 September 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Como. Born in Spain, he plays for the Argentina national team.
Nico Paz.note: Paz is Argentina's younger creative midfielder for rotation games. He receives between pressure lines and tries to play forward before the safe pass appears.
Nico Paz.noteZh: 尼科·帕斯是阿根廷轮换比赛中的年轻创造型中场。他在压力线之间接球，并试图在安全传球出现前就向前处理。

Nicolas Otamendi.name: Nicolas Otamendi
Nicolas Otamendi.summary: Nicolás Hernán Gonzalo Otamendi (born 12 February 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Benfica, which he captains, and the Argentina national team.
Nicolas Otamendi.note: Otamendi is veteran defensive authority if Argentina need to close a match. He gives aerial command and the personality to make late minutes feel smaller.
Nicolas Otamendi.noteZh: 如果阿根廷需要收掉比赛，奥塔门迪是老将防守权威。他提供空中控制，也用气场让后段时间显得没那么大。

Nicolas Seiwald.name: Nicolas Seiwald
Nicolas Seiwald.summary: Nicolas Seiwald (born 4 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Austria national team.
Nicolas Seiwald.note: Seiwald has been one of Austria's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Nicolas Seiwald.noteZh: 他是Austria这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Nicolas Tagliafico.name: Nicolas Tagliafico
Nicolas Tagliafico.summary: Nicolás Alejandro Tagliafico (born 31 August 1992) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Lyon and the Argentina national team.
Nicolas Tagliafico.note: Tagliafico has returned as the safer left-back in the knockout mix. He narrows the defense and lets the midfield take more of the attacking risk.
Nicolas Tagliafico.noteZh: 塔利亚菲科在淘汰赛组合中作为更安全的左后卫回归。他收窄防线，让中场承担更多进攻风险。

Patrick Pentz.name: Patrick Pentz
Patrick Pentz.summary: Patrick Pentz (born 2 January 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Danish Superliga club Brøndby and the Austria national team.
Patrick Pentz.note: Pentz gives Austria a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Patrick Pentz.noteZh: 他在Austria首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Patrick Wimmer.name: Patrick Wimmer
Patrick Wimmer.summary: Patrick Wimmer (born 30 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Bundesliga club Hoffenheim and the Austria national team.
Patrick Wimmer.note: Wimmer is an attacking change-up for Austria. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Patrick Wimmer.noteZh: 他是Austria的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Paul Wanner.name: Paul Wanner
Paul Wanner.summary: Paul Wanner (German pronunciation: [paʊ̯l ˈvanɐ]; born 23 December 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club PSV.
Paul Wanner.note: Wanner is the midfield player Austria can use when possession needs a sharper touch near the box. He tries to make one small gap matter.
Paul Wanner.noteZh: 他给Austria一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Philipp Lienhart.name: Philipp Lienhart
Philipp Lienhart.summary: Philipp Lienhart (born 11 July 1996) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Austria national team.
Philipp Lienhart.note: Lienhart is defensive rotation for Austria. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Philipp Lienhart.noteZh: 他是Austria后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Phillip Mwene.name: Phillip Mwene
Phillip Mwene.summary: Phillipp Mwene (born 29 January 1994) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Bundesliga club Mainz 05 and the Austria national team.
Phillip Mwene.note: Mwene gives Austria defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Phillip Mwene.noteZh: 他给Austria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Rodrigo De Paul.name: Rodrigo De Paul
Rodrigo De Paul.summary: Rodrigo Javier De Paul (Spanish pronunciation: [roˈðɾiɣo ðe pol]; born 24 May 1994) is an Argentine professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami and the Argentina national team.
Rodrigo De Paul.note: De Paul remains Argentina's running power around Messi, with an assist in the opener and constant cover afterward. He connects the genius to the grind.
Rodrigo De Paul.noteZh: 德保罗依然是梅西身边的跑动力量，首战有助攻，此后不断补位。他把天才和脏活连接起来。

Samuel Moutoussamy.name: Samuel Moutoussamy
Samuel Moutoussamy.summary: Samuel Albert Alain Arcade Moutoussamy (born 12 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Greek Super League club Atromitos. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Samuel Moutoussamy.note: Moutoussamy is a tempo player for DR Congo. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Samuel Moutoussamy.noteZh: 他让DR Congo在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Simon Banza.name: Simon Banza
Simon Banza.summary: Simon Bokoté Banza (born 13 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE Pro League side Al Jazira. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Simon Banza.note: Banza is attacking depth for DR Congo. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Simon Banza.noteZh: 他是DR Congo前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Stefan Posch.name: Stefan Posch
Stefan Posch.summary: Stefan Posch (German pronunciation: [ˈʃtɛfa (ː)n ˈpɔʃ]; born 14 May 1997) is an Austrian footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for Bundesliga club Mainz 05, on loan from Serie A club Como, and the Austria national team.
Stefan Posch.note: Posch gives Austria one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Stefan Posch.noteZh: 他是Austria无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Steve Kapuadi.name: Steve Kapuadi
Steve Kapuadi.summary: Steve Nkanu Kapuadi (born 30 April 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Polish club Widzew Łódź. Born in France, he represents the DR Congo national team.
Steve Kapuadi.note: Kapuadi is defensive rotation for DR Congo. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Steve Kapuadi.noteZh: 他给DR Congo那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Theo Bongonda.name: Theo Bongonda
Theo Bongonda.summary: Théo Bongonda Mbul'Ofeko Batombo (born 20 November 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Theo Bongonda.note: Bongonda is attacking depth for DR Congo. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Theo Bongonda.noteZh: 他是DR Congo前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Thiago Almada.name: Thiago Almada
Thiago Almada.summary: Thiago Ezequiel Almada (born 26 April 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Thiago Almada.note: Almada has started across the attacking midfield line and gives Argentina another set-piece and shooting option. He keeps defenders from loading every answer onto Messi.
Thiago Almada.noteZh: 阿尔马达已经在进攻中场线上多个位置首发，给阿根廷另一名定位球和射门选择。他让防守者不能把所有答案都压到梅西身上。

Timothy Fayulu.name: Timothy Fayulu
Timothy Fayulu.summary: Timothy Bruce Fayulu (born 24 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Armenian Premier League club FC Noah on loan from Sion. Born in Switzerland, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Timothy Fayulu.note: Fayulu is goalkeeper cover for DR Congo. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Timothy Fayulu.noteZh: 他是DR Congo门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Valentin Barco.name: Valentin Barco
Valentin Barco.summary: Valentín Barco (born 23 July 2004), better known as Colo Barco, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg and the Argentina national team.
Valentin Barco.note: Barco is left-footed invention from deeper or wider spaces. He is the change-up if Argentina need a different angle rather than another central combination.
Valentin Barco.noteZh: 巴尔科是在更深或更宽位置提供左脚创造力的人。如果阿根廷需要不同角度，而不是又一次中路配合，他就是变化。

Xaver Schlager.name: Xaver Schlager
Xaver Schlager.summary: Xaver Schlager (German pronunciation: [ˈksaːvɐ ˈʃlaːɡɐ]; born 28 September 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Austria national team.
Xaver Schlager.note: Schlager has supplied one of Austria's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Xaver Schlager.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Austria创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Sasa Kalajdzic.name: Sasa Kalajdzic
Sasa Kalajdzic.summary: Saša Kalajdžić (Serbian Cyrillic: Саша Калајџић; born 7 July 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Austrian Bundesliga club LASK on loan from EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Austria national team.
Sasa Kalajdzic.note: Kalajdžić's World Cup has already included a goal against Algeria. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Sasa Kalajdzic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Abdulla Abdullaev.name: Abdulla Abdullaev
Abdulla Abdullaev.summary: Abdulla Abdullaev (Uzbek: Abdulla Qahramonjon oʻgʻli Abdullayev, Абдулла Қаҳрамонжон ўғли Абдуллаев; born 1 September 1997) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays for Dibba and the Uzbekistan national team.
Abdulla Abdullaev.note: Abdullaev gives Uzbekistan defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Abdulla Abdullaev.noteZh: 他是Uzbekistan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Achref Abada.name: Achref Abada
Achref Abada.summary: Achref Abada (Arabic: أشرف عبادة; born 15 June 1999) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club USM Alger and the Algeria national team.
Achref Abada.note: Abada is back-line insurance for Algeria. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Achref Abada.noteZh: 他给Algeria那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Adil Boulbina.name: Adil Boulbina
Adil Boulbina.summary: Adil Boulbina (Arabic: عادل بولبينة; born May 2, 2003) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as forward for Al-Duhail and the Algeria national team.
Adil Boulbina.note: Boulbina is attacking depth for Algeria. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Adil Boulbina.noteZh: 他是Algeria前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Aissa Mandi.name: Aissa Mandi
Aissa Mandi.summary: Aïssa Mandi (Arabic: عيسى ماندي; born 22 October 1991) is a professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team.
Aissa Mandi.note: Mandi gives Algeria one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Aissa Mandi.noteZh: 他是Algeria无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Akmal Mozgovoy.name: Akmal Mozgovoy
Akmal Mozgovoy.summary: Akmal Vladimirovich Mozgovoy (Uzbek: Akmal Mozgovoy; born 2 April 1999) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Pakhtakor and the Uzbekistan national team.
Akmal Mozgovoy.note: Mozgovoy has supplied one of Uzbekistan's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Akmal Mozgovoy.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Uzbekistan创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Alvaro Montero.name: Alvaro Montero
Alvaro Montero.summary: Álvaro David Montero Perales (born 29 March 1995) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield, on loan from Categoría Primera A club Millonarios and the Colombia national team.
Alvaro Montero.note: Montero gives Colombia a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Alvaro Montero.noteZh: 他在Colombia首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Andres Gomez.name: Andres Gomez
Andres Gomez.summary: Carlos Andrés Gómez Hinestroza (born 12 September 2002) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Vasco da Gama and the Colombia national team.
Andres Gomez.note: Gómez gives Colombia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Andres Gomez.noteZh: 他是Colombia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Anis Hadj Moussa.note: Moussa is the forward Algeria can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Anis Hadj Moussa.noteZh: 他给Algeria替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Christopher Bonsu Baah.name: Christopher Bonsu Baah
Christopher Bonsu Baah.summary: Christopher Bonsu Baah (born 14 December 2004) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League side Al-Qadsiah and the Ghana national team.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.note: Baah gives Ghana midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Ghana来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Derrick Luckassen.name: Derrick Luckassen
Derrick Luckassen.summary: Derrick Luckassen (born 3 July 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cypriot club Pafos. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Derrick Luckassen.note: Luckassen is on the scoresheet for Ghana, with his goal coming against Croatia. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Derrick Luckassen.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Ehsan Haddad.name: Ehsan Haddad
Ehsan Haddad.summary: Ehsan Manial Farhan Haddad (Arabic: إِحْسَان منيل فَرْحَان حَدَّاد; born 5 February 1994) is a Jordanian footballer who plays for the Jordanian club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Ehsan Haddad.note: Haddad has already made a goal happen for Jordan. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Ehsan Haddad.noteZh: 他已经为Jordan送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Elisha Owusu.name: Elisha Owusu
Elisha Owusu.summary: Elisha Owusu (born 7 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in France, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Elisha Owusu.note: Owusu is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Ghana, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Elisha Owusu.noteZh: 他给Ghana提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Ernest Nuamah.name: Ernest Nuamah
Ernest Nuamah.summary: Ernest Nuamah Appiah (born 1 November 2003) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Lyon and the Ghana national team.
Ernest Nuamah.note: Nuamah has supplied one of Ghana's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ernest Nuamah.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Ghana创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Gideon Mensah.name: Gideon Mensah
Gideon Mensah.summary: Gideon Mensah (born 18 July 1998) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Auxerre and the Ghana national team.
Gideon Mensah.note: Mensah has been part of Ghana's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Gideon Mensah.noteZh: 他在Ghana体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Husam Abu Dahab.name: Husam Abu Dahab
Husam Abu Dahab.summary: Husam Ali Mohammad Abu Dahab (Arabic: حُسَام عَلِيّ مُحَمَّد أَبُو ذَهَب, born 13 May 2000) is a Jordanian footballer who is a center-back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Faisaly, as well as the Jordan national team.
Husam Abu Dahab.note: Dahab gives Jordan another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Husam Abu Dahab.noteZh: 他是Jordan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Ibrahim Sadeh.name: Ibrahim Sadeh
Ibrahim Sadeh.summary: Ibrahim Mohammad Sami Sadeh (Arabic: إبراهيم سعادة; born 27 April 2000) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Iraqi Stars League side Al-Karma and the Jordan national team.
Ibrahim Sadeh.note: Sadeh gives Jordan a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Ibrahim Sadeh.noteZh: 他是Jordan的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Jerome Opoku.name: Jerome Opoku
Jerome Opoku.summary: Jerome Osei Opoku (born 14 October 1998) is a professional footballer. He plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir.
Jerome Opoku.note: Opoku gives Ghana one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Jerome Opoku.noteZh: 他是Ghana无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Jonas Adjetey.name: Jonas Adjetey
Jonas Adjetey.summary: Jonas Adjei Adjetey (born 13 December 2003) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays for German 2. Bundesliga side VfL Wolfsburg and the Ghana national team. He plays mainly in the position of centre-back, but can also play as full-back on either side.
Jonas Adjetey.note: Adjetey has been part of Ghana's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Jonas Adjetey.noteZh: 他给Ghana后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Joseph Anang.name: Joseph Anang
Joseph Anang.summary: Joseph Tetteh Anang (born 8 June 2000) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for League of Ireland Premier Division club St Patrick's Athletic and the Ghana national team.
Joseph Anang.note: Anang sits behind the starter for Ghana, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Joseph Anang.noteZh: 他给Ghana保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Kamaldeen Sulemana.name: Kamaldeen Sulemana
Kamaldeen Sulemana.summary: Kamaldeen Sulemana (born 15 February 2002), also known simply as Kamaldeen, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or a forward for Serie A club Atalanta and the Ghana national team.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.note: Sulemana is the forward Ghana can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.noteZh: 他给Ghana替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Kojo Peprah Oppong.name: Kojo Peprah Oppong
Kojo Peprah Oppong.summary: Kojo Peprah Oppong (born 4 June 2004) is a French-Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Nice and the Ghana national team.
Kojo Peprah Oppong.note: Oppong is the kind of defender Ghana can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Kojo Peprah Oppong.noteZh: 他是Ghana艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Kwasi Sibo.name: Kwasi Sibo
Kwasi Sibo.summary: Kwasi Sibo (born 24 June 1998) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Segunda División club Real Oviedo and the Ghana national team.
Kwasi Sibo.note: Sibo has been one of Ghana's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Kwasi Sibo.noteZh: 他是Ghana这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Lawrence Ati-Zigi.name: Lawrence Ati-Zigi
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.summary: Lawrence Ati-Zigi (born 29 November 1996) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Swiss Super League club St. Gallen and the Ghana national team. Ati-Zigi has represented Ghana at under-17 and under-20 levels.
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.note: Ati-Zigi gives Ghana a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.noteZh: 他在Ghana首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Mahmoud Al-Mardi.name: Mahmoud Al-Mardi
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.summary: Mahmoud Nayef Mardi Al-Hwaitat (Arabic: مَحْمُود نَايِف مَرْضِيّ الحويطات; born 6 October 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a winger for the Jordanian club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.note: Mardi gives Jordan a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.noteZh: 他是Jordan在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Marvin Senaya.name: Marvin Senaya
Marvin Senaya.summary: Marvin Senaya (born 28 January 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in France, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Marvin Senaya.note: Senaya gives Ghana one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Marvin Senaya.noteZh: 他是Ghana无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Mohammad Abu Alnadi.name: Mohammad Abu Alnadi
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.summary: Mohammad Abu Alnadi is a Jordanian centre-back for Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.note: Alnadi is back-line insurance for Jordan. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.noteZh: 他给Jordan那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Mohammad Abu Ghoush.name: Mohammad Abu Ghoush
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.summary: Mohammad Ahmed Mohammad Taha (Arabic: محمد أحمد محمد طه; born 13 July 2005), also known as Mohammad Abu Ghoush (Arabic: محمد أبو غوش), is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a left back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Hussein, on loan from Shabab...
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.note: Taha gives Jordan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.noteZh: 他是Jordan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.name: Mohammad Abu Hasheesh
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.summary: Mohammad Ali Hasan Abu Hashish (Arabic: مُحَمَّد عَلِيّ حَسَن أَبُو حَشِيش; born 9 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Iraq Stars League side Al-Karma. Born in Iraq, he represents the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.note: Hashish is back-line insurance for Jordan. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.noteZh: 他给Jordan那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Mohammad Abu Zraiq.name: Mohammad Abu Zraiq
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.summary: Mohammad Faisal Yousef Abu Zrayq (Arabic: محمد فيصل يوسف أبو زريق, born 30 December 1997), popularly known as Sharara (Arabic: شرارة), is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Botola Pro club Raja CA and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.note: Zraiq is the forward Jordan can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.noteZh: 他给Jordan替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Mohammad Al-Daoud.name: Mohammad Al-Daoud
Mohammad Al-Daoud.summary: Mohammad Rateb Al-Dawoud (Arabic: مُحَمَّد رَاتِب الدَّاوُود; born 12 April 1992) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Wehdat and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.note: Al-Daoud gives Jordan a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.noteZh: 他是Jordan的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Mohannad Abu Taha.name: Mohannad Abu Taha
Mohannad Abu Taha.summary: Mohannad Mahmoud Saleh Abu Taha (Arabic: مُهَنَّد مَحْمُود صَالِح أَبُو طٰهٰ; born 2 February 2003) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a winger or left-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya, and the Jordan national team.
Mohannad Abu Taha.note: Taha has been part of Jordan's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Mohannad Abu Taha.noteZh: 他给Jordan后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Nizar Al-Rashdan.name: Nizar Al-Rashdan
Nizar Al-Rashdan.summary: Nizar Mahmoud Ahmed Al-Rashdan (Arabic: نزار الرشدان; born 23 March 1999) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Qatar Stars League club Qatar SC and the Jordan national team.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.note: Al-Rashdan already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Algeria. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Nour Bani Attiah.name: Nour Bani Attiah
Nour Bani Attiah.summary: Noureddin Ziad Bani Attiah (Arabic: نُور الدِّين زِيَاد بَنِي عَطِيَّة; born 25 January 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Al-Faisaly and the Jordan national team.
Nour Bani Attiah.note: Attiah is goalkeeper cover for Jordan. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Nour Bani Attiah.noteZh: 他是Jordan门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Odeh Fakhoury.name: Odeh Fakhoury
Odeh Fakhoury.summary: Odeh Burhan Shehadeh Fakhoury (Arabic: عودة برهان شحادة الفاخوري; born 22 November 2005) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a forward for Egyptian Premier League club Pyramids and the Jordan national team.
Odeh Fakhoury.note: Al-Fakhouri is the forward Jordan can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Odeh Fakhoury.noteZh: 他给Jordan替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Prince Adu.name: Prince Adu
Prince Adu.summary: Prince Kwabena Adu (born 23 September 2003) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays for Viktoria Plzeň and the Ghana national team. He was included in The Guardian's "Next Generation 2020".
Prince Adu.note: Adu is midfield insurance for Ghana. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Prince Adu.noteZh: 他给Ghana一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Rajaei Ayed.name: Rajaei Ayed
Rajaei Ayed.summary: Raja'ei Ayed Fadel Hasan (Arabic: رَجَائِيّ عَايِد فَاضِل حَسَن; born 25 July 1993) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Rajaei Ayed.note: Ayed gives Jordan a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Rajaei Ayed.noteZh: 他是Jordan的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Saed Al-Rosan.name: Saed Al-Rosan
Saed Al-Rosan.summary: Saed Ahmad Salameh Al-Rosan (Arabic: سَعْد أَحْمَد سَلَامَة الرُّوسَان; born 1 February 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Saed Al-Rosan.note: Al-Rosan is defensive cover for Jordan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Saed Al-Rosan.noteZh: 他是Jordan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Saleem Obaid.name: Saleem Obaid
Saleem Obaid.summary: Saleem Amer Obaid (Arabic: سَلِيم عَامِر عُبَيْد; born 17 January 1992) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a left back for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Saleem Obaid.note: Obaid gives Jordan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Saleem Obaid.noteZh: 他是Jordan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Yazan Al-Arab.name: Yazan Al-Arab
Yazan Al-Arab.summary: Yazan Mousa Mahmoud Abu Al-Arab (Arabic: يَزَن مُوسَى مَحْمُود أَبُو الْعَرَب; born 31 January 1996) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for K-League side FC Seoul and the Jordan national team.
Yazan Al-Arab.note: Al-Arab gives Jordan one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Yazan Al-Arab.noteZh: 他是Jordan无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Yazeed Abulaila.name: Yazeed Abulaila
Yazeed Abulaila.summary: Yazeed Moein Hasan Abu Laila (Arabic: يَزِيد مُعِين حَسَن أَبُو لَيْلَى; born 8 January 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Yazeed Abulaila.note: Laila is the last voice in Jordan's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Yazeed Abulaila.noteZh: 他承担了Jordan的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Neymar Jr.name: Neymar Jr
Neymar Jr.summary: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [nejˈmaʁ dɐ ˈsiwvɐ ˈsɐ̃tuz‿ˈʒuni.oʁ] ; born 5 February 1992) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club...
Neymar Jr.note: Neymar is on the scoresheet for Brazil, with his goal coming against Norway. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Neymar Jr.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。
